summary: A **hybrid** route: solo questing all the way, plus one run of a dungeon only where the run and its quests beat questing. Solo on a fresh account with no rested XP it takes about **28 hours /played to 30**, **55 to 40** and **138 to 60**. Logging out at an inn every day cuts 10–15 hours, and the optional group dungeons at 55–60 save a few more. About a third of the time is grinding mobs, almost all of it from 47 on, where the Alliance runs out of unused quests (the classic speed routes grind there too). Each grind step names the mobs and where. 1–27 stays in the Eastern Kingdoms, with a short Ashenvale trip at 27–29. 29–40 runs through the Wetlands, Hillsbrad, Duskwood, Alterac, Desolace, Arathi, Stranglethorn and the Swamp of Sorrows. 40–50 is the Badlands, the new Riverglades, Uldaman, Searing Gorge, Tanaris and Feralas. 50–60 is Un'Goro, the Blasted Lands, Felwood, Winterspring, Silithus, the Burning Steppes and the Plaguelands.
assumptions: **Fresh account.** No Legacy points. If you have **Well Rested**, **Talented** or **Frequent Flier**, you'll be a little ahead of the levels shown.

**Affliction, Imp and drain-tanking.** Launch pets have little health (Nov 2 patch), so the Voidwalker waits until you first reach Stormwind (about level 15.6), and the **Succubus and Felhunter quests are skipped**. If Blizzard buffs pets again, the Voidwalker comes back to level 10–11.

**Each dungeon once, with its quests in your log:** Hall of Thanes, Deadmines, Stockade, Excavation Site, Gnomeregan, City of Dalaran and Uldaman. The levels assume you run them; if no group forms within about 10 minutes, grind the mobs named in the next grind step instead. Krol'dok, Zul'Farrak, Blackrock Depths, Lower Blackrock Spire and Stratholme are optional. Never repeat a dungeon for XP.
**Quests are skipped on purpose** when they are slow for their XP: long walks, elites your pet can't tank, rare drops. Each section lists what it skips and why.
**Levels are targets, not promises.** Behind? Grind the mobs named in the next grind step. Ahead? Skip steps marked Optional.
**Deathskips** (dying on purpose to respawn at a spirit healer near your next stop) are used a few times early on, where they save a long walk.

**Built from** launch data (the race.aotc.gg leaderboard, Blizzard forums, Nov 4–6), RestedXP's free Forever route for 1–21, beta measurements, Wowhead Forever, guide sites and videos, and the classic Alliance speed routes for 40–60. Every step shows how sure we are and links its sources.

decisions.fork: Get the Voidwalker at 10, or later?
decisions.choice: Later: at about 15.6, the first time you reach Stormwind.
decisions.why: The Nov 2 patch cut pet health from 7.5 to 2 per point of Stamina. At launch the Voidwalker has less health than you, and warlocks stay on the Imp and drain-tank. Waiting also saves a separate trip to Stormwind at 11. **If pets are buffed again**, go back to getting it at 10–11.

decisions.fork: Darkshore, or Westfall and Redridge, for 12–20?
decisions.choice: Stay in the Eastern Kingdoms: Loch Modan, Hall of Thanes, Westfall, Deadmines, Redridge. No boats.
decisions.why: Darkshore has only about 7 new quests, and boats broke on launch day. Beta players reached 20 on Eastern Kingdoms quests plus Hall of Thanes and Deadmines.

decisions.fork: When to run Hall of Thanes?
decisions.choice: At about 14, straight from Loch Modan.
decisions.why: Its quests are level 15–16. The mobs give little XP (a launch full clear gave about three bars), so the run is worth it for its five quests, including **The Treaty of Understanding**. Entering from Loch Modan avoids two tram rides.

decisions.choice: At about 20, before Redridge and Duskwood.
decisions.why: Its quests (17–22) give full XP at 20. It is the busiest dungeon at launch, so groups form fast. Later, Redridge's 21–25 and Duskwood's 25–28 quests are no longer too hard.
Pets are weak at launch, and the Felhunter chain alone has five far-apart stops across two continents. You also skip Blackfathom Deeps, so no **Gravestone Scepter** wand. Re-check if pets are buffed.

decisions.choice: Yes: once, at about 24.5, with all five quests.
decisions.why: ForeverDB's launch logs show Forever paying about twice the old XP for quests done inside a dungeon: 5,550 each for **Quell the Uprising** and **The Color of Blood**. One run with all five quests is worth about 29,000 XP in about 1.2 hours, including the wait for a group and the hand-ins.

decisions.fork: Grind in the Wetlands, or cross to Kalimdor?
decisions.choice: A short Ashenvale trip on the Menethil → Auberdine ship, at 27.6–29.4.
decisions.why: It replaces about 550 Wetlands grind kills. Ashenvale's Alliance quests from 25 to 32 pay about 25,000 XP an hour as you cross the zone, and you pick up the Auberdine and Astranaar flight paths that later parts use. **If the ship doesn't come**, grind the Wetlands mobs named in the step instead.

decisions.choice: At about 30.8: after the Excavation Site and one loop of the northern Wetlands.
decisions.why: The Excavation Site's quests pay about 18,500 XP for one run. The Dun Modr camp holds three quest chains a few hundred yards apart, so the northern Wetlands is a single loop. Then the Southshore boat leaves from Menethil.

decisions.choice: Southshore, the cities, a Duskwood return, Alterac with the City of Dalaran, then Desolace and Arathi.
decisions.why: That's the launch Alliance trail: 16 of 27 Alliance players at 31 were in Duskwood. Each Alliance City of Dalaran quest pays about 9,400 XP. Desolace, the classic speed route's 33–35 zone, adds about 47,000 quest XP in about 2.7 hours, counting the trip there.

decisions.fork: What to do when Stranglethorn runs out at about 37.7?
decisions.choice: Hillsbrad, Alterac, Arathi and the Swamp of Sorrows to 39, then back to Stranglethorn.
decisions.why: A launch duo levelled 38–40 exactly there. It beats grinding Stranglethorn's basilisks only slightly, by about half an hour, so if you'd rather stay put, grind the mobs the step names.

decisions.fork: Mount at 40: Felsteed quest or buy riding?
decisions.choice: Felsteed: take the Booty Bay → Ratchet boat, then hearth back.
decisions.why: The Felsteed spell lists no riding requirement, and the trip fits between Stranglethorn and the Badlands. It's unconfirmed whether you still need Apprentice Riding (100 g). If you do, buy it from Binjy at Steelgrill's Depot instead.

decisions.fork: Shen'dralas and the Cozy Sleeping Bag?
decisions.why: Shen'dralas needs Honored with the Magram centaurs and has no flight path. The Sleeping Bag chain sends you through the Horde-held Barrens and a PvP-camped dam for about 3% XP.

decisions.fork: How to fit in the new Riverglades?
decisions.choice: Badlands at 40–40.6, Riverglades to about 44.6, then Uldaman.
decisions.why: The Badlands quests give full XP at 40 and lose value fast after that. Riverglades is a level 36–44 zone with over 150 quests, and Farholde Keep flies straight to Thelsamar. The race leader quested there at 42.5. Its quests aren't published yet, so this part is the route's biggest unknown. **If they're thin**, the step names a Stranglethorn grind instead.

decisions.fork: Hinterlands, or Searing Gorge and Kalimdor?
decisions.choice: Searing Gorge, then the Powderfuse Port ship to Tanaris, with Feralas between the two Tanaris loops.
decisions.why: Searing Gorge's quests (45–50) pay about 44,000 XP in two hours, and you can walk in from the Badlands without a key. Feralas's Feathermoon chains beat grinding by about a fifth and open the flight paths to Silithus. The Hinterlands' reachable quests paid no better than grinding. From about 47.7 nothing reachable is left at your level, so the last 2.3 levels are a grind.

decisions.fork: How to cover 50–55 with no warlock trainer on Kalimdor?
decisions.choice: Un'Goro, one trip home to train with the Blasted Lands on the way, then Felwood, Winterspring and Silithus.
decisions.why: The Blasted Lands pay about 34,000 quest XP, mostly for monster parts you collect while you grind. The new Stormwind Harbor ship lands in Auberdine, one flight from Felwood. At 54.6, Silithus's Cenarion Hold quests pay about 65,000 XP in 1.5 hours, which beats grinding there.

decisions.choice: Burning Steppes, then the Plaguelands, mostly grinding; the group dungeons are optional.
decisions.why: Few unused Alliance quests are left from 55. **The True Masters** courier chain pays about 20,700 XP, and Tirion's chain about 18,400 XP in 20–25 minutes. The rest is about 1,800 kills. Blackrock Depths, Lower Blackrock Spire or Stratholme with a group can replace part of it.

legs.title: Coldridge Valley & Dun Morogh
legs.summary: You start at Anvilmar, get your Imp from the Feather Charm quest and clear Coldridge Valley by about level 5.6. Then Kharanos is your base: the camping and cooking intro, the Grizzled Den, the new Misty Pine Refuge quests and two loops through Brewnall, dying on purpose to get back to Kharanos fast. You finish at 10.3 with Blood Pact on your Imp and the part 2 quests in your log.
legs.why: This part follows RestedXP's Forever 1–11 Dwarf/Gnome route, which has been kept up to date since launch and already uses the new Kharanos quests and deathskips (dying on purpose to respawn at a spirit healer near your next stop). Three changes make it faster. First, you do the five Misty Pine Refuge quests, about 2,350 quest XP at launch on ForeverDB, right after the Steelgrill's Depot turn-ins at about 7.1, while their level 7–8 mobs are still yellow (full XP). In the beta, Forever cut XP from green (low-level) mobs, and the Depot is on the way anyway. Second, you accept Frosthowl, worth 775 XP, in Brewnall on your first pass west and kill it on the second, when you walk past the Grizzled Den anyway. Third, the grind (killing mobs for XP) at the end of this part is on Leper Gnomes, which are yellow at level 8–10, together with Operation Recombobulation for 850 XP, instead of on RestedXP's level 7–8 beasts. Misty Pine and Frosthowl replace most of RestedXP's beast grind. On the Classic XP curve, which Forever keeps, the turn-ins and the kills they need give about 26k of the roughly 29.9k XP to 10.3; the Leper Gnome block covers the rest. Gnomes are the least-played Alliance race at launch, so Coldridge and Kharanos are among the quieter Alliance starts. Data Hoarders is left out because you can only accept it in Ironforge. For comparison, a beta warlock's personal best from 1 to 10 was 1:29 with bugged instant wands, and a relaxed beta warrior took 2:05 to reach 10.
legs.estTime: About 2.0–2.4 h /played: most of it is questing in Coldridge Valley and around Kharanos, with a short Leper Gnome grind at the end.
legs.start: You are level 1 at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Dun Morogh. Your hearthstone is set to Coldridge Valley, the default. You have no quests, no flight paths and no pet.
legs.end: You are level 10.3 at Steelgrill's Depot in Kharanos, 1 minute from the inn. Your hearthstone is set to Thunderbrew Distillery. You trained level 10 at Gimrizz Shadowcog, and your Imp has Blood Pact. You carry three quests: The Reports, for Ironforge; Shimmer Stout, for Mountaineer Barleybrew at the South Gate (Dun Morogh 86.2, 48.8), who then gives you Stout to Kadrell; and A Visitor to Dun Morogh. Camping 101: Cooking is turned in; if it is still in your log, never abandon it. You did not take Data Hoarders, because it starts in Ironforge. You have no flight paths yet.

skipped.name: Data Hoarders
skipped.why: It starts at Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge (ForeverDB; a beta tester asked for it to start in Kharanos instead), but its cards are back near Gnomeregan, around 24–28, 36–44 in Dun Morogh. Taking it in Ironforge means a trip back.

skipped.name: Protecting the Herd
skipped.why: A level 12 quest worth 900 XP: kill Vagash, a level 11 elite yeti (much tougher than a normal mob) at Amberstill Ranch, east of this part. A level 10 paladin in the beta needed every cooldown, but RestedXP's launch guide has every class except hunters kite him (lead him along while you attack) to the ranch guard and do 51% or more of the damage. You pass the ranch again in part 2, which skips it too.

skipped.name: The Quarry's Smith
skipped.why: You need 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides.

skipped.name: Never Saddle on Quality
skipped.why: You need 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts, and their drop rate is unknown.

skipped.name: A New Threat
skipped.why: Low XP, only 170. RestedXP leaves it out for warlocks because the Imp quest takes the same time.

skipped.name: A Refugee's Quandary
skipped.why: 250 XP for three boxes in different corners of the valley. RestedXP leaves it out for warlocks.

skipped.name: Rejold's New Brew
skipped.why: A talk-only quest that only leads you away from the route; guides list it as skippable.

skipped.name: Exploration / flight-path openers
skipped.why: These openers are built around a human start in Elwynn Forest (level 5 in about 36 minutes with no kills) and have no Imp quest, so they are not faster for a gnome. Use one only if Coldridge is too crowded to play.

steps.text: Accept **Dwarven Outfitters** from Sten Stoutarm outside Anvilmar
Kill Ragged Young Wolves until you have about 10 copper of loot; take off your starter clothes
steps.note: Training Immolate costs money at level 1. RestedXP sells the four Acolyte cloth pieces for 4 copper to afford it.

steps.text: Sell the loot and starter clothes to Grundel Harkin inside Anvilmar
Train **Immolate** and accept **Beginnings** from Alamar Grimm upstairs
steps.note: Optional RestedXP trick: use your hearthstone from up here to get back to Coldridge Valley instead of walking out.

steps.text: Kill Ragged Young Wolves for 8 Tough Wolf Meat and reach level 2
Sell junk and buy 15 Refreshing Spring Water from Adlin Pridedrift
steps.note: Water is your mana between pulls until Life Tap at 6.

steps.text: Turn in **Dwarven Outfitters**; accept **Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery** and **Tainted Memorandum**
steps.note: Tainted Memorandum is the gnome warlock letter. It is turned in together with Beginnings.

steps.text: Accept **The Troll Cave** from Grelin Whitebeard on the way to the cave
steps.note: RestedXP has warlocks take this early so whelps killed near the cave already count.

steps.text: Enter the troll cave and kill Frostmane Novices for 3 Feather Charms
steps.note: The cave entrance is at 27.1, 80.7.

steps.text: Deathskip (die on purpose): die in the cave and release to the Coldridge Valley spirit healer
steps.note: Your subzone must say Coldridge Valley when you die, or you respawn in Kharanos. Under level 10 there is no resurrection sickness (the stat penalty after a spirit-healer revive).

steps.text: Turn in **Beginnings** and **Tainted Memorandum** to Alamar Grimm; summon your Imp
steps.note: Keep the Imp for this whole part: pets have little health at launch, so the Voidwalker waits until about 15.6.

steps.text: Turn in **Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery**; accept **The Boar Hunter** and the next **Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery**
Kill 12 Small Crag Boars around Talin
Turn in **The Boar Hunter** to Talin Keeneye
Grind (kill for XP) boars and wolves toward Grelin until you are at least 1,130/1,400 XP into level 3
steps.note: Not optional: 1,130 + 270 XP from the Mail Delivery turn-in is exactly level 4, which Scalding Mornbrew requires. Skip only if you are already past 1,130.

steps.text: Turn in **Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery** to reach level 4; accept **Scalding Mornbrew Delivery** from Nori next to Grelin

npcs.name: Nori Pridedrift
npcs.note: Her spot comes from ForeverDB launch data.

steps.note: Scalding Mornbrew needs level 4. It has a 5-minute timer: run straight to Anvilmar and don't step away from the keyboard.

steps.text: Turn in **Scalding Mornbrew Delivery** to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar; accept **Bring Back the Mug**
Train level 4 (Corruption, Curse of Weakness) at Alamar Grimm
steps.note: If you still carry Tainted Memorandum, turn it in here too.

steps.text: Accept **Grund and Gozwin** from Grund Drokda at the Anvilmar door
steps.note: New Forever quest, worth 410 XP at level 4–5.

steps.text: At the camp in the north-west hills, kill the Snow Leopard Prowler and loot Gozwin's Mechanic's Log
steps.note: The Prowler respawns very fast at launch: grab the log even if someone else is on the cat.

steps.text: Turn in **Bring Back the Mug** to Nori Pridedrift

npcs.name: Nori Pridedrift
npcs.note: Her spot comes from ForeverDB launch data.

steps.note: 450 XP for a walk you make anyway.

steps.text: Kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps south and west of Grelin
Turn in **The Troll Cave**; accept **The Stolen Journal**
Kill Grik'nir the Cold at the back of the troll cave; loot Grelin's journal
Turn in **The Stolen Journal**; accept **Senir's Observations**
Turn in **Grund and Gozwin** to Grund Drokda
steps.note: Reward: Canvas Latchbag, a 6-slot bag.

steps.text: At the tunnel: turn in **Senir's Observations**; accept **Senir's Observations**, **The Adventurer** and **Supplies to Tannok**
steps.note: The Adventurer (new) starts the camping chain in Kharanos.

steps.text: Run through Coldridge Pass, killing Crag Boars; keep every Chunk of Boar Meat and Crag Boar Rib
steps.note: Keep the meat for Stocking Jetsteam and your XP food (cooked meat that adds kill XP); the ribs are for Beer Basted Boar Ribs. Aim for 1,595/2,800 XP into level 5 here, as RestedXP does.

steps.text: Deathskip once out of the tunnel: die and release to the Kharanos spirit healer
steps.note: Make sure your subzone is no longer Coldridge Pass, or you respawn back in the valley.

steps.text: Turn in **The Adventurer**; accept **The Great Outdoors** from Eric Brighthammer
Type /sit at Eric's campfire, wait for Boosted Rest, then type /sit again
steps.note: Launch bug: the sit objective needs the typed /sit, a second time while already seated, and no NPC targeted.

steps.text: Turn in **The Great Outdoors**; accept **Camping 101: Cooking**
steps.note: Never abandon Camping 101: Cooking. An abandoned copy cannot be taken again.

steps.text: Turn in **Senir's Observations**; accept **Secure the Mountain** from Senir Whitebeard
Accept **Beer Basted Boar Ribs** from Ragnar Thunderbrew outside the distillery
In the distillery: turn in **Supplies to Tannok**; accept **Dawn in the Mountains** from Maxan Anvol
steps.note: Dawn in the Mountains opens the Misty Pine quests (all level 8).

steps.text: Train Cooking with Gremlock Pilsnor and turn in **Camping 101: Cooking**
steps.note: It gives 270 XP and unlocks the campfire recipe. Training Cooking costs 1 silver: if you are short, keep the quest for your next Kharanos stop and never abandon it.

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Belm (Thunderbrew Distillery); buy a few Ice Cold Milk if you have money to spare
steps.note: Every deathskip in this part lands you in Kharanos anyway; the bind is for part 2.

steps.text: Train 6 (Life Tap, Shadow Bolt) at Gimrizz Shadowcog; buy the **Grimoire of Blood Pact** from Dannie Fizzwizzle
steps.note: Blood Pact gives you Stamina from the Imp. If money is short, buy the grimoire on the next Kharanos stop.

steps.text: Accept **Tools for Steelgrill** (Tharek Blackstone) and **Flintfire's Shipment** (Tognus Flintfire) at the forge
Steelgrill's Depot: turn in **Tools for Steelgrill**; accept **Stocking Jetsteam**, **The Grizzled Den** and **Ammo for Rumbleshot**
Walk to Gretchen killing boars and Young Black Bears for meat, ribs and 2 Thick Bear Fur
steps.note: Keep 4 meat for Stocking Jetsteam and every extra chunk for XP food.

steps.text: Open the crate next to Mountaineer Gretchen for Rumbleshot's Ammo
Turn in **Secure the Mountain**; accept the next **Secure the Mountain** (find Cornelius)
Grizzled Den: 8 Wendigo Manes, 8 Flintfire's Shipments, and find Mountaineer Cornelius
steps.note: Cornelius' body is at 43.0, 49.5. Mobs in this cave respawn extremely fast at launch: pull one at a time, never rest inside, and leave Frosthowl at 39.6, 48.6 for later.

steps.text: Deathskip: die in the den and release to the Kharanos spirit healer
steps.note: RestedXP does this instead of walking out of the cave.

steps.text: If still missing, kill Young Black Bears south of Kharanos for Thick Bear Fur
Turn in **Flintfire's Shipment** to Tognus Flintfire; repair at Gamili Frosthide beside him
steps.note: 625 XP plus reputation. Each deathskip costs durability, 10% for dying and 25% more for the spirit-healer revive, so repair here if your gear shows yellow.

steps.text: Cook spare boar meat into Roasted Boar Meat at Eric's campfire; eat one before each kill block

items.name: Basic Campfire
items.note: needs Simple Wood + Flint and Tinder; "allows cooking"

steps.note: Well Fed: +5% kill XP for 15 min if you sit for 10 seconds while eating; boar meat cooks at Cooking 1, wolf meat needs 10. If Eric's fire will not cook, buy Simple Wood and Flint and Tinder from Kreg Bilmn and cast Basic Campfire.

steps.text: At the Depot: turn in **The Grizzled Den** and **Stocking Jetsteam**; accept **Evershine**
Follow the road east to Misty Pine Refuge
steps.note: About 1 min from the Depot. Its mobs are level 7–8, so they are yellow (full XP) now and turn green (reduced XP) if you leave this for later.

steps.text: Turn in **Dawn in the Mountains**; accept **Finding Warmth** from Father Gavin
steps.note: Finding Warmth must be done first: Gavin's other quests only appear after it.

steps.text: Loot 14 Mostly Dry Firewood from Fallen Logs around the refuge
steps.note: If logs are taken, more lie south at 56–60, 52–59 and along the road at 50–53, 50–52.

steps.text: Turn in **Finding Warmth**; accept **Rime's Wrath** and **Treacherous Cold**
Kill the Minor Ice Elementals around the refuge as you head south
Loot Sunhammer's Rifle from the fallen mountaineer south-east of the refuge
steps.note: The bodies are hard to see in the fog; go to the exact spot.

steps.text: Loot Stoneanvil's Rifle south of the road
steps.note: The farthest rifle. The beta "no loot" bug was fixed in the dev notes.

steps.text: Head north: loot Coalbeard's Rifle and finish the 10 Minor Ice Elementals
Turn in **Rime's Wrath** and **Treacherous Cold**; accept the second **Rime's Wrath**
Kill Avala just north of the refuge and loot Avala's Core
steps.note: Let the Imp and your damage-over-time spells do the work; Frost Armor punishes melee.

steps.text: Turn in **Rime's Wrath** to Father Gavin
steps.note: 700 XP. Misty Pine is done: walk back west.

steps.text: Passing Kharanos, accept **Operation Recombobulation** (Razzle) and **Frostmane Hold** (Senir Whitebeard)
steps.note: Both need level 7, so Razzle waits until now; he is about a 15-second detour at the north-west edge of town. Also buy the Blood Pact grimoire if you skipped it, and cook more boar meat.

steps.text: Turn in **Secure the Mountain**; accept **Secure the Mountain** (the report for Senir)
Turn in **Ammo for Rumbleshot** to Hegnar Rumbleshot
Accept **Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash** from Tundra MacGrann
steps.note: Done on the second western pass, once you have Fear.

steps.text: In Brewnall, buy Ice Cold Milk from Keeg Gibn if you are low on drinks
Turn in **Evershine**; accept **A Favor for Evershine**, **The Perfect Stout**, **Bitter Rivals** and **Frosthowl**
steps.note: Frosthowl (new, 775 XP) is from Gretta Ganter at 31.4, 44.6.

steps.text: Loop Brewnall for 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars and 8 Snow Leopards; finish the ribs
steps.note: RestedXP's loop: 31.2, 39.2 → 27.9, 45.6 → 29.4, 50.1 → 31.7, 46.8. Eat boar meat first.

steps.text: Turn in **A Favor for Evershine**; accept **Return to Bellowfiz**
steps.note: Return to Bellowfiz, worth 875 XP, stays in your log until the end of this part.

steps.text: Frostmane Hold: kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters and explore the cave, keeping to the left
steps.note: RestedXP's tip: run up the side of the entrance and drop in. The rare mob Great Father Arctikus, level 11, spawns here.

steps.text: Deathskip: die in Frostmane Hold and release to the Kharanos spirit healer
steps.note: Saves the 3-minute walk back east.

steps.text: Turn in **Secure the Mountain** and **Frostmane Hold** to Senir Whitebeard
Buy one Rhapsody Malt and one Thunder Ale from Innkeeper Belm
steps.note: The malt is for Beer Basted Boar Ribs, the ale distracts Jarven.

steps.text: Downstairs: accept and turn in **Distracting Jarven** (hand over the Thunder Ale), then click the barrel for **Bitter Rivals**
steps.note: Jarven offers Distracting Jarven when you talk to him; with the ale in your bags you hand it in at once. The barrel then completes Bitter Rivals and starts Return to Marleth.

steps.text: Train 8 (Bane of Agony, Fear) at Gimrizz Shadowcog
steps.note: You need Fear for Old Icebeard on the next pass.

steps.text: Turn in **Beer Basted Boar Ribs** to Ragnar Thunderbrew; cook more boar meat
In the Grizzled Den, kill Frosthowl in the north-west chamber and loot the Sack of Fish
steps.note: Beta players found Frosthowl hard to tag (hit it first so the kill counts for you), and at launch the den respawns extremely fast. Fear any extra mob that joins.

steps.text: Climb to Shimmer Ridge; kill Frostmane Seers and open Shimmerweed Baskets for 6 Shimmerweed
steps.note: The path up the slope is at 42.9, 45.2. If the south end is busy, more seers and baskets sit at 41–43, 34–37.

steps.text: In Old Icebeard's cave, Fear the yeti and loot MacGrann's Meat Locker
steps.note: RestedXP's warlock trick: Fear him as he comes, loot, and walk out.

steps.text: Turn in **Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash**
steps.note: Level 12 quest, so it pays full XP.

steps.text: Brewnall: turn in **Frosthowl**, **The Perfect Stout** and **Return to Marleth**; accept **Shimmer Stout**

items.name: Frosthowl's Footwarmers
items.note: leather: a warlock cannot wear it, so sell it

steps.note: You carry Shimmer Stout into part 2, for Mountaineer Barleybrew at the South Gate.

steps.text: Leper Gnomes north-west of Brewnall: get 8 Cogs and 8 Gears, then grind to 550 XP into level 10
steps.note: These level 9–10 mobs are yellow, so eat boar meat first. This replaces RestedXP's beast loop, which ends at 4,525/5,400 XP into level 8; you are already past that here.

steps.text: Deathskip: die and release to the Kharanos spirit healer
steps.note: Still free at 10: resurrection sickness starts above level 10 (a Classic rule we assume Forever keeps). The revive only costs durability.

steps.text: Accept **The Reports** from Senir Whitebeard
steps.note: You turn it in to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge in part 2.

steps.text: Train 10 (Drain Soul, Create Healthstone) at Gimrizz Shadowcog
steps.note: Skip the Voidwalker for now: launch pets were cut to 2 HP per Stamina, so it waits for Stormwind at about 15.6.

steps.text: Turn in **Operation Recombobulation** to Razzle Sprysprocket
At the Depot: turn in **Return to Bellowfiz**; accept **A Visitor to Dun Morogh** from Beldin Steelgrill
steps.note: 875 XP. A Visitor to Dun Morogh starts the Hall of Thanes chain in part 2.

steps.text: At Steelgrill's Depot, check you are level 10.3 with your hearth at Thunderbrew Distillery; then head east to Gol'Bolar
steps.note: If you are below 10.3, part 2 makes it up at Gol'Bolar; don't grind more here.

openQuestions: If you want Data Hoarders anyway, it starts at Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge at 68.1, 44.5 (ForeverDB), and a beta tester confirms you can't take it in Kharanos. Its XP is not known yet, so this route also skips it in part 2 rather than going back to Gnomeregan.

If the Leper Gnomes' 8 Cogs and 8 Gears take more than about 15 minutes, abandon Operation Recombobulation and grind the level 8–10 trolls at Frostmane Hold instead. Their drop rates in Forever have not been measured yet.
Not confirmed yet: the XP for Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash, a level 12 quest. Forever has no recorded value, so our estimate assumes about 900.

Not confirmed yet: where the Kharanos spirit healer stands. The deathskips assume it works as in RestedXP's guide, where dying anywhere west of Coldridge Pass respawns you at Kharanos; nobody has confirmed the graveyard's position in a database yet.
Not confirmed yet: whether you can cook Roasted Boar Meat at Eric's Basic Campfire, or whether you need your own Basic Campfire (Simple Wood plus Flint and Tinder).
Not confirmed yet: the levels in this part. They are our estimate from the Classic XP curve, ForeverDB launch quest XP and guessed kill XP, so check them on a real run.

Not confirmed yet: the minimum level for the Misty Pine quests (Finding Warmth, Rime's Wrath, Treacherous Cold). Other new level 8 Dun Morogh quests, Dawn in the Mountains and Secure the Mountain, could be taken at level 5 (ForeverDB), so arriving at 7.1 should work. If Father Gavin offers nothing, play the Brewnall loop first and do Misty Pine on the way east in part 2.

Not confirmed yet: the minimum levels ForeverDB shows (Scalding Mornbrew 4, Operation Recombobulation 7, Frostmane Hold 7, Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash 7, Shimmer Stout 8) come from Classic data. RestedXP's launch guide still makes you reach 1,130/1,400 XP before Scalding Mornbrew, which suggests they hold in Forever.
Not confirmed yet: the Forever XP for Distracting Jarven. ForeverDB has no page for it; in Classic it was small.

Not confirmed yet: the durability cost of the five deathskips. In Classic you lose 10% per death plus 25% more for being revived at a spirit healer; nobody has reported whether low-level Forever characters are exempt.

legs.title: Gol'Bolar, Loch Modan, Hall of Thanes, Voidwalker & Westfall
legs.summary: You finish east Dun Morogh and the quest chain that leads to the Hall of Thanes, a dungeon reached from Old Ironforge, then quest in west Loch Modan with a quick flight to Ironforge at 12 to train Shadow Bolt rank 3. At 14 you fly back to Ironforge for one Hall of Thanes run with all five of its quests. Then you take the tram to Stormwind, get your Voidwalker by way of Brackwell and Lakeshire (for its flight path), set your hearthstone in Stormwind and quest in Westfall from Sentinel Hill.
legs.why: You go to Loch Modan instead of taking RestedXP's trip through Stormwind and Elwynn at 11 because the Nov 2 pet nerf made the Voidwalker weak, at 250–395 HP, so its class quest waits until you pass Stormwind anyway. You run the Hall of Thanes straight from Loch Modan: its five quests pay about 13,300 XP (warcraft.wiki.gg values), all need only level 9–10, and its mobs give little XP at launch ('3 bars' for a full clear), so one run with every quest is the whole point. Loch Modan follows RestedXP's 12–14 route, kept up to date since launch, with two changes. First, at 12.05 you set your hearthstone in Thelsamar, fly to Ironforge, train level 12 and hearth back: Shadow Bolt rank 3 hits for 40–46 instead of 22–27, and the trip also pays Return to Brock for 1,050 XP. Second, your grind stop (killing mobs for XP until a target) sits at the mouth of Stonesplinter Valley, where In Defense of the King's Lands step 2, worth 1,050 XP at launch on ForeverDB, pays for the same Skullthumpers and Seers. The bunker, that grind spot and the Snowbound snow patch are all within a minute of each other. Stormwind, Elwynn and Lakeshire are one loop that collects three flight paths, the level 14 spells at the Slaughtered Lamb and the Voidwalker without a separate trip. Westfall is done in three loops, in the order its quests unlock: Toxic Soil step 3 needs steps 1–2, step 4 needs step 3, and The People's Militia step 3 needs step 2. The People's Militia steps 2–3 and Keeper of the Flame are added to replace part of the grind. Stopping the Toxic Soil chain at Moonbrook Espionage avoids the Rough Dynamite and the Stormwind detour.
legs.estTime: About 6.3–7.3 h /played: mostly questing in Loch Modan and Westfall plus one Hall of Thanes run, with about an hour of grinding in Westfall to reach 18.3.
legs.start: You are level 10.3 at Steelgrill's Depot in Kharanos. Your hearthstone is set to Thunderbrew Distillery. You trained level 10, and your Imp has Blood Pact. You carry A Visitor to Dun Morogh, Shimmer Stout (it becomes Stout to Kadrell at South Gate Pass) and The Reports. You have no flight paths yet.
legs.end: You are level 18.3 at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Your hearthstone is set to Stormwind; you set it there at about 15.4, replacing the Thelsamar bind from 12.05. You have the Imp and the Voidwalker. You trained level 12 in Ironforge at 12.1 and level 14 at the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind. You reach 16 (Life Tap rank 2, Unending Breath) in Westfall with no trainer on the way, so train 16 and 18 together at part 3's Stormwind stop. Flight paths: Thelsamar, Ironforge, Stormwind, Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill. You carry The Defias Brotherhood (for Wiley in Lakeshire), Oh Brother..., Collecting Memories, Underground Assault and, if you took it, Humble Beginnings with the compass looted. Red Silk Bandanas is not available yet: it opens after the Defias Traitor escort in The Defias Brotherhood chain. Done: all five Hall of Thanes quests, Toxic Soil up to Moonbrook Espionage, The People's Militia 1–3, Keeper of the Flame, Encroaching Gnolls (handed in on the Lakeshire walk), and Harvesting the Harvesters only if the drops came.

skipped.name: RestedXP's Stormwind/Elwynn swing at 11
skipped.why: The Voidwalker is weak after the Nov 2 pet nerf, and you pick up these flight paths at 15.3 anyway.

skipped.name: Protecting the Herd
skipped.why: Vagash is a level 11 elite (much tougher than a normal mob), and at 10 you only have the Imp.

skipped.name: Data Hoarders
skipped.why: You didn't take it in part 1 because it starts in Ironforge, and its 7 cards are back near Gnomeregan.

skipped.name: Excavation Tools
skipped.why: A level 18 quest (ForeverDB) at Ironband's Excavation: a south-east detour that nobody has reported playing yet.

skipped.name: Excavation Progress Report / Report to Ironforge
skipped.why: 270 + 540 XP for a 4-minute run each way to the excavation.

skipped.name: Bingles' Missing Supplies
skipped.why: A detour to east Loch Modan.

skipped.name: A Hunter's Boast
skipped.why: It starts at the Farstrider Lodge in east Loch Modan and has a 15-minute timer.

skipped.name: Resupplying the Excavation
skipped.why: Only 270 XP, and it starts an ambush chain toward the excavation.

skipped.name: Elwynn Forest quests and Hogger
skipped.why: These quests are grey (too low to give much XP) at 15, and Hogger is an elite whose quest drop goes to only one player per kill.

skipped.name: Explosive Consultation and the rest of Toxic Soil
skipped.why: Step 6 of the chain needs 10 Rough Dynamite and a detour to Stormwind.

skipped.name: Harvesting the Harvesters step 3
skipped.why: It needs Engineering (per Questie's Forever data) and a crafted Crude Scope.

skipped.name: My First Alchemy Set
skipped.why: It needs vials and herbs.

skipped.name: The Coast Isn't Clear
skipped.why: The murloc types it needs are spread from the north coast to the lighthouse.

skipped.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
skipped.why: Four stops along the coast for 580 XP per step.

skipped.name: ... and that note you found (Cozy Sleeping Bag chain)
skipped.why: The chain runs through the Horde-held Barrens and through Stonetalon.

skipped.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
skipped.why: RestedXP's dungeon version runs it at 18–19, and its Alliance quests were broken at launch.

skipped.name: In Defense of the King's Lands (part 3)
skipped.why: It needs 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Bonesnappers, level 15–16, deep in the valley while you are 13.3; the next quest in the chain is level 17.

skipped.name: Harvesting the Harvesters step 2
skipped.why: It needs Engineering (per Questie's Forever data).

skipped.name: Crocolisk Hunting
skipped.why: It starts at the Farstrider Lodge in east Loch Modan, off the route.

steps.text: Before leaving Kharanos: keep cooked boar meat in your bags and eat it before every kill block
steps.note: Cooked food gives +5% kill XP for 15 min; boar meat works from Cooking 1. Never abandon Camping 101: Cooking if it is still in your log.

steps.text: Run east on the road past Amberstill Ranch to Earthseer Farsen's camp above Gol'Bolar Quarry
steps.note: Skip Protecting the Herd: Vagash is a level 11 elite (much tougher than a normal mob) and you only have the Imp. Kill boars on the road for XP food.

steps.text: Turn in **A Visitor to Dun Morogh**; accept **Farsen's Watch** from Earthseer Farsen
steps.note: 675 XP each at launch (ForeverDB). This chain opens the final Hall of Thanes quest.

steps.text: Use Farsen's Far Sight (talk to him), then turn in **Farsen's Watch**; accept **Nip 'Em in the Bud**
At the quarry, accept **The Public Servant** and **Those Blasted Troggs!**
Kill 6 Rockjaw Skullthumpers around the quarry pit; loot any **Empty Powder Keg** and use it

items.name: Empty Powder Keg
items.note: low drop rate; it starts the Stolen Blasting Powder pair

steps.text: Enter the quarry mine and kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers
Turn in **The Public Servant** and **Those Blasted Troggs!**; if you found the keg, turn it in to Thesten
steps.note: 660 + 590 XP (Classic values); the keg pair paid 85 + 850 at launch (ForeverDB). No keg after the quarry troggs: skip the pair.

steps.text: If on **Stolen Blasting Powder**, kill Rockjaw Ambushers east of the quarry for 16 powder
Kill 10 Dark Iron Spies at Ironband's Compound; use the **Dark Iron Map** when it drops

items.name: Dark Iron Map
items.note: quest starter; keep killing spies until it drops

steps.text: Turn in **Stolen Blasting Powder** to Quarrymaster Thesten
Back at Farsen: turn in **Nip 'Em in the Bud** and **Underground Map**; accept **Old Ironforge Incursion**
steps.note: 900 + 1,050 XP at launch (ForeverDB). Keep Old Ironforge Incursion for the Hall of Thanes; King Magni pays 3,200 XP for it.

steps.text: Follow the road east to South Gate Pass: turn in **Shimmer Stout**; accept **Stout to Kadrell**
steps.note: You bring Shimmer Stout from part 1; if you already hold Stout to Kadrell, skip this.

steps.text: Run 1 min north to Pilot Hammerfoot; accept **The Lost Pilot**
Click the Dwarven Corpse: turn in **The Lost Pilot**; accept **A Pilot's Revenge**
Kill Mangeclaw next to the corpse and loot the **Mangy Claw**
Turn in **A Pilot's Revenge** to Pilot Hammerfoot
steps.note: 420 + 660 XP for a 4-minute side trip (Classic values).

steps.text: Go back to Barleybrew and through the South Gate Pass tunnel into Loch Modan
steps.note: Note the snowy patch just outside the tunnel at 19.6, 63.1: you come back here with the Snowbound jar later.

steps.text: Valley of Kings bunker: accept **In Defense of the King's Lands** and **The Trogg Threat** (top floor)

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
Banner of the Fallen
quests.note: only if Captain Rugelfuss offers it

steps.note: Banner of the Fallen is in the Forever database but no launch guide routes it; take it only if offered.

steps.text: Kill Elder Black Bears and Forest Lurkers around the bunker for 3 Bear Meat and 3 Spider Ichor
steps.note: These are normal crafting drops, so they count for Thelsamar Blood Sausages before you accept it.

steps.text: Walk north toward Thelsamar; at the trogg camps kill 10 Troggs and 10 Scouts, loot 8 Stone Teeth

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands

steps.note: RestedXP warns that the camp at 26.7, 56.9 respawns extremely fast. Since Oct 1, troggs here respawn a little slower.

steps.text: Thelsamar: find Mountaineer Kadrell on the road; turn in **Stout to Kadrell**, accept **Rat Catching** and **Mountaineer Stormpike's Task**
Accept **Thelsamar Blood Sausages** (inn), **Snowbound** (Grenhild) and **Honor Students** (Brock)

items.name: Ceramic Jar
items.note: Snowbound's quest item: scoop snow at South Gate Pass

steps.note: Set your hearthstone here next: you hearth back from Ironforge in a few minutes.

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Hearthstove in the Stoutlager Inn
steps.note: Your hearthstone has not been used since part 1, so it is ready. RestedXP sets it here too.

steps.text: Learn the Thelsamar flight path; turn in **Honor Students**, accept **Ride to Ironforge**
steps.note: Fly to Ironforge right away (next step), not at the end of Loch Modan.

steps.text: Fly from Thelsamar to Ironforge now to train level 12 and finish the flight quests
steps.note: Shadow Bolt rank 3 (level 12) hits for 40–46 instead of 22–27, and you fight for another hour in Loch Modan. There is no warlock trainer in Thelsamar.

steps.text: Turn in **Ride to Ironforge** to Golnir Bouldertoe; accept **Gryth Thurden**
Forlorn Cavern: train level 12 at Briarthorn (Shadow Bolt rank 3, Health Funnel, Curse of Weakness rank 2)
steps.note: The Forlorn Cavern is just north of Golnir. Level 14 is trained later at the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, which the route visits anyway.

steps.text: Turn in **Gryth Thurden** at the gryphon master; accept **Return to Brock**
steps.note: Leave The Reports for the next visit: Senator Barin stands on the way to the Hall of Thanes.

steps.text: Hearth to Thelsamar
steps.note: Faster than the gryphon the quest text suggests; Return to Brock only needs the picks delivered.

steps.text: Turn in **Return to Brock** to Brock Stoneseeker next to the inn
steps.note: 1,050 XP (Classic value; no launch figure yet). RestedXP routes the same turn-in.

steps.text: Bunker: turn in **In Defense of the King's Lands** and **The Trogg Threat**; accept step 2 from Gravelgaw

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
In Defense of the King's Lands

steps.note: 900 XP each at launch (ForeverDB). Step 2 wants the Skullthumpers and Seers you grind next anyway.

steps.text: Stonesplinter Valley mouth: kill 10 Skullthumpers and 10 Seers, then keep grinding them until 13.26
steps.note: You would grind here anyway, but now you also get 1,050 quest XP (seen at launch). Eat XP food; it takes about 30 minutes.

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands

steps.text: Optional, only with **Banner of the Fallen**: plant the banner in the trogg cave and kill Headsplitter
steps.note: It is a level 17 quest (ForeverDB). Do it only with a group or if you feel comfortable; otherwise abandon it.

steps.text: Bunker: turn in **In Defense of the King's Lands** step 2 to Gravelgaw, and **Banner of the Fallen** if done

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
Banner of the Fallen
quests.note: only if you did it, to Captain Rugelfuss

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands

npcs.name: Captain Rugelfuss
npcs.role: Banner of the Fallen turn-in (top floor)

steps.note: 1,050 XP at launch (ForeverDB). Skip step 3: its level 15–16 troggs sit deep in the valley.

steps.text: On the snowy patch outside the South Gate tunnel, use the **Ceramic Jar** to get a Jar of Snow
steps.note: The Jar of Snow expires after 10 minutes. Go straight north from here and fight as little as possible.

steps.text: Run north up the west road to Algaz Station: turn in **Mountaineer Stormpike's Task**; accept **Stormpike's Order** and **Filthy Paws**

npcs.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
npcs.role: quest giver (top floor of the bunker)

steps.note: About 2 minutes from the snowy patch. You turn in Stormpike's Order in Stormwind for 980 XP.

steps.text: Hurry east to Norric Lochthane's house and turn in **Snowbound** before the jar melts
Silver Stream Mine: loot 4 Miners' Gear from the crates; kill Tunnel Rat Diggers and Geomancers for ears
Back at Algaz Station, turn in **Filthy Paws**
steps.note: 1,350 XP, the biggest Classic turn-in in Loch Modan.

steps.text: Walk south killing Mountain Boars for 3 Boar Intestines, and Tunnel Rat Vermin and Foragers for the last ears
Thelsamar: turn in **Rat Catching** (Kadrell) and **Thelsamar Blood Sausages** (Vidra)
Swim into the loch and click the **Discarded Fishing Toolbox** on the floor; accept **Silver of the Waves**
steps.note: The box moves between several spots, so look for the quest marker on the minimap. Watch for high-level Young Threshadons.

steps.text: Turn in **Silver of the Waves** to Khara Deepwater on the shore north of Thelsamar

npcs.name: Khara Deepwater
npcs.role: quest turn-in ('K.D.' on the hair clip)

steps.note: Reward: Repurposed Hair Band (cloth wrist, Int/Spirit).

steps.text: Fly from Thelsamar to Ironforge for the Hall of Thanes
steps.note: Aim to land at about 14.0. If you are well short, kill Tunnel Rat Foragers at 26, 43 first.

steps.text: Walk to the High Seat: turn in **The Reports** to Senator Barin Redstone by the throne
Auction house: buy a **Greater Magic Wand** (requires 13); fallback **Smoldering Wand** (requires 15)
steps.note: Since the Oct 15 change you must stand still for 0.5 seconds before each wand shot, so don't kite (move away while attacking) with it.

steps.text: Look for a Hall of Thanes group; accept **The Restless Dead** and **Important Heirlooms** below Magni's room
steps.note: Both need only level 10 (warcraft.wiki.gg). A beta group of level 13–15 players cleared it, entering at 14.5.

steps.text: Enter the Hall of Thanes; in room 2 accept **An Ancient Grudge** from the Ghostly Attendant
steps.note: Carry in Old Ironforge Incursion, The Restless Dead and Important Heirlooms. The 5th quest is the tablet at the end.

steps.text: Kill Faldrim Anvilmar (first boss) and turn in **An Ancient Grudge** to the Ghostly Attendant
steps.note: 2,300 XP. Turn it in now so you don't have to walk back.

steps.text: Finish 15 Enraged Apparitions and 10 Tormented Souls; loot Dwarven Heirlooms from candle-lit platforms
steps.note: Finish the ghosts in the early rooms; RestedXP warns you may not get another chance. Heirlooms are plentiful near the end.

steps.text: Kill Durgen Dirgehammer, loot his head; open the vault behind him and take **The Treaty of Understanding**
steps.note: The tablet is the 'hidden 5k XP' quest guides mention; it is worth 2,550 XP at Magni.

steps.text: Exit by running straight down the corridor from the final boss room into Ironforge
steps.note: A launch full clear gave about 3 bars of mob XP; the value is in the 5 quests. Never run it a second time.

steps.text: Turn in **Important Heirlooms** (Thom Filch) and **The Restless Dead** (Afadra Dunwall)
steps.note: 2,950 + 2,300 XP. Rewards include Dwarven Tome (off-hand) and Cryptwalker Bracers.

steps.text: Turn in **Old Ironforge Incursion** and **The Treaty of Understanding** to King Magni
steps.note: 3,200 + 2,550 XP. Take Deepblaze from Old Ironforge Incursion if it beats your weapon.

steps.text: Enter the Deeprun Tram from Tinker Town; accept **Deeprun Rat Roundup** from Monty
Use the Rat Catcher's Flute on 5 Deeprun Rats; turn in **Deeprun Rat Roundup** and accept **Me Brother, Nipsy**
steps.note: 910 XP for about 2 minutes.

steps.text: Ride the tram to Stormwind; turn in **Me Brother, Nipsy** on the Stormwind platform
Dwarven District: turn in **Stormpike's Order** to Furen Longbeard
steps.note: Stormwind coordinates here use the Forever map, not the Classic one.

steps.text: Accept the Deadmines quests **Oh Brother...**, **Collecting Memories** and **Underground Assault**
steps.note: They need level 15; Collecting Memories needs 14. Carry them to the Deadmines in part 3.

steps.text: Optional: accept **Humble Beginnings** from Baros Alexston in Cathedral Square
steps.note: The compass is in Westfall next to the Gold Coast loop; turn the quest in at part 3's Stormwind stop for 1,050 XP.

steps.text: Slaughtered Lamb basement (Mage Quarter): accept **Surena Caledon** from Gakin the Darkbinder
steps.note: RestedXP accepts it directly from Gakin; the lead-in quest from Ironforge is not needed.

steps.text: Train level 14 from Ursula Deline: Drain Life, Corruption rank 2, Curse of Recklessness
steps.note: Same room as Gakin, so no detour. Skip the Voidwalker grimoires: launch Voidwalkers are too weak to pay for them.

steps.text: Learn the Stormwind flight path at Dungar Longdrink, then leave the city by the main gate
Follow the road east past Goldshire to the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch
steps.note: Elwynn's quests are grey (too low to give much XP) for you; don't stop for them.

steps.text: Kill Surena Caledon and loot **Surena's Choker**; Fear Morgan the Collector if he joins
steps.note: The choker is not a guaranteed drop; wait for her respawn if it is missing.

steps.text: Continue east into Redridge; accept **Encroaching Gnolls** from Guard Parker at Three Corners
steps.note: Redridge coordinates use the redrawn Forever map, about 4–5 lower in x than Classic.

steps.text: Lakeshire: turn in **Encroaching Gnolls** to Deputy Feldon
steps.note: Free 290 XP on the walk; the road has level 15–18 gnolls and murlocs, so stay on it.

steps.text: Learn the Lakeshire flight path and fly to Stormwind
steps.note: This is the reason for walking: part 3 starts with a flight from Sentinel Hill to Lakeshire.

steps.text: Turn in **Surena Caledon** to Gakin; accept **The Binding**
At the summoning circle downstairs, use the **Bloodstone Choker** and defeat the Summoned Voidwalker
Turn in **The Binding**; you can now summon a Voidwalker
steps.note: Launch Voidwalkers have only 250–395 HP after the Nov 2 pet nerf; keep questing with the Imp.

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Allison in the Trade District
steps.note: Level 16 (Life Tap rank 2, Unending Breath) comes in Westfall, away from trainers. Train 16 and 18 together at part 3's Stormwind stop.

steps.text: Leave by the main gate and run west past Goldshire into Westfall
steps.note: Optional RestedXP trick: first Life Tap to low health in the Slaughtered Lamb and deathskip (die on purpose to respawn at the spirit healer).

steps.text: Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm roadside: accept **The Forgotten Heirloom**, **Westfall Stew** and **Poor Old Blanchy**
Saldean's Farm: accept **The Killing Fields**; turn in **Westfall Stew**, accept **Westfall Stew** and **Goretusk Liver Pie**
Optional: accept **Harvesting the Harvesters** from Ozwin Ironsprocket in the barn
steps.note: 800 XP at launch (ForeverDB), but RestedXP's launch guide skips it: 'over 50 kills' for 14 Isosprings. Finish it only if the drops come.

steps.text: Sentinel Hill: accept **The People's Militia**, **Patrolling Westfall** and **Red Leather Bandanas**
steps.note: RestedXP skips Patrolling Westfall; this route keeps it only because the gnolls sit on your path.

steps.text: Accept **Testing the Wells** and **Murloc Gills** from Alba Fairmoon; learn the Sentinel Hill flight path
steps.note: The Toxic Soil quests pay little, 460 XP each, but their objectives overlap the usual Classic Westfall loop.

steps.text: Go north-west to Molsen Farm; use the Well Water Sample Kit on the well
steps.note: Start on the Defias around the farm: they count for The People's Militia and drop Red Leather Bandanas.

steps.text: Loop the fields: 20 Harvest Watchers, 3 Okra, 5 Flasks of Oil; Young Goretusks for 8 livers and 3 snouts

items.name: Flask of Oil
items.note: keep 5 for Keeper of the Flame at the lighthouse

items.name: Sack of Oats
items.note: open sacks by fences for Poor Old Blanchy

steps.note: Flasks of Oil are normal drops, so collect them now and hand in Keeper of the Flame later in one visit.

steps.text: Clear Defias Trappers and Smugglers north of the fields: 15 + 15 kills and 15 Red Leather Bandanas
steps.note: If other players camp the spawns in the north, as they did at launch, finish these at the respawn camp near 48.4, 46.7 instead.

steps.text: Furlbrow's farmhouse: loot the pocket watch from **Furlbrow's Wardrobe**
steps.note: Beware Benny Blanco. The watch respawn was changed in beta; if it is gone and players wait, skip this quest.

steps.text: Kill north-coast murlocs for 7 Longshore Murloc Gills and 3 Murloc Eyes, and Riverpaw Gnolls on the way for paws
Jansen Stead: sample the well; open Sacks of Oats around the farms until you have 8
steps.note: Doing the coast first saves a backtrack: Jansen Stead sits next to the Furlbrows.

steps.text: Turn in **The Forgotten Heirloom** and **Poor Old Blanchy** at the Furlbrows
Saldean's Farm: turn in **The Killing Fields**, **Westfall Stew** and **Goretusk Liver Pie**

items.name: Goretusk Liver Pie
items.note: XP food for the grind blocks

steps.text: Optional: turn in **Harvesting the Harvesters**; skip step 2 unless you are an engineer
steps.note: Questie's Forever data lists Engineering for steps 2 and 3, so a non-engineer stops after step 1.

steps.text: Sentinel Hill: turn in **The People's Militia**, **Red Leather Bandanas**, **Testing the Wells** and **Murloc Gills**
steps.note: 900 + 1,050 + 460 + 460 XP at launch (ForeverDB).

steps.text: Accept **The People's Militia** step 2, **The Defias Brotherhood** and **The State of the Mines**
steps.note: The Defias Brotherhood goes to Wiley in Lakeshire at the start of part 3. The State of the Mines needs both earlier Alba quests done.

steps.text: Jangolode Mine: kill 4 Kobold Diggers at the entrance; finish Gnoll Paws on the gnolls next to it
Gold Coast Quarry: 6 Riverpaw Miners, plus 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Looters for the Militia
steps.note: Both quests share this camp, so it is the best kill spot in the zone for this part.

steps.text: Optional: on the way back, loot **A Simple Compass** from Alexston's Chest behind the burnt house
steps.note: Loot it from the back by the chimney to avoid the Defias in front.

steps.text: Sentinel Hill: turn in **The State of the Mines**, **The People's Militia** and **Patrolling Westfall**
steps.note: 490 + 975 + 975 XP at launch (ForeverDB).

steps.text: Accept **Moonbrook Espionage** (Alba) and **The People's Militia** step 3 (Gryan)
Moonbrook: loot 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies (glowing tool chests) in the houses and the forge
steps.note: If the houses are empty, more chests sit in the cave toward the Deadmines entrance.

steps.text: Dagger Hills: kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Pathstalkers and 5 Knuckledusters
steps.note: These mobs are your level, so they give full XP, and step 3 pays 1,600 XP (Classic value).

steps.text: Westfall Lighthouse: accept and turn in **Keeper of the Flame** with your 5 Flasks of Oil
steps.note: 1,150 XP for a 1-minute detour. Skip his follow-ups: The Coast Isn't Clear spans the whole coast.

steps.text: Grind Defias Highwaymen and Knuckledusters in the Dagger Hills until 18.2
steps.note: Our estimate needs about 17,000 XP here: roughly 130 kills, 60–80 min. Eat Goretusk Liver Pie; rested XP (bonus XP you build up while logged out, fastest at an inn) shortens it.

steps.text: Return to Sentinel Hill: turn in **Moonbrook Espionage** and **The People's Militia** step 3
steps.note: Stop the Toxic Soil chain here: the next steps need 10 Rough Dynamite and a Stormwind trip.

steps.text: At Sentinel Hill, check you are level 18.3; part 3 starts by flying to Lakeshire for **The Defias Brotherhood**
steps.note: Your hearth is in Stormwind and you have the Imp and Voidwalker. Flight paths: Thelsamar, Ironforge, Stormwind, Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill.

openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: whether you need the Westfall grind. Our estimate (Classic quest XP from Questie's data plus guessed kill XP) has the quests end at about 17.25 after the lighthouse, so reaching 18.3 takes about 17,000 XP of grinding, 60–80 minutes; the early Ironforge trip doesn't shorten it, because it only replaces Loch Modan grinding. If you'd rather not grind, end part 2 at about 17.3 and start part 3's first Redridge pass (its quests are level 15–18) instead.

Not confirmed yet: whether Harvesting the Harvesters is worth it. RestedXP's launch guide skips step 1 (its drop rate is 'beyond dreadful, over 50 kills'), and Questie's Forever data lists Engineering 1 for step 2, so a non-engineer stops after step 1.

Not confirmed yet: whether Banner of the Fallen and Excavation Tools are worth doing. No launch player or guide routes them; ForeverDB lists them as level 17 and 18 quests, and Headsplitter is level 15–17 in a cave.

Not confirmed yet: the exact spots of Grenhild Darktalon, who gives Snowbound, and Norric Lochthane, who takes it. Wowhead doesn't list them yet, so their coordinates come from RestedXP's launch guide.

Not confirmed yet: the Forever XP for Snowbound, Silver of the Waves, Banner of the Fallen, Return to Brock (we assume the Classic 1,050), Moonbrook Espionage and The People's Militia step 3. ForeverDB has launch XP for the other Dun Morogh and Westfall quests here; the Stolen Blasting Powder pair paid 85 + 850.
If players are waiting at the wardrobe for The Forgotten Heirloom, skip it. The Oct 1 notes say the watch's 'respawn rate' was 'significantly reduced', which could mean slower or faster.
If many warlocks are camping Surena Caledon, expect a wait: her choker drops only 38% of the time (Wowhead).
If you compare with RestedXP, its Stormwind coordinates are Classic-map values. This guide uses the Forever map values from Questie's converted data, which match Wowhead's second set of coordinates.

If launch groups at 14 wipe in the Hall of Thanes, do Westfall first and take the tram back at about 17. RestedXP's launch dungeon guide runs it at 17–18, and its Loch Modan guide says to skip the trogg grind if you will run the dungeon later. This route goes in at 14.0 straight from Loch Modan because a beta group of level 13–15 players cleared it, and all five quests need only level 9–10 (warcraft.wiki.gg); enter higher only if your group asks for it.

Not confirmed yet: how long the early Ironforge trip takes. Our estimate is one flight (about 2 minutes) plus about 1 minute of walking and the hearth. It pays 1,050 XP for Return to Brock, removes about 2,000 XP of grinding and gives you Shadow Bolt rank 3 for the Loch Modan fights.

legs.title: Defias chain, Deadmines & Redridge
legs.summary: You follow The Defias Brotherhood quest chain between Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill and Stormwind, doing Redridge's easy quests on the way, and run the Deadmines dungeon once at about 19.7 with all five of its quests. After the Stormwind hand-ins and your level-20 spells, you clear Redridge's level 20–25 quests in an east loop and a north loop, with one gnoll grind of about 70 minutes (killing mobs for XP until a target level) in Galardell Valley. You finish by walking to Darkshire in Duskwood at about 22.45 to learn its flight path.
legs.why: The Defias Brotherhood chain sets the order: Wiley in Lakeshire, Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill, Mathias Shaw in Stormwind, back to Gryan, then the Deadmines. Two cheap additions ride on it. First, you walk from Stormwind to Redridge through Goldshire instead of flying, as RestedXP's launch speed route does: that hands in The Price of Shoes, which opens Underbelly Scales, A Baying of Gnolls and Howling in the Hills, and passes Guard Parker. Second, the Messenger errands use stops you make anyway and are needed for Messenger to Darkshire. You do Redridge's level 15–20 quests on the two Lakeshire stops before the run, while they still pay full XP, so you enter the Deadmines at about 19.7, the level RestedXP's launch dungeon route uses. The Deadmines is the busiest dungeon at launch, and its five quests pay about 15,750 XP in Forever, about three quarters of a level at 19 (Method counts 18,450 XP for six quests, one of which this route skips; one beta player measured 99% of a level at 18). The level 20–25 Redridge quests follow in two loops that never backtrack: east (Alther's Mill, Galardell Valley, Render's Valley) and north (Yowler, Rethban Caverns). Launch players' addon data on ForeverDB shows Redridge quests paying their Classic amounts, for example 2,000 XP for Blackrock Bounty and 1,850 for Solomon's Law. Two cheap quests are in because they sit on your path: An Unwelcome Guest (Bellygrub is a normal level-24 boar at Lakeshire's west edge) and Missing In Action (Keeshan waits in the cave where you kill the Champions). Redridge's quests still fall about 19,000 XP short, so you grind about 115 of the Shadowhide gnolls you already kill for Solomon's Law. The part then ends at about 22.45 instead of grinding Rethban orcs for almost two more hours (about 190 kills) to 23.5: part 4 makes up that XP with the Stockade quests, which pay about twice their Classic XP at launch (What Comes Around… paid 4,200 against Classic's 2,000). Starting Duskwood a level lower costs little, because most of its first quests are level 24–26, still only yellow or orange to you (2–4 levels above you). Every coordinate here uses Forever's maps: Redridge is re-cut, so its x values are about 5 lower than in Classic guides, and Stormwind uses its harbor-era map.
legs.estTime: About 5.5–6.5 h /played: about 4.9 h of questing, travel and one Deadmines run including the wait for a group, plus about 115 gnoll kills, roughly 70 minutes at 100 kills an hour.
legs.start: Level 18.3 at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Your hearthstone is set to Stormwind (since about 15.4) and you have the Imp and the Voidwalker. You trained level 12 in Ironforge and 14 in Stormwind; train 16 and 18 together at this part's first Stormwind stop. Flight paths: Thelsamar, Ironforge, Stormwind, Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill. You carry The Defias Brotherhood (for Wiley in Lakeshire), Oh Brother…, Collecting Memories, Underground Assault and, if you took it, Humble Beginnings with the compass looted. Red Silk Bandanas opens later, after you escort the Defias Traitor (walk with him and protect him until he reaches his goal). Done: all five Hall of Thanes quests, Toxic Soil up to Moonbrook Espionage, The People's Militia 1–3, Keeper of the Flame, Encroaching Gnolls, and Harvesting the Harvesters only if its drops came.
legs.end: Level about 22.45 in Darkshire (Duskwood), with the Darkshire flight path learned. Your hearthstone is set to Stormwind, you have the Imp and the Voidwalker, and you trained 16, 18 and 20 in Stormwind. You carry Messenger to Darkshire (for Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire), What Comes Around… (a Stockade quest, handed back to Guard Berton in Lakeshire) and Bazil Thredd (for Warden Thelwater at the Stockade). Done: the Defias chain, the five Deadmines quests, The Unsent Letter, the Messenger errands up to Messenger to Westfall, An Unwelcome Guest, Missing In Action and every Redridge quest except the skips below. WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore is done only if a group helped you; if not, abandon it.

skipped.name: Tharil'zun
skipped.why: A level-25 quest to kill a level-24 elite (much tougher than a normal mob) at Stonewatch Keep. Since the Nov 2 pet changes your Voidwalker can't hold him.

skipped.name: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im
skipped.why: A group quest in a Render's Valley cave: RestedXP marks it for 4 players. On Nov 5 the cave had a phasing bug that dropped players into a fully respawned copy. It pays 2,550 XP at launch.

skipped.name: Shadow Magic
skipped.why: Its Midnight Orbs drop from Blackrock Shadowcasters, level 22–23 elites inside Stonewatch Keep.

skipped.name: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg
skipped.why: A level-26 elite in Stonewatch Keep: group only.

skipped.name: A Watchful Eye
skipped.why: It needs level 20 at Theocritus in the Tower of Azora (Elwynn), and you walk past at 18.6. Its follow-up, Looking Further, puts a glyph on a watch tower among Stonewatch elites.

skipped.name: Morganth
skipped.why: A level-27 elite at the Tower of Ilgalar.

skipped.name: Shipping Label
skipped.why: A delivery to the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub, part of the trading system rather than leveling; ForeverDB lists it at level 60.

skipped.name: Sign Me Up!
skipped.why: An advertising-license errand for Elaine Compton, part of the trading and crafting side of the game rather than leveling.

skipped.name: Destruction in Deadmines
skipped.why: It needs the later Toxic Soil steps, 10 Rough Dynamite and a Stormwind detour, which part 2 skips. The same goes for its second part.

skipped.name: Dry Times
skipped.why: It needs four drinks sold in three different zones.

skipped.name: Theocritus' Retrieval
skipped.why: It starts from a rare pendant drop and is handed in at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn.

skipped.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
skipped.why: A treasure-map chain along the whole Westfall coast: long walks for little XP.

skipped.name: Devourer of Souls
skipped.why: The Succubus quest. This route skips it because it sends you to Takar the Seer in the Barrens and on through Ashenvale.

skipped.name: Songblade Search
skipped.why: A level-31 lead-in to the Excavation Site in part 5, and you don't come back to Lakeshire then.

skipped.name: Darkshore, Wailing Caverns, Ruins of Lordaeron
skipped.why: Boat trips far from this part's path, and the Alliance Ruins of Lordaeron quests were bugged at launch.

skipped.name: ... and that note you found
skipped.why: A new level-22 Westfall quest that RestedXP's launch Deadmines route picks up from Burned-Out Remains near the lighthouse road. Nobody has logged its hand-in or XP yet, so it stays out until someone maps it.

skipped.name: Rethban Ore (Brother Kristoff's chain)
skipped.why: A five-step chain worth about 4,100 XP at Classic rates that needs two walks to Brother Paxton in Northshire Abbey, plus stops in the Cathedral and the Royal Library. That travel costs more time than the XP is worth.

steps.text: Fly from Thor at Sentinel Hill to Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains
steps.note: The two flight paths link directly. No launch flight time is logged for this hop yet; expect 2–3 minutes.

steps.text: Cross the bridge north into town; accept **The Lost Tools** from Oslow and **The Price of Shoes** from Verner
steps.at: Lakeshire, north end of the bridge
steps.note: Every Redridge coordinate here uses Forever's re-cut map, about 5 lower in x than Classic guides. Launch players' addon data on ForeverDB matches it.

steps.text: Accept **Messenger to Stormwind** from Magistrate Solomon in the town hall
steps.note: Its four short errands unlock Messenger to Darkshire, which you carry into part 4.

steps.text: In the inn, turn in **The Defias Brotherhood** to Wiley upstairs; take the next part and **A Free Lunch**
steps.note: 1,350 XP, seen at launch. Darcy gives A Free Lunch; it goes to Guard Parker, whom you pass later.

steps.text: Accept **Selling Fish** from Dockmaster Baren on the dock
steps.note: Murloc Poachers opens at level 20 and wants 8 Murloc Fins. They drop now, so keep them.

steps.text: Accept **Hilary's Necklace** from Shawn on the shore south of town
Swim along the west shore and open Glinting Mud until you find **Hilary's Necklace**
steps.note: The mud has several spawn points between about 14, 52 and 33, 55: check them in a line.

steps.text: Swim east to the Sunken Chest on the lake bed and loot Oslow's Toolbox for **The Lost Tools**
steps.note: The chest is in deep water and you won't have Unending Breath until the Stormwind trainer, so watch your breath bar.

steps.text: Kill murlocs on the south shore for 10 Spotted Sunfish; keep 8 Murloc Fins for **Murloc Poachers**

items.name: Murloc Fin
items.note: normal drop, not a quest item: it drops before you have Murloc Poachers

steps.note: RestedXP's launch route collects the fins on this same pass.

steps.text: Run to Ariena Stormfeather at the south end of the bridge; fly to Sentinel Hill
steps.note: Hand in The Lost Tools, Selling Fish and Hilary's Necklace on your next visit, when you walk through town anyway.

steps.text: Turn in **The Defias Brotherhood** to Gryan Stoutmantle; accept the next part
steps.note: 675 XP, seen at launch.

steps.text: Fly from Thor to Stormwind
In SI:7 in Old Town, turn in **The Defias Brotherhood** to Mathias Shaw upstairs; accept the next part
steps.note: Stormwind coordinates here use Forever's harbor-era city map, which launch players' data matches.

steps.text: Train levels 16 and 18 with Ursula Deline in the Slaughtered Lamb basement
steps.note: You skipped the level-16 visit in part 2, so take Unending Breath, Searing Pain, Create Soulstone and the new ranks now. Searing Pain pulls the enemy's attention to you, so don't use it while the Voidwalker is holding a mob.

steps.text: Optional: at the auction house, buy 5 Crisp Spider Meat for **Redridge Goulash**, and 5 Tough Condor Meat if cheap
steps.note: Tough Condor Meat also drops from the condors by the gnoll hills north-west of Lakeshire. You don't need Flasks of Oil: you handed in Keeper of the Flame in part 2.

steps.text: Turn in **Messenger to Stormwind** to General Marcus Jonathan at the main gate; accept the reply
steps.note: He stands at about 69.2, 82.7 on Forever's Stormwind map.

steps.text: Walk out the gate and down the road to Goldshire
steps.note: Walking instead of flying lets you hand in The Price of Shoes and meet Guard Parker on the way. RestedXP's launch speed route does the same walk.

steps.text: Turn in **The Price of Shoes** to Smith Argus at the Goldshire forge; accept **Return to Verner**
steps.note: Return to Verner unlocks Underbelly Scales and A Baying of Gnolls.

steps.text: Follow the road east through Elwynn into Redridge at Three Corners
steps.note: About 5 minutes on foot. Elwynn's mobs are grey to you (too low to give XP), so don't stop.

steps.text: Give **A Free Lunch** to Guard Parker; accept **Visit the Herbalist**
steps.note: 550 XP, seen at launch. Encroaching Gnolls won't be offered again: you handed it in during part 2.

steps.text: West Lakeshire: turn in **Visit the Herbalist** to Martie Jainrose; accept **Delivering Daffodils**, and optionally **Redridge Goulash** next door
steps.note: Take Redridge Goulash only if you bought the spider meat. Its Great Goretusk Snouts drop only while you hold the quest, from the boars just west of here.

steps.text: In the inn, give **Delivering Daffodils** to Darcy
steps.note: The reward, 10 Sauteed Sunfish, is plain food: it does not give the +5% kill-XP buff.

steps.text: Town hall: turn in **Messenger to Stormwind** to Solomon; accept **Messenger to Westfall**
Dock: turn in **Selling Fish** to Dockmaster Baren
steps.note: 1,250 XP, seen at launch. Its reward includes one Murloc Fin Soup (+5% kill XP for 15 minutes): save it for the gnoll grind.

steps.text: Hand in **Return to Verner** and **The Lost Tools**; accept **A Baying of Gnolls**, **Underbelly Scales**, **The Everstill Bridge**
steps.at: Lakeshire, north end of the bridge
steps.note: Verner and Oslow stand at the north end of the bridge. The Lost Tools pays 875 XP, seen at launch.

steps.text: North-west of town, kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Mystics; loot 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets

mobs.name: Dire Condor
mobs.note: optional: 5 Tough Condor Meat for Redridge Goulash

steps.note: Pikes and rivets drop from Brutes, Mystics and Bashers. You get the whelp scales on the south loop.

steps.text: Back at the bridge, hand in **A Baying of Gnolls** and **The Everstill Bridge**; accept **Howling in the Hills**
steps.at: Lakeshire, north end of the bridge
steps.note: The Everstill Bridge paid 1,550 XP at launch. Howling in the Hills sends you after Yowler, a level-25 gnoll, on your last Redridge loop.

steps.text: Turn in **Hilary's Necklace** to Hilary on the shore south of town
steps.note: 1,350 XP, seen at launch.

steps.text: Accept **Assessing the Threat** and **Show of Force** from Deputy Feldon by the flight master
steps.at: Lakeshire, south end of the bridge
steps.note: Show of Force is new in Forever and pays 950 XP. It opens after Encroaching Gnolls, which you've done.

steps.text: Head south and kill Black Dragon Whelps for 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales
Around 27, 80, kill 10 Mongrels and 6 Poachers; loot 5 Spiked Collars from Thrashers
steps.note: If this camp is busy, the same three gnolls also camp at Three Corners, about 11, 62–67.

steps.text: Turn in **Assessing the Threat** and **Show of Force** to Deputy Feldon
steps.at: Lakeshire, south end of the bridge
steps.note: 950 XP each, seen at launch. Underbelly Scales waits for your next visit.

steps.text: Fly from Ariena Stormfeather to Sentinel Hill
Turn in **The Defias Brotherhood** and **Messenger to Westfall** to Gryan Stoutmantle; accept both follow-ups
Kill the Defias Messenger on the road north of Moonbrook and loot A Mysterious Message

mobs.name: Defias Messenger
mobs.note: spawns in Moonbrook, walks the road north

steps.note: He walks from Moonbrook toward Jangolode Mine. If you miss him, wait in Moonbrook for him to respawn; launch players reported a queue.

steps.text: Back at Sentinel Hill, turn in **The Defias Brotherhood**; accept the next part from the Defias Traitor
steps.note: The next part is an escort: you walk with the Traitor and protect him until he reaches his goal.

steps.text: Escort the Defias Traitor south to Moonbrook; he stops by the Defias Hideout
steps.note: Start looking for a Deadmines group now in the LookingForGroup channel. The Deadmines is the busiest dungeon at launch.

steps.text: Turn in the escort to Gryan; accept the last **The Defias Brotherhood** and Scout Riell's **Red Silk Bandanas**
steps.note: Red Silk Bandanas only opens after the escort. You now carry five Deadmines quests: this one, the bandanas, Oh Brother…, Collecting Memories and Underground Assault.

steps.text: Walk to Moonbrook and enter the Defias Hideout, the big house in the village's south-west
steps.note: A cave maze leads from the house down to the dungeon portal.

steps.text: Before the portal, kill Foreman Thistlenettle for **Oh Brother…** and undead miners for **Collecting Memories**
steps.note: These mobs are outside the dungeon, so they give full kill XP; Thistlenettle is an elite (much tougher than a normal mob). RestedXP warns the 4 Miners' Union Cards drop slowly: drop Collecting Memories if your group won't wait.

steps.text: Run the Deadmines: loot the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from Sneed's Shredder, collect 10 Red Silk Bandanas, kill VanCleef

mobs.name: Edwin VanCleef
mobs.note: Head of VanCleef; An Unsent Letter (56% drop)

steps.note: Bandanas drop from the Defias inside. Dungeon kills give about a quarter of their Classic XP, so the quests are the point.

steps.text: Right-click the letter VanCleef drops to start **The Unsent Letter**
steps.note: It drops 56% of the time. If you don't get it, skip The Unsent Letter and Bazil Thredd.

steps.text: Leave the group after looting; after a short countdown you're moved out to the nearest graveyard
steps.note: RestedXP's launch guides use this trick to save the walk out. Walk out instead if you want the optional lighthouse step.

steps.text: Optional: at the lighthouse, take **The Coastal Menace**, kill Old Murk-Eye up the coast and hand it in

mobs.name: Old Murk-Eye
mobs.note: normal (not elite) in Forever; patrols the coast

steps.note: About 1,550 XP for 7 minutes, slower than grinding. Take it only for the Torchlight Wand if the Sable Wand doesn't drop for you.

steps.text: Walk back to Sentinel Hill
Turn in **The Defias Brotherhood** to Gryan and **Red Silk Bandanas** to Scout Riell at the top of the tower

items.name: Staff of Westfall
items.note: take it: intellect and spirit two-hander

steps.note: The last Defias step paid 6,175 XP in the beta (ConquestCapped). You reach level 20 here.

steps.text: Hearth to Stormwind
steps.note: Your hearthstone has been set to Stormwind since part 2.

steps.text: In the Dwarven District, turn in **Oh Brother…** and **Collecting Memories** to Wilder Thistlenettle
steps.note: 1,550 and 1,350 XP, seen at launch.

steps.text: Turn in **Underground Assault** to Shoni the Shilent nearby
steps.note: Underground Assault and Red Silk Bandanas are worth about 6,650 XP together by ConquestCapped's beta numbers. Launch players haven't logged them yet.

steps.text: In Cathedral Square, turn in **The Unsent Letter** and **Humble Beginnings**, if carried, to Baros Alexston; accept **Bazil Thredd**

quests.name: Humble Beginnings
quests.note: only if you looted A Simple Compass in part 2

steps.note: Bazil Thredd starts the Stockade quests: keep it for part 4.

steps.text: Train level 20 with Ursula Deline: Demon Armor, Rain of Fire and Ritual of Summoning
steps.note: Skip Gakin's Succubus quest, Devourer of Souls: it sends you to the Barrens and Ashenvale.

steps.text: Fly from Dungar Longdrink to Lakeshire
steps.note: 1:53, measured at launch.

steps.text: Accept **Blackrock Bounty** from Guard Howe at the south end of the bridge
steps.at: Lakeshire, south end of the bridge
steps.note: 2,000 XP, seen at launch. Its Blackrock Champions are level 24–25, so do it last, on the north loop.

steps.text: At the north end of the bridge, hand in **Underbelly Scales**; accept **Alther's Mill**, **Blackrock Menace** and **Blackrock Blockade**
steps.at: Lakeshire, north end of the bridge
steps.note: Alther's Mill is new in Forever and its text names Foreman Oslow. Wowhead lists it in the same group as the two Blackrock quests, so it should be offered now.

steps.text: Town hall: hand in **Messenger to Westfall**; accept **Messenger to Darkshire** from Solomon and **Solomon's Law** from Conacher
steps.note: Carry Messenger to Darkshire to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire; you hand it in at the start of part 4.

steps.text: Dock: accept and hand in **Murloc Poachers** with your 8 Murloc Fins
steps.note: It needs level 20 and paid 1,550 XP at launch.

steps.text: Optional: take **WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore** from the wanted poster by the inn door
steps.note: Take it only if you expect to team up with other players in Galardell Valley. Fangore is a level-26 gnoll leader with guards; abandon the quest if no group turns up.

steps.text: At the west end, accept **An Unwelcome Guest** from Martie Jainrose; kill Bellygrub just west of town; hand it in

quests.name: Redridge Goulash
quests.note: optional: needs 5 snouts (boars here), 5 condor and 5 spider meat

steps.note: 1,950 XP at launch; RestedXP's launch speed route kills him solo at about 19. Let the Voidwalker hold him, keep your damage-over-time spells (DoTs) up, and Fear him if he turns on you.

mobs.name: Bellygrub
mobs.note: normal (not elite) boar; patrols from about 10, 50 to the town's west edge

mobs.name: Great Goretusk
mobs.note: Great Goretusk Snouts for Redridge Goulash (quest item)

steps.text: Take the north-shore road east to Alther's Mill; kill 12 Greater Tarantulas and destroy 6 Tarantula Eggs
steps.note: Greater Tarantulas also drop Crisp Spider Meat for Redridge Goulash. Watch for Chatter, a level-23 rare spider (a stronger named mob).

steps.text: Continue east to Galardell Valley; kill Shadowhide gnolls for 10 Shadowhide Pendants for **Solomon's Law**
steps.note: Stay east and north of Stonewatch Keep, about 58–64, 48–60: its orcs are elites.

steps.text: Optional, only in a group: kill Lieutenant Fangore at about 71, 39 for **WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore**

mobs.name: Lieutenant Fangore
mobs.note: normal (not elite) on Wowhead; launch players found him here

steps.note: In Classic he took no Shadow damage and four bodyguards rushed in when he was attacked, so he is a bad solo target at 21. If your group gets him, the quest pays 2,650 XP at launch and you stop the grind about 0.1 level early.

steps.text: Grind Shadowhide gnolls here until 21.7, or 21.6 if your group killed Fangore
steps.note: Redridge's quests fall about 19,000 XP short, so this is the part's only grind (killing mobs for XP until a target level): about 115 kills, roughly 70 minutes. Eat the Murloc Fin Soup first for +5% kill XP.

steps.text: Go south past Stonewatch Falls to Render's Valley; kill Blackrock Grunts and Outrunners for 10 Battleworn Axes
steps.note: The axes are for Blackrock Menace. Outrunners cast Net, which holds you in place for a few seconds.

steps.text: In the same camp, loot 10 Blackrock Supplies and 8 Stolen Weapons for **Blackrock Blockade**
