steps.note: Supplies are grain sacks and meat, weapons are racks; launch players logged them at about 72, 76. Skip the cave at about 73, 86: that's Incinerator Gar'im, a group quest.

steps.text: Follow the south-shore road west back to Lakeshire
steps.note: Kill Dire Condors on the way if you still need Tough Condor Meat for Redridge Goulash.

steps.text: At the bridge, hand in **Blackrock Menace** and **Blackrock Blockade** to Marris and **Alther's Mill** to Oslow
steps.at: Lakeshire, north end of the bridge
steps.note: Blackrock Blockade paid 1,650 XP at launch. Marris now offers Tharil'zun and Shadow Magic: skip both, they need elite kills.

steps.text: Town hall: hand in **Solomon's Law** to Bailiff Conacher
steps.note: 1,850 XP, seen at launch. You should now be level 22, which What Comes Around… needs later.

steps.text: Optional: hand **WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore** to Magistrate Solomon in the same room
steps.note: 2,650 XP, seen at launch.

steps.text: Head north up the canyon road and kill Yowler, a level-25 gnoll, for **Howling in the Hills**
steps.note: Launch players found him at about 24.5, 23.7. Clear his Redridge Alphas first.

steps.text: Continue north to Rethban Caverns; kill 15 Blackrock Champions around the cave mouths for **Blackrock Bounty**
steps.note: Champions are 2–3 levels above you: fight them one at a time and Fear any extra. Don't stay to grind here: part 4's Stockade run earns more XP per hour.

steps.text: Inside Rethban Caverns, accept **Missing In Action** from Corporal Keeshan and escort him out
steps.note: Go in right after the Champions, while the cave mouth is still clear. Keeshan is a level-25 elite who fights beside you; the quest needs level 19 and goes to Marshal Marris.

steps.text: Walk back south to Lakeshire
Hand in **Howling in the Hills** to Verner and **Missing In Action** to Marris; accept **What Comes Around…** from Berton

quests.name: Redridge Goulash
quests.note: optional, if you didn't hand it in at the west end

steps.note: What Comes Around… needs level 22 and is a Stockade quest that paid 4,200 XP at level 25; you hand it back to Berton in part 4. Hand Redridge Goulash to Chef Breanna if you finished it.

steps.text: At the south end of the bridge, hand in **Blackrock Bounty** to Guard Howe
steps.at: Lakeshire, south end of the bridge
steps.note: 2,000 XP, seen at launch.

steps.text: Walk south-west to Three Corners and follow the road into Duskwood to Darkshire
steps.note: You can't fly to Darkshire until you've been there. On foot it takes about 3–4 minutes.

steps.text: Learn the Darkshire flight path from Felicia Maline; part 3 ends here at about 22.45

quests.name: Messenger to Darkshire
quests.note: turn in to Lord Ello Ebonlocke at about 71.8, 46.4, at the start of part 4

steps.note: You carry Messenger to Darkshire, What Comes Around… and Bazil Thredd. Your hearthstone is still set to Stormwind.

openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: the launch XP for the Deadmines quests. Our estimate uses the beta values ConquestCapped published, 6,175 XP for the last Defias Brotherhood step and about 6,650 for Red Silk Bandanas and Underground Assault together, and Classic's 870 for The Unsent Letter. If they pay less, the gnoll grind runs a few minutes longer.

Not confirmed yet: who gives Alther's Mill and what it pays. Its text names Foreman Oslow, who stands with Marshal Marris at the north end of the bridge, so it is the same stop either way; our estimate assumes 1,650 XP, like the two Blackrock quests offered with it.

Not confirmed yet: whether everyone in the group can loot An Unsent Letter from VanCleef, a 56% drop. Without it you have no Bazil Thredd for part 4. The Gnoam Sprecklesprocket for Underground Assault drops 47% of the time from Sneed's Shredder.
Not confirmed yet: which Westfall graveyard you land at when you leave the group inside the Deadmines.

If Bellygrub turns out to be elite (much tougher than a normal mob), skip An Unwelcome Guest and grind about 13 more gnolls. Wowhead lists him as a normal level-24 boar, RestedXP's launch speed route kills him solo, and one launch player has logged the quest.

Not confirmed yet: the Missing In Action escort in Forever. Wowhead's path for Keeshan runs from about 26, 9.6 toward 38, 18, so he may leave by an eastern exit; two launch players have handed it in to Marshal Marris.

Not confirmed yet: whether Lieutenant Fangore still takes no Shadow damage in Forever, as in Classic, and how many guards come with him. Wowhead lists him as a normal level-26 mob, and two launch players handed the quest in, at levels 17 and 20.
Not confirmed yet: the Sentinel Hill to Lakeshire flight time; we assume 2–3 minutes. Stormwind to Lakeshire is 1:53.

Not confirmed yet: the launch XP for Return to Verner, Underbelly Scales, A Baying of Gnolls, Howling in the Hills, Missing In Action, the later Messenger errands and the middle Defias Brotherhood steps, including the escort. Our estimate uses their Classic amounts, which every Redridge quest logged so far has matched; levels shift by about 0.2 if they differ.

Not confirmed yet: where '... and that note you found' is handed in and what it pays. RestedXP's launch Deadmines route picks it up from Burned-Out Remains near the Westfall lighthouse road, and five launch players have seen it.

Not confirmed yet: who gives Philmor's Favor and Gatehouse Goods, two new level-15 Stormwind quests that RestedXP's launch speed route hands in at the cheese shop in the Trade District. If the first part is easy to get, they fit the auction-house stop.

legs.title: Duskwood, the Stockade, Wetlands & Ashenvale
legs.summary: You quest Duskwood from Darkshire in three short loops, then fly to Stormwind for one Stockade run with all five of its quests. You walk into the Wetlands from Loch Modan and work the Menethil, Whelgar, Greenwarden and Howin quests. At about 27.6 you take the ship from Menethil to Auberdine, quest across Ashenvale, hearth back to Menethil and end at the Excavation Site approach at 29.4.
legs.why: You start this part about a level lower than before, so Duskwood's level 24–28 quests send you against mobs 3–5 levels above you; the loops still pay because they stay close to Darkshire, and you hearth back from Raven Hill instead of running across the zone. The Stockade is now on your path: ForeverDB shows Forever paying about twice Classic for its quests (5,550 XP each for Quell the Uprising and The Color of Blood, 4,400 for Crime and Punishment, 4,200 for What Comes Around…), so one run with all five quests gives about 29,000 XP in about 1.2 hours, including the group wait and the Darkshire and Lakeshire hand-ins. That makes up the lower start. The Wetlands is where launch Alliance players level from 27 to 30 (the launch leaderboard), and you walk in through Dun Algaz because you can't fly to Menethil before you have been there. The two old Wetlands grinds (about 550 kills) are replaced by an Ashenvale trip on the Menethil–Auberdine ship, which still runs at launch. Ashenvale's Alliance quests between levels 25 and 32 pay about 25,000 XP an hour while you cross the zone, against about 19,000 for grinding. The route goes west first because Raene's later quests need her first three, and because Illiyana and Sentinel Melyria stand at the Shrine of Aessina in the west, not at Forest Song (ForeverDB). The zone runs out of quests at about 28.9, so you top up with about 110 satyr kills at Xavian. The trip still saves about half an hour over grinding from 27.6 to 29.4, and it gives you the Auberdine and Astranaar flight paths that parts 5 and 9 use.
legs.estTime: About 11–12 h /played: about 2 h of Duskwood, 1.8 h for Stormwind, the Stockade and the walk into the Wetlands, 4.1 h of Wetlands quests and 3.5 h for the Ashenvale trip, including about 110 satyr kills.
legs.start: You are level 22.45 in Darkshire (Duskwood) and have its flight path. Your hearthstone is set to Stormwind. You trained levels 16, 18 and 20 in Stormwind and have the Imp and the Voidwalker. You carry Messenger to Darkshire, What Comes Around… and Bazil Thredd. Done: the Defias chain, the five Deadmines quests, The Unsent Letter and every Redridge quest that part 3 does not skip.
legs.end: You are level 29.4 at the Excavation Site approach in the Wetlands (the path left of Thelgen Rock, 53.9, 65.4), after hearthing back from Ashenvale. Your hearthstone is set to Menethil Harbor and is on cooldown for about an hour. You trained levels 22 and 24 in Stormwind; you train 26, 28 and 30 at part 5's Ironforge stop. Flight paths added: Menethil, Auberdine and Astranaar. You carry Lost in the Thicket Things and Horrors in the Highland for the Excavation Site (Ardin gives Heartwoven inside; Changing Tastes is a Horde quest), Death to the Dragonmaw and Carnage (elite targets), A Friend of the Family (for Bolvar in Stormwind), Understanding Our Present only if Uncovering the Past finished, and Forced Disarmament and Old Habits only if you picked them up. Done: the Stockade (all five quests), Bloom of the Heavens parts 1 and 2, Unrequited Love if Hollee offered it, Nek'rosh's Gambit and From the Ashes, The Cursed Crew (so Lifting the Curse is open for part 5), Ormer's Revenge 1–3, the Greenwarden chain to Blisters on the Land, the statuette chain, Razormaw Needling and Trying Times, and in Ashenvale the whole Raene's Cleansing chain, Fallen Sky Lake, The Howling Vale, The Branch of Cenarius, Culling the Threat, Forsaken Diseases and Shared Fury. Strong Anti-Venom is in your bags.

skipped.name: The Valor Family (part 2)
skipped.why: A level-27 follow-up at Raven Hill whose requirements aren't published (beta players say it runs through all four Valor ghosts). Part 5's Duskwood return skips it too.

skipped.name: Merrick's Bow
skipped.why: It starts from the Lost Watcher's drop and needs level 29–30 Splinter Fist gnolls, red at 23. Part 5 does it on its Duskwood return.

skipped.name: Silvia's Sword / Grant's Shield (Valor ghosts)
skipped.why: Item-started Valor quests with unpublished objectives; the Lost Knight spawns in two far-apart cemeteries.

skipped.name: The Legend of Stalvan
skipped.why: A chain across Westfall, Elwynn and Stormwind with small XP per stop.

skipped.name: The Weathered Grave / Mor'Ladim
skipped.why: A level-35 chain that ends with an elite.

skipped.name: Morbent Fel
skipped.why: Level 32, at the end of a Stormwind and Wetlands chain.

skipped.name: Look to the Stars (part 4)
skipped.why: Zzarc'Vul is a level-30 ogre in the southern ogre mound, too strong for you at 22. Part 5 does it on its Duskwood return.

skipped.name: The Night Watch (part 3)
skipped.why: Level 30 and back at Raven Hill. Part 5 does it on its Duskwood return.

skipped.name: Worgen in the Woods (part 3)
skipped.why: Level 29–31 worgen deep in the south-east. Part 5 does it on its Duskwood return.

skipped.name: Sven's Revenge / The Shadowy Figure chain
skipped.why: The dirt mound is in south-central Duskwood, and the chain bounces between Sven, Darkshire and Jitters.

skipped.name: Wolves at Our Heels
skipped.why: Level 19–21 wolves for 1,250 XP.

skipped.name: Ghost Hair Thread and the Abercrombie chain
skipped.why: It bounces between Blind Mary, Darkshire and Abercrombie across the zone.

skipped.name: Dusky Crab Cakes / Return to Jitters
skipped.why: It ends back at Raven Hill after you have left.

skipped.name: Eight-Legged Menaces
skipped.why: Grey (too low to give XP) spiders in the far north.

skipped.name: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
skipped.why: Meat that drops only sometimes, plus a herb you buy in Stormwind.

skipped.name: The Fury Runs Deep
skipped.why: Its giver is at Dun Modr, among elites.

skipped.name: Songblade Search
skipped.why: It starts and ends in Lakeshire, and you only pass Lakeshire for a quick hand-in.

skipped.name: Highland Hides
skipped.why: Its 4 Thicket Raptor Hides drop inside the Excavation Site, and beta players reported it bugged for a small reward.

skipped.name: Changing Tastes
skipped.why: A Horde quest (Borstan, Orgrimmar).

skipped.name: Seeking Caitlin
skipped.why: A lead-in quest from Astranaar to Caitlin in Menethil, whom you have already met.

skipped.name: A Lack of Virtue
skipped.why: Its item starts outside the Wetlands, and where it comes from isn't published.

skipped.name: The Greenwarden
skipped.why: A lead-in quest; you take Tramping Paws straight from Rethiel.

skipped.name: Stopping the Cycle
skipped.why: A level-34 group quest. Part 5 offers it if your Excavation group stays.

skipped.name: Defeat Nek'rosh
skipped.why: A level-32 elite chieftain. Part 5 offers it if your Excavation group stays.

skipped.name: The Dark Iron War, A Grim Task, The Thandol Span
skipped.why: Elite Dun Modr quests; part 5 returns to Dun Modr with a group.

skipped.name: Blackfathom Deeps and the Succubus quests
skipped.why: Launch players say Blackfathom Deeps' quests can't be finished in one run; the Succubus chain crosses two continents.

skipped.name: Satyr Slaying!
skipped.why: It opens only when you hand in The Branch of Cenarius at the Shrine of Aessina, on the far side of the zone from the satyrs.

skipped.name: Insane Druids
skipped.why: Three level-32 ghosts deep in Dor'danil Barrow Den, with the hand-in back at Forest Song: no better than grinding.

skipped.name: Slowing the Orc Advance
skipped.why: A level-32 quest from Shandrina (ForeverDB): 6 swords and 4 daggers that orcs drop, with no drop rates published for Forever.

skipped.name: An Aggressive Defense
skipped.why: 25 low-level Foulweald furbolgs: the same XP per hour as the Xavian top-up. If Xavian is crowded, take it from Raene on your second visit and do it on the way to Krolg instead.

skipped.name: Elemental Bracers / Mage Summoner
skipped.why: Only some of the elementals' bracers are intact, and Mage Summoner sends you into the Barrens.

skipped.name: Velinde Starsong
skipped.why: It goes on to Darnassus, Ratchet and Booty Bay.

skipped.name: The Zoram Strand / Naga at the Zoram Strand
skipped.why: Level-19 quests that pay only 20–40% of their XP at 27–28.

skipped.name: The Ancient Statuette / Ruuzel
skipped.why: Level 20–25 naga quests on the far west coast.

skipped.name: Journey to Stonetalon Peak / Pridewings of Stonetalon
skipped.why: Level 18–21 quests in Stonetalon.

skipped.name: The Tower of Althalaxx / Supplies to Auberdine
skipped.why: A level 18–24 chain that starts in Darkshore.

steps.text: Town hall: turn in **Messenger to Darkshire**, take the reply, and accept **Crime and Punishment** and **The Valor Family**

quests.name: Messenger to Darkshire
quests.note: Ello's reply goes back to Lakeshire after the Stockade

steps.note: You hand in the reply in Lakeshire and Crime and Punishment after the Stockade, both later in this part.

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Trelayne
steps.note: You hearth back here from Raven Hill and again after the Stockade. You move it to Menethil later in this part.

steps.text: Accept **The Night Watch** and **The Totem of Infliction**
Accept **Raven Hill**, **Deliveries to Sven** and **The Hermit**
steps.note: Calor's Worgen in the Woods needs level 23, so take it on your next visit to town.

steps.text: Buy a **Bronze Tube** from Herble Baubbletump
steps.note: He has limited stock. If he is sold out, check the Auction House later; the first Look to the Stars is worth 2,000 XP.

steps.text: Accept and turn in **Look to the Stars** with the tube, then accept part 2
Blind Mary's house: turn in **Look to the Stars** part 2 and accept part 3
Tranquil Gardens Cemetery: kill 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages, and loot Skeleton Fingers
steps.note: Skeletons here and at Raven Hill drop the fingers; you need 10 in all.

steps.text: Kill the Insane Ghoul in the chapel and loot **Mary's Looking Glass**
steps.note: The ghoul is level 26, about 3 levels above you, so clear the skeletons near the chapel first.

steps.text: Back in Darkshire: turn in **The Night Watch** and **Look to the Stars**; accept The Night Watch part 2

quests.name: Look to the Stars
quests.note: Zzarc'Vul is a level-30 ogre in the southern ogre mound; part 5 does it on its Duskwood return

steps.text: Follow the road west across Duskwood to Raven Hill
steps.note: About 4 minutes on foot. Kill only what blocks the road.

steps.text: Turn in **Raven Hill** to Jitters and accept **Jitters' Growling Gut**
Click the Memory of Valor behind the houses for **The Valor Family**
steps.note: A Lost Watcher ghost here (16, 62) drops the item for Merrick's Bow. Leave it: part 5 does that quest when its gnolls are no longer red.

steps.text: East of Raven Hill: kill Black Widow Hatchlings for 5 Vials of Spider Venom
Raven Hill Cemetery: kill 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors, and finish the Skeleton Fingers
North end of the cemetery: kill Rotted Ones for 10 Ghoul Fangs
steps.note: Brain Eaters (level 28–29) wander just north; don't pull them (draw them into a fight) by accident.

steps.text: Abercrombie's shack: turn in **The Hermit** and accept **Supplies from Darkshire**
Sven's camp on the west coast: turn in **Deliveries to Sven**

quests.name: Sven's Revenge
quests.note: its dirt mound is in south-central Duskwood

steps.text: Hearth to Darkshire
steps.note: This saves the long run back east. Your hearthstone takes 10 seconds to cast and has a 1-hour cooldown.

steps.text: Town hall: turn in **The Valor Family** to Sirra Von'Indi

quests.name: The Valor Family
quests.note: ghost spawns in two opposite cemeteries

steps.note: Hand it in before you hunt the Lost Stalker, which a beta player said comes after it. Its XP is not published; we assume about 1,050.

steps.text: Turn in **The Night Watch**, **The Totem of Infliction**, **Supplies from Darkshire**, **Jitters' Growling Gut**; accept **Worgen in the Woods**

quests.name: The Night Watch
quests.note: level 30, back at Raven Hill; part 5 does it on its Duskwood return

steps.note: Calor stands at the east end of town. You are level 23 now, which Worgen in the Woods needs.

steps.text: North-east of Darkshire: kill the Lost Stalker ghost and loot **Ira's Dagger** to start the quest
steps.note: If the ghost isn't up, kill the ravagers in the next step while it respawns.

steps.text: Kill 7 Black Ravagers and 10 Young Black Ravagers around the Lost Stalker
steps.note: Both wolves also roam south-central Duskwood (47–60, 58–66) if this spot is crowded.

steps.text: Kill 6 Nightbane Shadow Weavers west of the ravagers
steps.note: They are about 4 levels above you: open with Corruption and Bane of Agony, and Fear (your spell that makes a mob run away) any second one.

steps.text: Darkshire: turn in **Ira's Dagger** and **Worgen in the Woods**; accept Worgen in the Woods part 2
steps.note: Other Valor ghosts drop items for more Valor quests; skip them. Ira's Dagger XP is not published; we assume about 1,950.

steps.text: Just west of Darkshire: kill 12 Nightbane Dark Runners
steps.note: Warning: they are 4–5 levels above you. Fight one at a time and Fear any add (an extra mob that joins in). If you die twice, skip this quest; it is worth about 4,000 XP.

steps.text: Turn in **Worgen in the Woods** part 2

quests.name: Worgen in the Woods
quests.note: level 29–31 worgen; part 5 does it on its Duskwood return

steps.text: Fly to Stormwind
steps.note: The flight takes about 2 minutes (ForeverDB).

steps.text: Mage Quarter: train level 22 at Ursula Deline
steps.note: Drain Life rank 2 helps in the Stockade. Come back for level 24 after the run.

steps.text: Stockade gate: turn in **Bazil Thredd**; accept **The Stockade Riots** and **Quell the Uprising**
steps.note: Look for a group for up to 15 minutes. With no group by then, use the fallback a few steps further on.

steps.text: Old Town: accept **The Color of Blood** from Nikova Raskol
steps.note: Do this while you wait for the group.

steps.text: Stockade, one run: kill Targorr, Dextren Ward and Bazil Thredd, 26 Defias, and collect 10 Red Wool Bandanas
steps.note: Forever pays about twice Classic for these quests (ForeverDB): about 26,000 XP for the five, plus about 3,000 from mobs. Bazil Thredd is a level-29 elite (a much tougher mob), so stay with your group.

steps.text: Turn in **Quell the Uprising**, **The Stockade Riots** and **The Color of Blood**
steps.note: The Stockade Riots has no launch XP logged yet; we assume about 6,200, twice its Classic value.

steps.text: Mage Quarter: train level 24 at Ursula Deline
steps.note: Corruption rank 3 is the key upgrade. Level 26 waits for part 5's Ironforge stop.

steps.text: Hearth to Darkshire: turn in **Crime and Punishment** to Councilman Millstipe
steps.note: Your hearthstone is ready again by now. It paid 4,400 XP at launch (ForeverDB).

steps.text: Fly to Lakeshire: turn in **What Comes Around...** (Guard Berton) and the **Messenger to Darkshire** reply (Magistrate Solomon)
steps.note: Darkshire flies straight to Lakeshire (ForeverDB), so this is a short hop.

steps.text: No Stockade group after 15 minutes? Abandon the five Stockade quests and the Lakeshire reply, then fly on
steps.note: You can't finish them without the run. You lose about 29,000 XP: kill about 150 more satyrs at Xavian later in this part (about 1.5 h).

steps.text: Fly to Thelsamar in one booking from Lakeshire, or from Stormwind if you skipped the Stockade

npcs.name: Dungar Longdrink
npcs.role: flight master (if you skipped the Stockade)

steps.note: It routes through Stormwind and Ironforge (ForeverDB). You can't fly to Menethil until you have been there, so you walk in from Loch Modan.

steps.text: Thelsamar: accept **Report to Mountaineer Rockgar** from Mountaineer Kadrell
Run north to the Dun Algaz gate: turn in to Rockgar and accept **The Algaz Gauntlet**
Dun Algaz pass: kill 8 Dragonmaw Scouts and 6 Dragonmaw Grunts as you walk north
steps.note: The walk from Thelsamar takes about 10 minutes (our estimate).

steps.text: Crossroads: accept **Daily Delivery** from Einar Stonegrip and anything Howin Kindfeather offers
steps.note: Howin's quests may need This Land Was Their Land from Menethil first; their requirements aren't published.

steps.text: Rethiel the Greenwarden: accept **Tramping Paws**

quests.name: The Greenwarden
quests.note: a lead-in quest; it closes once Tramping Paws is taken

steps.note: In Classic it needs no lead-in quest. Level 29–30 elite Dragonmaw Reclaimers patrol right next to Rethiel.

steps.text: South-east Mosshide camps: kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels
steps.note: Blizzard raised gnoll respawn rates in the beta and again for launch, so the camps refill quickly.

steps.text: Rethiel: turn in **Tramping Paws** and accept **Fire Taboo**
Take the road west past Angerfang Encampment toward Whelgar's Excavation Site
steps.note: Dragonmaw Raiders line the road; kill only those in your way. You come back here for War Banners.

steps.text: Whelgar's camp: accept **Ormer's Revenge** and **Uncovering the Past**
steps.note: Uncovering the Past needs level 25 (ForeverDB); if it isn't offered yet, take it on your next visit. Give it up if the fourth fragment hasn't shown after 20 minutes in total.

steps.text: West of the camp toward Menethil: kill 10 Mottled Raptors and 10 Mottled Screechers
Bridge outside Menethil: accept **In Search of the Excavation Team** from Tarrel Rockweaver

quests.name: In Search of the Excavation Team

steps.text: Menethil Harbor: learn the flight path from Shellei Brondir
steps.note: It links Ironforge, Thelsamar, Southshore and Refuge Pointe (ForeverDB travel page).

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Helbrek and buy a Flagon of Dwarven Honeymead
steps.note: The honeymead is for The Third Fleet. Menethil stays your hearth for the rest of this part, including the Ashenvale trip.

steps.text: Keep entrance: turn in **The Algaz Gauntlet**; accept **Spoils of War** and **Report to Captain Stoutfist**
Stoutfist: accept **War Banners**, **From the Ashes**, **This Land Was Their Land**; Harlo: accept **Fall of Dun Modr**
steps.note: Hand in Report to Captain Stoutfist first. If he doesn't offer From the Ashes yet, take it when you hand in War Banners.

steps.text: West side: turn in **Daily Delivery**; accept **Young Crocolisk Skins**, **Crocs of the Sky** and **Bloom of the Heavens**
Docks and inn: accept **Claws from the Deep** and **The Third Fleet**, hand it in, and accept **The Cursed Crew**
Accept **Digging Through the Ooze** (Sida), **Alchemical Hazards** and **Lost in the Thicket Things** (Caitlin)
steps.note: Keep Lost in the Thicket Things for the Excavation Site in part 5. Skip Highland Hides from Halloran: it was bugged in the beta.

steps.text: Spoils of War: swim along the harbor west of the docks for 6 Khaz Modan Timber and 30 Iron
steps.note: The underwater crates lie between 47 and 68 on the y axis. Watch your breath bar.

steps.text: Shore north of town: kill Young Wetlands Crocolisks for 6 Young Crocolisk Skins
Murloc camps up the coast: kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs and Gobbler

mobs.name: Gobbler
mobs.note: patrols the camps; loot his head

steps.note: The Damaged Crate here starts the next quest, but only after you turn in Claws from the Deep.

steps.text: Menethil: turn in **Spoils of War**, **Young Crocolisk Skins** and **Claws from the Deep**; accept the follow-ups
Click the Damaged Crate, Sealed Barrel and Half-buried Barrel in the murloc camps
steps.note: Each one hands in a quest and starts the next.

steps.text: Sunken ships: kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig

mobs.name: First Mate Snellig
mobs.note: inside the hull; loot Snellig's Snuffbox

steps.note: Snellig (29) and the Marines (27–28) are well above you, so pull one at a time. Enter the southern ship through the hole near the shore.

steps.text: Along this coast: kill Giant Wetlands Crocolisks for 6 Giant Crocolisk Skins
Mosshide camp inland: kill Mosshide Brutes and Alphas for 9 Crude Flints
steps.note: Flints drop at a low rate (Warcraft Tavern). The hidden Fen Creepers in these pools don't count yet.

steps.text: Ironbeard's Tomb: kill oozes until **Sida's Bag** drops
steps.note: The quest's reward is a free 10-slot bag.

steps.text: Dun Modr camp: turn in **Fall of Dun Modr** to Longbraid the Grim
steps.note: Leave the Dun Modr quests and Bring Back a Bang for part 5; the dwarves here are elite.

steps.text: Road south to the crossroads: turn in **This Land Was Their Land**; accept **Death to the Dragonmaw** and **Trying Times**
steps.note: Keep Death to the Dragonmaw for part 5: its targets are level 29–30 elites (Wowhead).

steps.text: Rethiel: turn in **Fire Taboo** and accept **Blisters on the Land**
Kill 12 hidden Fen Creepers in the streams around Rethiel and north of the crossroads

mobs.name: Fen Creeper
mobs.note: hidden until you are close; walk the water

steps.note: They only show up when you are close. Forever needs 12 (Classic needed 8); more sit at 46–48, 29–36.

steps.text: East of Rethiel: kill whelps for 8 Pristine Crimson Scales
steps.note: Stay north of Dragonmaw Retreat (56–62, 41–48): its orcs are elite.

steps.text: Rethiel: turn in **Blisters on the Land**; accept **Horrors in the Highland** and **Carnage**
steps.note: Horrors in the Highland is an Excavation Site quest. Carnage is a level-30 elite raptor: keep it for part 5.

steps.text: Angerfang: kill Dragonmaw for 8 **War Banners** and destroy the 4 Attack Plans for **From the Ashes**
steps.note: The plan spots come from ForeverDB player data; the west one (38.5, 46.1) is on the way to Whelgar's camp. Leave the catapult (47.5, 46.9) until Nek'rosh's Gambit is in your log.

steps.text: Thelgen Rock cave mouth: kill Cave Stalkers for the Unruptured Stalker Gland
steps.note: Get it now so the Strong Anti-Venom is in your bags before the dungeon.

steps.text: Whelgar's camp: turn in **Ormer's Revenge** and **In Search of the Excavation Team**; accept the next parts

quests.name: In Search of the Excavation Team
In Search of the Excavation Team

steps.text: Dig site: kill 10 Mottled Scytheclaws and 10 Mottled Razormaws, and look for the tablet fragments
steps.note: Fragments: Ados (tomb), Modr (thin red vase), Golm (fat yellow vase), Neru (dirt pile). Keep to the 20-minute limit.

steps.text: Whelgar's camp: turn in **Ormer's Revenge** part 2 (and **Uncovering the Past** if done); accept part 3

quests.name: Understanding Our Present
quests.note: only if Uncovering the Past is done; part 5

steps.text: Kill Sarltooth (level 29) on the hill west of the camp, loot his talon and turn it in to Ormer
steps.note: He thrashes (hits several times in a row) and respawns in about 6 minutes (RestedXP). Fear him if he hits hard.

steps.text: Hearth to Menethil Harbor
Turn in the statuette quests, **War Banners** and **From the Ashes**; accept **A Friend of the Family** and **Nek'rosh's Gambit**

quests.name: A Friend of the Family
quests.note: turn in to Bolvar at part 5's Stormwind stop

steps.note: Nek'rosh's Gambit opens after both War Banners and From the Ashes (Wowhead). From the Ashes XP is not published; we assume 2,300, like War Banners.

steps.text: Hand in **Apprentice's Duties**, **Crocs of the Sky**, **The Cursed Crew**, **Digging Through the Ooze**, **Alchemical Hazards**
steps.note: Equip Sida's Bag. Lifting the Curse, which The Cursed Crew opens, waits for part 5.

steps.text: Flying Osprey wreck south of town: kill Bluegill Raiders and loot **Nord'el**
steps.note: The wreck lies just south of the city (Wowhead quest text). The raiders are level 28–29 and come in pairs.

steps.text: Turn in **Bloom of the Heavens** to Sylessa and accept part 2
steps.note: Part 2 goes to Auberdine, which you pass on the Ashenvale trip later in this part. Part 1 XP is not published; we assume about 2,950.

steps.text: Bridge: turn in **In Search of the Excavation Team** to Tarrel Rockweaver

quests.name: In Search of the Excavation Team

steps.text: Take the road east to Angerfang Encampment
steps.note: About 4 minutes from the bridge.

steps.text: Angerfang: click the Dragonmaw Catapult to complete **Nek'rosh's Gambit**; skip **Defeat Nek'rosh**
steps.note: Defeat Nek'rosh is a level-32 elite. If From the Ashes came late, do its plans here and use the fallback after the Ashenvale hearth.

steps.text: Howin: turn in **Crimson Crate Delivery** and accept **Razormaw Needling**
steps.note: Take Trying Times now if he didn't offer it on your first visit. Crate XP is not published; we assume about 1,100.

steps.text: Raptor Ridge: kill Highland Razormaws for 10 Razormaw Incisors and loot 12 Razormaw Eggs
steps.note: The Razormaw Matriarch (level 31, rare) also lives here. Carnage's cave is at the north end (69, 29); leave it for part 5.

steps.text: Howin: turn in **Razormaw Needling** and **Trying Times**
steps.note: XP is not published; we assume about 2,950 each, like a Classic level-29 quest.

steps.text: Optional: loot a Dragonmaw Armaments pile at the edge of Dragonmaw Retreat to start **Forced Disarmament**
steps.note: The piles sit in a camp of level 29–30 elites. Grab one only if nothing is near it.

steps.text: Hearth to Menethil if your hearthstone is ready; if not, run west along the road
steps.note: The run takes about 5 minutes. Either way the hearthstone is ready again long before you leave Ashenvale.

steps.text: Menethil docks: take the ship to Auberdine in Darkshore
steps.note: The Menethil–Auberdine ship still runs at launch. If no ship comes in 10 minutes, grind Dragonmaw at Angerfang and Raptor Ridge to 29.4 instead (about 410 kills).

steps.text: Auberdine: learn the flight path from Caylais Moonfeather
steps.note: Auberdine and Astranaar are linked by a 2.5-minute flight (ForeverDB), and parts 5 and 9 use both.

steps.text: Turn in **Bloom of the Heavens** to Thundris Windweaver; accept **Unrequited Love** from Archaeologist Hollee

quests.name: Unrequited Love
quests.note: Hollee's Note, for Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil

steps.note: Hollee's Note starts Unrequited Love; if she doesn't offer it, skip it. Neither quest's XP is published: we assume about 600 for Bloom of the Heavens, a delivery.

steps.text: Run south out of Auberdine on the road into Ashenvale, to Maestra's Post
steps.note: About 8 minutes. Kill only what blocks the road.

steps.text: Maestra's Post: accept **Bathran's Hair** from Orendil Broadleaf
steps.note: It opens the Pelturas chain that ends with Fallen Sky Lake (3,050 XP).

steps.text: Go back north to Bathran's Haunt and pick 5 **Bathran's Hair** from the plant bundles
steps.note: The bundles look like small brown sacks on the ground, east of the road. Forsaken guard the ruins.

steps.text: Maestra's Post: turn in **Bathran's Hair** and accept **Orendil's Cure**
Follow the road south-east to Astranaar
Astranaar: learn the flight path from Daelyshia
steps.note: Astranaar flies to Auberdine, Stonetalon Peak and Talrendis Point (ForeverDB).

steps.text: Astranaar: turn in **Orendil's Cure** (Pelturas); accept **Elune's Tear**, **Raene's Cleansing**, **Culling the Threat**, **Kayneth Stillwind**
steps.note: Raene stands by the inn, Pelturas just south of it, and Shindrell (who gives Kayneth Stillwind) by the flight master.

steps.text: Swim to the island in Iris Lake, east of town, and take **Elune's Tear**
Astranaar: turn in **Elune's Tear** to Pelturas and accept **The Ruins of Stardust**
Thistlefur Village, north of town: kill Dal Bloodclaw and take his skull
steps.note: He is level 25 and walks with Thistlefur furbolgs (level 23–24); pull them away from him first.

steps.text: Head west to Teronis' Corpse: turn in **Raene's Cleansing** and accept part 2
steps.note: Teronis lies on the shore among the Saltspittle murlocs.

steps.text: Kill Saltspittle murlocs around the corpse until the **Glowing Gem** drops
steps.note: They are level 19–21, so they die fast.

steps.text: Shrine of Aessina, just south: accept **The Howling Vale** (Melyria) and **Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!** (Illiyana)
steps.note: Both stand at this shrine, not at Forest Song (ForeverDB). You come back here to hand in at the end.

steps.text: Ruins of Stardust, south-east: pick 5 **Handfuls of Stardust** from the Stardust Covered Bushes
steps.note: Shadethicket elementals (level 22–24) walk the ruins.

steps.text: Astranaar: hand in **The Ruins of Stardust**, **Raene's Cleansing**, **Culling the Threat**; accept **Fallen Sky Lake** and Raene's next
steps.note: Raene's next quest sends you to Shael'dryn at the moonwell north-east of town. She also offers An Aggressive Defense; see the skipped list.

steps.text: Raynewood Retreat moonwell: turn in **Raene's Cleansing** to Shael'dryn and accept the next part

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.note: 4 of 11: Wooden Key and Iron Shaft

steps.text: Howling Vale, north: read the **Tome of Mel'Thandris** at the ruined shrine
steps.note: Ghostpaw Alphas (level 27–28) roam the vale.

steps.text: North-east, near the Felwood border: kill corrupted ancients for the **Wooden Key**, then open the Worn Chest
steps.note: The chest (54.4, 35.3) holds the Iron Shaft. The ancients stand right around it.

steps.text: Shael'dryn: turn in **Raene's Cleansing** and accept the next part
steps.note: The last rod piece (Iron Pommel) is near Fallen Sky Lake in the south-east; you get it later on this trip.

steps.text: Follow the road east to Xavian: turn in **Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!** to Anilia; accept **The Branch of Cenarius**
steps.note: Anilia is badly hurt among the satyrs; Geltharis, who took the branch, stands by the arch to the north.

steps.text: Forest Song: turn in **Kayneth Stillwind**; accept **Forsaken Diseases** and **Vengeful Trail** (Maseara Autumnmoon)
steps.note: Forest Song has no flight path, so you walk back west at the end.

steps.text: Satyrnaar, just west of Forest Song: search among the Bleakheart satyrs for the **Vine-Wrapped Scroll**
steps.note: The scroll's exact spot is not published yet. The satyrs here are level 26–28.

steps.text: South to the Forsaken camp by Dor'danil Barrow Den: take a **Bottle of Disease**
steps.note: The Forsaken here are level 28–30. Pass well east of Splintertree Post, a Horde town at 73, 61, on the way.

steps.text: Forest Song: turn in **Forsaken Diseases** and **Vengeful Trail**; accept **Shared Fury**
steps.note: Skip Kayneth's next quest, Insane Druids: its three level-32 ghosts sit deep in the barrow den and the hand-in is back here.

steps.text: Xavian: kill 5 each of Xavian Rogues, Felsworn, Betrayers and Hellcallers, and Geltharis for the branch
steps.note: Geltharis is level 32, so clear the satyrs around the north arch before you pull him.

steps.text: Stay at Xavian and kill any Xavian satyrs until level 28.8
steps.note: About 112 kills (about 22,000 XP, 67 minutes): Ashenvale's quests fall that far short of the 29.4 that part 5 starts at. Stop early if rested XP or the new quests paid more than we assume.

steps.text: Forest Song: turn in **Shared Fury** to Maseara Autumnmoon
steps.note: Its XP is not published; we assume about 2,450, like a Classic level-30 quest.

steps.text: South-west near Fallen Sky Lake: kill Rotting Slimes until one drops a Rusty Chest; take the **Iron Pommel**
steps.note: Classic players got the chest after a few slimes around 70, 75. The slimes are low level and die in seconds.

steps.text: Fallen Sky Lake: kill the Shadethicket Oracle and loot the **Fallen Moonstone**
steps.note: The oracle is level 30 with Shadethicket elementals (level 25–27) around her; pull them one by one.

steps.text: North-west of the lake: pick up the **Gleaming Crescent Necklace** to start its quest
steps.note: It lies at 63.0, 71.6 among Shadethicket Stone Movers (ForeverDB). The quest is a delivery to Maliynn in Astranaar.

steps.text: Head north-west to Shael'dryn: turn in **Raene's Cleansing** and accept the next part
steps.note: She rebuilds Dartol's Rod and sends you to a hidden shrine just south-east.

steps.text: Hidden Shrine: re-enchant the rod to finish **Raene's Cleansing**, then accept the next part from the shrine
Shael'dryn: turn in **Raene's Cleansing** and accept the next part, for Raene
Astranaar: turn in **Raene's Cleansing**, **Fallen Sky Lake** and **Gleaming Crescent Necklace**; accept Raene's next part
steps.note: Maliynn, who takes the necklace, sells food by the inn. The necklace XP is not published; we assume about 700.

steps.text: South near Lake Mystral: use **Dartol's Rod of Transformation**, then speak to Krolg to finish **Raene's Cleansing**
steps.note: The rod turns you into a furbolg for 3 minutes, so Krolg will talk to you. Accept his task, Raene's next part.

steps.text: South-east of Krolg: kill Ran Bloodtooth and 4 Bloodtooth Guards
steps.note: Ran is level 30 and his guards 27–28; kill the guards first.

steps.text: Use the rod again and turn in **Raene's Cleansing** to Krolg; accept the last part
steps.note: The rod has a 1-minute cooldown.

steps.text: Astranaar: turn in the last **Raene's Cleansing** to Raene Wolfrunner
Shrine of Aessina: turn in **The Howling Vale** (Melyria) and **The Branch of Cenarius** (Illiyana)
steps.note: Skip the follow-ups: Velinde Starsong goes on to Darnassus, Ratchet and Booty Bay, and Satyr Slaying! needs 16 horns from the satyrs at the far end of the zone.

steps.text: Hearth to Menethil Harbor
steps.note: If From the Ashes came late, hand it in to Stoutfist now, take Nek'rosh's Gambit and light the catapult (47.5, 46.9) on your walk east.

steps.text: Bridge outside Menethil: turn in **Unrequited Love** to Tarrel Rockweaver
steps.note: Only if Hollee gave it to you. It is a small delivery; we assume about 100 XP at your level.

steps.text: Walk east along the road to the crossroads, then south toward Thelgen Rock
steps.note: About 5 minutes.

steps.text: Optional: grab the Tattered Spellbook at Nek'rosh's camp to start **Old Habits**
steps.note: It is on your walk to Thelgen Rock; skip it if Nek'rosh stands on it. Its rewards include the Flamescarred Spellbook (off-hand), and you hand it in to Stoutfist in part 5.

steps.text: Level 29.4: you are at the Excavation Site approach, on the path left of Thelgen Rock
steps.note: Form your Excavation group here; part 5 starts with the dungeon. Your hearthstone is on cooldown for about an hour.

openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: how much the new Forever quests here pay. ForeverDB has no XP yet for Bloom of the Heavens, Ira's Dagger, The Valor Family, Return the Statuette, From the Ashes, Crimson Crate Delivery, Razormaw Needling, Trying Times, Vengeful Trail, Shared Fury, Gleaming Crescent Necklace and Unrequited Love, or for The Stockade Riots. We assume Classic-like values; if they pay more or less, the satyr top-up at Xavian shrinks or grows to match.

Not confirmed yet: how reliable the Menethil–Auberdine ship is. Blizzard fixed lost boats on Nov 5, but one player still reported missing boats on Nov 6. If it does not come, grind at Angerfang and Raptor Ridge to 29.4 instead (about 410 kills); parts 5 and 9 then learn the Auberdine and Astranaar flight paths when they first land in Auberdine.
Not confirmed yet: whether Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine gives Unrequited Love. Wowhead only says it starts from Hollee's Note.

Not confirmed yet: where the Vine-Wrapped Scroll for Vengeful Trail lies in Satyrnaar, and whether Rotting Slimes still drop the Rusty Chest with the Iron Pommel (Wowhead places the chest at 68–69, 77–82).
If no group will take you at about 23.9, use the 15-minute fallback. The Stockade quests need only level 22 (ForeverDB), but Bazil Thredd is a level-29 elite.

If you play on a PvP realm (where players can attack each other in contested zones), expect Horde players at 27–28 in Ashenvale; Splintertree Post, a Horde town, sits next to the Xavian and Forest Song quests.
Not confirmed yet: whether the Valor ghosts (Lost Stalker → Ira's Dagger) need The Valor Family handed in first. We hand it in first to be safe; ForeverDB has no pick-up record for Ira's Dagger.

Not confirmed yet: what Howin Kindfeather's quests need first. Trying Times and Death to the Dragonmaw may need This Land Was Their Land, and Razormaw Needling needs Crocs of the Sky → Crimson Crate Delivery (Wowhead).

Not confirmed yet: whether Strong Anti-Venom helps in the Excavation Site. It only cures poisons (Wowhead), but beta players reported the Excavation debuffs as diseases, so a priest, paladin or shaman in the group helps more.

If you carry Death to the Dragonmaw, Carnage or Forced Disarmament, treat them as group quests in part 5 or skip them. The first two target level 29–30 elites (Wowhead), and Forced Disarmament starts inside elite-filled Dragonmaw Retreat.
Not confirmed yet: how long the Dun Algaz walk from Thelsamar to the crossroads takes. RestedXP's Classic "deathless" mountain path from Dun Morogh into the Wetlands is an untested alternative.

If Captain Stoutfist only offers From the Ashes when you hand in War Banners, Nek'rosh's Gambit is still open when you leave for Ashenvale: hand in From the Ashes after the Ashenvale hearth and light the catapult on your walk east.

Not confirmed yet: the Stormwind and Redridge coordinates on Forever's redrawn maps (Ursula Deline 39.8, 84.2; Warden Thelwater 51.5, 69.3; Dungar Longdrink 71.2, 72.4; Guard Berton 21.2, 46.6). Check them in game.
Not confirmed yet: two kill counts. Wowhead's Forever tooltips ask for 6 Young Crocolisk Skins (Classic 4) and 12 Fen Creepers (Classic 8).

legs.title: Excavation Site, Duskwood, Dalaran, Desolace & Arathi
legs.summary: Run the Excavation Site once at about 29.5 with its quests, clear the northern Wetlands and take the new ship from Menethil to Southshore. After Farren’s coast chain, the city stop trains you in Ironforge, picks up the Dalaran quests in Stormwind, sends you to Darkshire for the Duskwood quests you left in part 4, and runs Gnomeregan. Clear Alterac on the way to one City of Dalaran run, sail from Southshore to Kalimdor for a loop of Desolace, then hearth back and finish in Arathi at Refuge Pointe.
legs.why: This part follows the launch Alliance trail: the Wetlands at 29–31, Southshore at 31, the cities, Alterac and Dalaran at 32–33, then Arathi (the launch leaderboard). The Excavation Site and City of Dalaran are run once, with every Alliance quest in your log, because the quests are the reward: the Excavation pays 4,900 + 6,150 + 1,250 + 6,150 XP and each Alliance Dalaran quest 9,400. The northern Wetlands is one loop, since the Dun Modr camp holds three chains a few hundred yards apart. Farren’s coast chain comes before the city stop so Reassignment (3,200 XP) goes in at Stormwind Keep on the same visit as the Dalaran pickups. From Stormwind you fly to Darkshire for five Duskwood quests you could not do at 24 (about 12,000 quest XP plus kills in under an hour); at launch, 16 of 27 Alliance players at level 31 were in Duskwood, the Gnome Warlock duo among them. After Dalaran, the new Southshore ship takes you to Desolace, the classic Alliance speed route’s 33–35 zone: about 47,000 quest XP and 25,000 kill XP in about 2.7 hours, counting the trip there. Those two trips replace most of the old 400-kill Witherbark grind; about 135 kills are left, at Witherbark Village, where Worth Its Weight in Gold takes you anyway. By our estimate Desolace beats grinding the same XP by only about 20% (half an hour), so if the ships fail, simply grind longer at Witherbark.
legs.estTime: About 13.5–14.5 h /played: about 9 h for the quests and the three dungeon runs, 0.85 h for the Duskwood return, 2.7 h for Desolace including the trip there, and about 135 grind kills (1.4 h at 100 kills an hour).
legs.start: Level about 29.4 at the Excavation Site approach in the Wetlands (the path left of Thelgen Rock, 53.9, 65.4). Hearth: Menethil Harbor; you used it at the end of part 4, and it is ready again before you need it. You trained 22 and 24 in Stormwind; 26, 28 and 30 come at this part’s Ironforge stop. Flight paths include Darkshire, Menethil, Auberdine and Astranaar. You carry the Excavation quests (Lost in the Thicket Things, Horrors in the Highland), Death to the Dragonmaw, Carnage and A Friend of the Family, plus Forced Disarmament, Old Habits or Understanding Our Present if you picked them up, and Nek’rosh’s Gambit only if part 4 could not finish it. Done: The Cursed Crew (so Lifting the Curse is open), the Stockade and its quests, Bloom of the Heavens and Hollee’s Unrequited Love.
legs.end: Level 35.3 at Refuge Pointe (Arathi Highlands), flight path learned. Hearth: Southshore. You trained 26, 28, 30 and 32 in Ironforge; talents are Affliction for drain-tanking (Siphon Life at 30). New flight paths: Southshore, Refuge Pointe and Nijel’s Point. You carry Power Overwhelming and A Green Sample (both complete, for Stormwind), Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators (complete, for Shoni in Stormwind), Letter to Stormpike and The Karnitol Shipwreck (both for the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge), Noble Deaths (for Southshore), A Fine Mess (for Scooty in Booty Bay) if you escorted Kernobee, and a Hints of a New Plague? step if you are mid-chain. Done: the Excavation Site, Gnomeregan, City of Dalaran (Starving Arcane only if one run finished it), the Duskwood return and Desolace. Abandon Friend of the Kirin Tor and Return of the Ring if you skipped their turn-ins.

skipped.name: Spark of Freedom
skipped.why: An escort of an elite fire elemental out of Dun Modr, through elite Dark Irons; its XP is unknown.

skipped.name: Songblade Search
skipped.why: Its follow-up, Fallen in the Fen, ends in Lakeshire, which the route never revisits.

skipped.name: Highland Hides
skipped.why: Reported bugged in the beta, and it does not count as a dungeon quest.

skipped.name: Changing Tastes
skipped.why: A Horde quest (Borstan, Orgrimmar), so it cannot be in your log.

skipped.name: Moldy Tome murlocs (Felhunter chain)
skipped.why: You skip the Felhunter: its chain has five far-apart stops.

skipped.name: Crushridge Warmongers
skipped.why: Level-40 elites.

skipped.name: Strahnbrad Mystery
skipped.why: Level 36; part 6 does it on its trip back north.

skipped.name: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak
skipped.why: Needs a crafted Hillman’s Cloak, wool and thread as well as yeti fur.

skipped.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
skipped.why: 10 Turtle Meat from turtles off the route; about as slow as grinding.

skipped.name: Valik
skipped.why: 270 XP, and it needs a Southshore Stout.

skipped.name: Stromgarde Badges
skipped.why: Its badges drop from elite Syndicate inside Stromgarde Keep; part 6 skips it too.

skipped.name: The Princess Trapped → Stones of Binding
skipped.why: Levels 37–38, across Drywhisker Gorge and three stone circles; part 6 does it.

skipped.name: Wand over Fist
skipped.why: Level 39; part 6 does it.

skipped.name: Dutiful Steps / Ground to Keep
skipped.why: Level 38–39 Stromgarde quests with elite targets inside the keep; part 6 skips them too.

skipped.name: A Way In (Ravenholdt chain)
skipped.why: Rogues only.

skipped.name: Blood in the Streets / Shrewd Negotiations / Opportunistic Education
skipped.why: Horde City of Dalaran quests.

skipped.name: An Acquaintance in Southshore / Take Two With Water (Drowned City)
skipped.why: Level 40.

skipped.name: The Day After → Gnogaine → The Only Cure is More Green Glow
skipped.why: A level 27–30 Gnomeregan chain through Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos: an extra stop and a two-hour turn-in timer. Take it only if you pass Kharanos anyway.

skipped.name: The Valor Family (part 2)
skipped.why: It seems to need all four Valor family weapons (beta players found the chain unfinished), and it sends you back to Raven Hill.

skipped.name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc. (part 3)
skipped.why: Level 40: 30 drops from Mannoroc demons of level 37–40, slower than grinding.

skipped.name: Gizelton Caravan
skipped.why: Starts at the far south-west end of the caravan road, makes you wait for the caravan, and runs past level 37–40 demons.

skipped.name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
skipped.why: Its ghosts are level 38–39, in the Valley of Bones at the far south-east of Desolace.

skipped.name: Down the Scarlet Path / Brother Anton
skipped.why: 30 Undead Ravagers of level 37–39 in the Valley of Bones: slower than grinding, with a hand-in back at Nijel’s Point.

skipped.name: Get Me Out of Here!
skipped.why: A level-39 escort out of a centaur camp.

skipped.name: Strange Alliance / Brutal Politics (centaur reputation chains)
skipped.why: Long reputation grinds that the classic Alliance speed route also skips; the new Valley of Bones chains need Honored with a clan.

skipped.name: Dustwallow Marsh (Theramore)
skipped.why: About a third of Desolace’s quest XP for the same kind of boat ride. Use it only if the Auberdine ships fail and the Theramore ship runs.

steps.text: At the meeting stone, stock food, water and 2–3 **Strong Anti-Venom**, then find a group
steps.at: Excavation Site path, left of Thelgen Rock

quests.name: Changing Tastes
quests.note: Horde quest (Borstan, Orgrimmar); it won't be in your log

items.name: Strong Anti-Venom
items.note: reward of Alchemical Hazards; cures poison up to level 35

steps.note: Spiders and lurkers poison you; Thicket Hunters add a disease a warlock cannot cleanse. The meeting stone is at the foot of the path.

steps.text: Climb the winding path to the dungeon entrance; the spiders on the way are not elite
steps.note: Method lists a 20–35 minute clear for levels 26–33. The quests are level 31, so arriving at about 29.5 is fine.

steps.text: Kill **Saltspine** (crocolisk) and **Shadetooth** (raptor); ignore Daewyn's tent unless you carry Songblade Search

mobs.name: Saltspine
mobs.note: first boss; pull it from a dry spot

mobs.name: Shadetooth
mobs.note: second boss; clear the hidden raptors first, they call for help

steps.note: Shadetooth fears and enrages at low health. Dungeon kills pay about a quarter of normal XP; the quests are the reward.

steps.text: Kill the **Highland Horror** (third boss) and loot the Horrible Rootcore

mobs.name: Highland Horror
mobs.note: optional boss for Horde, needed by Alliance; drops only the quest item

steps.note: It roots the whole group; interrupt Wild Regeneration.

steps.text: Find Ardin Grassman on the wooden platform by the Site of the Guardian; turn in, accept **Heartwoven**
steps.note: 4,900 XP. Heartwoven goes back to Caitlin in Menethil.

steps.text: Click the Archival Panel beside the column, kill the **Relic Guardian**, loot the **Titan Relic**

mobs.name: Relic Guardian
mobs.note: tank-and-heal check: Thunderclap and knockbacks, keep away from the edge

items.name: Titan Relic
items.note: right-click to start Lost Relic Carry

steps.note: Never abandon Lost Relic Carry or Prehistoric Prism: in the beta the relic vanished and could not be looted again.

steps.text: If **Nek'rosh's Gambit** is still in your log, light the catapult at Angerfang
steps.note: Part 4 normally burns the catapult already; then skip this step.

steps.text: With a group: at the catapult accept **Defeat Nek'rosh**; kill Chieftain Nek'rosh in the camp
steps.note: Level-32 elite: group only. Hand his head to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil (2,550 XP).

steps.text: West edge of Dragonmaw Retreat: kill **Maddened Rotclaws** (bears) for the **Malignant Rotclaw Flesh**

mobs.name: Maddened Rotclaw
mobs.note: more of them north toward Direforge Hill

steps.note: The flesh is the bait you need to lure Carnage on Raptor Ridge. If your group has left, skip this and the Carnage steps.

steps.text: Dragonmaw Retreat, west to east: loot 30 **Dragonmaw Armaments** and kill the Dragonmaw for **Death to the Dragonmaw**

quests.name: Forced Disarmament
quests.note: if it is not in your log, loot any Dragonmaw Armaments container to start it

steps.note: Wowhead marks all three orc types elite. Ask your Excavation group to stay for this, Carnage and the Dun Modr elites.

steps.text: Raptor Ridge cave: use the flesh to lure **Carnage** (elite raptor) and take its head

mobs.name: Carnage
mobs.note: elite beast: Fear works on it

steps.note: Bane of Agony (Forever’s name for Curse of Agony) and Corruption, then drain. Carnage is elite: solo with no group, skip it.

steps.text: Dun Modr camp: accept **The Thandol Span** (Rhag Garmason) and **Bring Back a Bang** (Ashlan Stonesmirk)
steps.note: Bring Back a Bang is a new level-31 quest; ForeverDB players found its giver here.

steps.text: With a group: also accept **The Dark Iron War** (Motley Garmason) and **A Grim Task** (Longbraid the Grim)
steps.note: Both need elite Dark Irons: 2,450 and 3,350 XP. Solo, leave them.

steps.text: Direforge Hill camps east of the camp: grab 3 red-marked **Stolen Explosives**
steps.note: ForeverDB players found the explosives at 61.2, 26.0. Wowhead marks these Dark Irons elite: take barrels at the camp edges and pull singles.

steps.text: With a group: clear Dark Irons on Direforge Hill and in Dun Modr; kill **Balgaras the Foul** for his ear
steps.note: Do the Direforge Hill part while you collect the explosives. Balgaras is a level-34 elite warlock.

steps.text: Back at the camp, turn in **Bring Back a Bang**
steps.note: ForeverDB has not logged who takes it back yet; Ashlan, the giver, is the likely one. Reward: Ez-Thro Dynamite.

steps.text: With a group: turn in **The Dark Iron War** and **A Grim Task** at the camp
On the road north toward the bridge, accept **Hearts of the Lost** from Corma Villard
steps.note: New level-33 chain: Corma wants her wife Essene found beyond the Dark Irons on the bridge.

steps.text: Walk onto the Thandol Span; find Ol' Rustlocke's corpse below deck; take his parchment
steps.note: Go halfway across and take the door that leads down. Each Thandol Span step pays 2,500 XP.

steps.text: Find Essene past the Dark Irons; turn in **Hearts of the Lost**; recover her three belongings for her
steps.note: No database has Essene's or her belongings' positions yet; the quest text puts her just past the Dark Iron ambush. Give it 10 minutes at most.

steps.text: Back at Rhag's camp: turn in the parchment; accept **The Thandol Span** (part 3)
Cross the span into Arathi; destroy the **Cache of Explosives** in the Dark Iron camp
steps.note: These Arathi-side Dark Irons are normal mobs.

steps.text: Walk back: give Corma Essene's note; at the camp turn in part 3 and take **Plea to the Alliance**

quests.name: Plea to the Alliance
quests.note: carry it to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe, at the end of this part

steps.text: Run south to Rethiel: turn in **Horrors in the Highland** and **Carnage**
steps.note: Horrors pays 6,150 XP; if your group left before Carnage, just hand in Horrors.

steps.text: Howin's camp on the road: turn in **Death to the Dragonmaw**
steps.note: Howin also offers Stopping the Cycle: take it only with a group (optional steps below).

steps.text: With a group: accept **Stopping the Cycle** from Howin Kindfeather
steps.note: A level-34 group quest at the Dragonmaw Gates; its follow-up is a free hand-in to King Magni in Ironforge.

steps.text: With a group: kill the **Subdued Dragonspawn** at the Dragonmaw Gates; back at Howin, take **Word to Ironforge**
steps.note: Hand it in to Howin on your way to Whelgar: the quest text names him, but the hand-in is not logged yet. XP for both is not published.

steps.text: Whelgar's camp: turn in **Lost Relic Carry**; accept **Prehistoric Prism** (Ironforge)
steps.note: Do not abandon Prehistoric Prism; the relic cannot be replaced.

steps.text: With a group only: Goaz Stone on the Goaz Warder, then on the four golems for **Gleaning Our Future**

quests.name: For Further Study
quests.note: Historian Karnik, Ironforge, at the city stop

steps.note: All five constructs are level-32 elites, and Ados and Golm sit at opposite ends of the zone. Solo, skip the chain.

steps.text: Hearth to Menethil Harbor
steps.note: Your hearth is ready again long before you use it in Ironforge (1-hour cooldown).

steps.text: Menethil: give **Heartwoven** to Caitlin and **Forced Disarmament** to Stoutfist; accept **Lifting the Curse** from Fitzsimmons

quests.name: Old Habits
quests.note: only if you looted the Tattered Spellbook in part 4

quests.name: Lifting the Curse
quests.note: opened by The Cursed Crew, done in part 4

steps.note: Heartwoven's XP is not logged yet; we assume about 2,500. Old Habits also goes to Stoutfist if you looted the Tattered Spellbook in part 4.

steps.text: Intrepid wreck: kill **Captain Halyndor** for the key; open the strongbox; take **The Eye of Paleth**

quests.name: Lifting the Curse
quests.note: turned in at the Intrepid’s Locked Strongbox

steps.note: The three-quest chain pays about 4,850 XP (the last part in Stormwind) for ~12 minutes. Do it while the ship is away.

steps.text: Back in Menethil: give **The Eye of Paleth** to Glorin Steelbrow; accept **Cleansing the Eye**

quests.name: Cleansing the Eye
quests.note: Archbishop Benedictus, Cathedral of Light, at the city stop

steps.note: Glorin stands a few steps from Fitzsimmons, so this fits the wait for the ship.

steps.text: Take the ship to **Southshore**; check its destination before boarding
steps.note: ForeverDB lists a new Menethil → Southshore → Auberdine ship. If it never comes, walk: Thandol Span, Arathi, then west through Thoradin's Wall (about as long).

steps.text: Southshore: learn the flight path from Darla Harris
steps.note: Southshore links to Ironforge (3 min 26 s), Menethil, Refuge Pointe, Aerie Peak and Chillwind.

steps.text: Barn east of the flight master: accept **Costly Menace** from Darren Malvew
Inn: set your hearthstone to Southshore with Innkeeper Anderson
Outside the inn: accept **Down the Coast** (Farren Orinelle) and **Hints of a New Plague?** (Phin Odelic)

quests.name: Hints of a New Plague?
quests.note: leads to Quae in Arathi, at the end of this part

steps.note: The Shamed Lieutenant (Stormwind) also leads to Farren; in Classic his chain works without it.

steps.text: Town hall: accept **Syndicate Assassins** (Maleb) and **An Alarming Request** (Emissary Jacques); outside, **Crushridge Bounty** (Redpath)

quests.name: An Alarming Request
quests.note: City of Dalaran attunement; needs level 30

steps.text: Coast south-west of town: kill 10 Torn Fin Tidehunters and 10 Torn Fin Oracles
Farren: turn in **Down the Coast**; accept **Farren's Proof**
Western Strand: kill Torn Fin murlocs until you have 10 **Murloc Heads**
Turn in **Farren's Proof**, take the sack to Redpath, back to Farren; accept **Stormwind Ho!**
Shore south-east of the dock: kill 10 Daggerspine Shorehunters and 10 Daggerspine Sirens
Farren: turn in **Stormwind Ho!**; accept **Reassignment** for Stormwind Keep

quests.name: Reassignment
quests.note: 3,200 XP at Major Samuelson, at the city stop

steps.text: Fly Southshore → **Ironforge** (3 min 26 s)
steps.note: The launch Gnome Warlock went the same way: Ironforge at 30.6, Stormwind at 31.0, straight after the Wetlands.

steps.text: Hall of Explorers: turn in **Prehistoric Prism**; accept **Reclaimers' Business in Desolace** from Roetten Stonehammer

quests.name: Reclaimers' Business in Desolace
quests.note: turn in to Kreldig Ungor at Nijel’s Point, Desolace

steps.note: Prism: 6,150 XP, and Healer's Staff is the caster pick. Reclaimers' Business opens Kreldig's Desolace quests later in this part.

steps.text: Group option only: give **Word to Ironforge** to King Magni in the High Seat
Forlorn Cavern: train every spell for levels 26, 28 and 30 (part 4 trained up to 24)
steps.note: Shadow Bolt and Bane of Agony get new ranks at 28, Drain Life at 30. Shadow Ward comes at 32, after Gnomeregan.

steps.text: Check talents for drain-tanking: Fel Concentration 3/3, Improved Drains, level-30 point into **Siphon Life**
steps.note: Our all-Affliction order needs no respec. Reset at the trainer only if you went Demonology for the Voidwalker.

steps.text: Take the Deeprun Tram from Tinker Town to Stormwind
steps.note: About a minute; you arrive in the Dwarven District. Take the Gnomeregan quests when you come back: your log is too full for them in Duskwood.

steps.text: Stormwind Keep: give **Reassignment** to Major Samuelson and **A Friend of the Family** to Bolvar; take the next part
steps.note: Stormwind spots use Forever's harbor-era city map.

steps.text: Cathedral: give **A Friend of the Family** to Grayson Shadowbreaker and **Cleansing the Eye** to Benedictus; accept **The Shamed Lieutenant**

quests.name: The Shamed Lieutenant
quests.note: free hand-in to Farren after the hearth

steps.note: XP for the two statuette follow-ups is not logged yet; we assume about 1,000 each.

steps.text: Outside the Cathedral: accept **Tinkmaster Overspark** from Brother Sarno

quests.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
quests.note: talk to Overspark in Tinker Town before you take the Gnomeregan quests

steps.note: It is the first link of the Techbot chain, so Overspark may not offer Save Techbot's Brain! without it. It costs half a minute.

steps.text: Mage Quarter, Wizard's Sanctum: accept **Power Overwhelming** (Andromath) and **Malin's Request** (Archmage Malin)

quests.name: Power Overwhelming
quests.note: 9,400 XP; kill the Arcanic Enigma in Dalaran

quests.name: Malin's Request
quests.note: breadcrumb to Refuge Pointe; opens Worth Its Weight in Gold

steps.text: The Park: accept **A Green Sample** from Shylamiir

quests.name: A Green Sample
quests.note: 9,400 XP; the Fel Ancient's blossom in Runeweaver Square

steps.text: Stormwind: fly to **Darkshire** from Dungar Longdrink (1 min 56 s)
steps.note: Start looking for a Gnomeregan group now; you are back in Stormwind within the hour.

steps.text: Darkshire: accept the next **The Night Watch**, **Look to the Stars** and **Worgen in the Woods**
steps.note: You did the earlier parts of all three in part 4. At launch, 16 of 27 Alliance players at level 31 were in Duskwood.

steps.text: Run west to Raven Hill; kill the **Lost Watcher** ghost and loot **Merrick's Bow** to start its quest

quests.name: Merrick's Bow
quests.note: starts from the Lost Watcher’s drop

mobs.note: one of the four Valor family ghosts

steps.text: Raven Hill Cemetery, eastern crypts: kill 20 **Plague Spreaders**
steps.note: They are green to you now and come in groups; Fear the extras.

steps.text: South to the Vul'Gol ogre mound: kill **Zzarc'Vul** for his monocle, 8 Splinter Fist Warriors and 4 Taskmasters
steps.note: Zzarc'Vul is a normal level-30 ogre inside the mound. The gnolls camp around its entrance.

steps.text: East along the south edge: kill 8 **Nightbane Vile Fangs** and 8 **Nightbane Tainted Ones**
steps.note: Both kinds stand around 60, 81; more of both wait near 72, 70 on your way back north.

steps.text: Darkshire: turn in **The Night Watch**, **Look to the Stars**, **Worgen in the Woods** and **Merrick's Bow**

steps.text: Fly back to **Stormwind** from Felicia Maline

quests.note: 24 Robo-mechanical Guts in Gnomeregan; hand in to Shoni at part 6's Stormwind stop

steps.note: The tram station is in the Dwarven District, so Shoni is on your way back to Ironforge.

steps.text: Tram back to Ironforge; in Tinker Town turn in **Tinkmaster Overspark**, then accept the four Gnomeregan quests

quests.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
quests.note: Tinkmaster Overspark himself; this opens Save Techbot's Brain!

steps.note: Beta players measured about 46,000 XP from its Alliance quests. If no group forms within 15 minutes, skip it and grind about 45,000 XP more at the end.

steps.text: Leave Ironforge by the front gate and run west to Gnomeregan’s entrance

quests.name: A Fine Mess

quests.name: Grime-Encrusted Ring

quests.name: Grime-Encrusted Ring
quests.note: only if the ring drops; clean it in the Sparklematic 5200 inside

steps.text: Crushridge ogres west of the camp: loot 9 **Dirty Knucklebones**

steps.text: Head west across the hills to Dalaran's sewer gate on the Lordamere Lake shore
steps.note: The gate is at 8.8, 59.6 on the Alterac map. Dalaran has no flight master.

steps.text: Image of Archmage Modera: turn in **An Alarming Request**; accept **Heart of Disruption** and **Starving Arcane**
