openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: whether the new Southshore → Auberdine ship runs reliably, and how long you wait for it. If it does not come, fly to Menethil and take the Auberdine ship there; if no ship to Kalimdor runs, skip Desolace and grind at Witherbark instead.
Not confirmed yet: who gives Vahlarriel’s Vengeance and what it pays. We assume Vahlarriel at Nijel’s Point and about 3,000 XP.
Not confirmed yet: Merrick’s Bow’s XP (we assume about 2,300) and every spot where the Lost Watcher ghost appears. It was seen at Raven Hill, 16, 62.
Not confirmed yet: whether Captain Pentigast’s Carved Centaur Totems gives XP. The Kolkar you kill for Centaur Bounty drop the totems, so if it does, hand them in at Nijel’s Point.

Elites: Wowhead marks the Dragonmaw Retreat orcs, Carnage, the Direforge Hill and Dun Modr Dark Irons and the Goaz golems elite. If they are elite in game, keep your Excavation group for them, or skip Death to the Dragonmaw and Carnage.
If one City of Dalaran run finishes Starving Arcane, you gain 9,400 XP, about 40 fewer grind kills. Not confirmed yet: whether you can reach Archmage Celindra inside Dalaran after the run.
Not confirmed yet: where Essene and her three belongings are on the Thandol Span, and what her chain pays (we assume about 6,600 XP).
Not confirmed yet: who takes Bring Back a Bang back and its XP (we assume Ashlan and 3,250), and Heartwoven’s XP (we assume about 2,500).

Not confirmed yet: what each Gnomeregan quest pays. We assume about 28,000 XP at the Tinker Town turn-ins. One ForeverDB log shows 0 XP for The Grand Betrayal and for Reclaimers’ Business in Desolace; if that holds, the Witherbark top-up grows by about 30 kills.
If Farren does not offer Down the Coast without The Shamed Lieutenant, do the coast chain after the city stop and hand Reassignment in during part 6’s Stormwind visit.
If Southshore offers Hillsbrad’s Hoard or Brewer’s Trade (new level-27 quests), they are quick full-XP deliveries.
The Southshore and Menethil ship piers have no logged coordinates yet.

legs.title: Stranglethorn, Arathi, the Swamp of Sorrows & the Felsteed
legs.summary: Train in Ironforge, hand in part 5's city quests, then walk into Stranglethorn from Duskwood and quest it in three loops. At about 37.8 you leave for Alterac, Arathi and the Swamp of Sorrows, whose quests now fit your level. You finish in Booty Bay with the pirate quests, reach 40 and sail to Ratchet for the Felsteed.
legs.why: Stranglethorn is where launch racers levelled from 35 to 38 (the launch leaderboard). You enter from Duskwood because you can't fly to Booty Bay before you have been there, so the north (Rebel Camp, Nesingwary, the Kurzen cave) comes first, and each later loop starts from Booty Bay and ends with a hearth. Kurzen's Mystery and Troll Witchery ride along on loops you already walk, and leaving through the Rebel Camp puts you on the Darkshire road north. Stranglethorn runs out of quests at about 37.7, so instead of grinding there you take the zones a launch duo used from 38 to 40 (Arathi, Hillsbrad, Alterac, the Swamp of Sorrows, then Stranglethorn). In this part that means Hillsbrad and Alterac at 37.8–38.1, Arathi at 38.1–38.5 and the Swamp of Sorrows at 38.5–39. You do Alterac before Arathi because both its quests and your hearth are in Southshore, which has a direct flight to Refuge Pointe. On our estimate those quests pay about 27,000–28,000 XP an hour with their flights and walks, against about 25,000–26,000 for grinding, so the trip saves only about half an hour; each zone on its own beats grinding once you are there. Several Arathi quests turn out to need elites (Stromgarde Keep, Trelane's tower, Fozruk), so about 255 pirate kills remain at the end; they also finish Up to Snuff and Keep An Eye Out. The Felsteed spell needs only level 40 on Wowhead, and you hearth back from Ratchet instead of taking the boat.
legs.estTime: About 13.5–14.5 h /played: about 6.5 h for the Stranglethorn quests and the city stops, about 4.5 h for Alterac, Arathi, the Swamp of Sorrows and the last Stranglethorn quests with their flights and walks, about 2.5 h for some 255 pirate kills at the end, and 0.5 h for the Felsteed trip.
legs.start: You are level 35.3 at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands, and your hearthstone is set to Southshore. You trained levels 26, 28, 30 and 32 in Ironforge, with Affliction talents for drain-tanking (Siphon Life at 30). Your newest flight paths are Southshore, Refuge Pointe and Nijel's Point. You carry Power Overwhelming and A Green Sample (both complete, for Stormwind), Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators (complete, for Shoni in Stormwind), Letter to Stormpike and The Karnitol Shipwreck (both for the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge) and Noble Deaths for Magistrate Maleb; also A Fine Mess if your Gnomeregan group escorted Kernobee, and maybe a Hints of a New Plague? step. Done: the Excavation Site, Gnomeregan, the City of Dalaran, the Duskwood return, Desolace, Northfold Manor and Worth Its Weight in Gold.
legs.end: You are level 40.1 in Thelsamar (Loch Modan) with the Felsteed, and your hearthstone is set to Thelsamar. You trained level 34 in Ironforge, 36 in Stormwind, 38 in Ironforge and 40 in Ironforge. New flight paths: Booty Bay, Nethergarde Keep and Ratchet. If the Felsteed needed riding training, you bought Apprentice Riding from Binjy at Steelgrill's Depot instead. You carry Ironband Wants You! for part 7's first stop, where it opens Find Agmond.

skipped.name: Goblin Sponsorship
skipped.why: The chain starts in the Shimmering Flats and Ratchet, so its Booty Bay steps are never offered on this route.

skipped.name: Colonel Kurzen
skipped.why: Colonel Kurzen is a level-40 elite at the top of the cave, with elite guards.

skipped.name: Mai'Zoth
skipped.why: The quest after Troll Witchery is level 46.

skipped.name: Panther Mastery (the fourth, Bhag'thera)
skipped.why: Bhag'thera is an elite level-40 panther.

skipped.name: Raptor Mastery (the fourth, Tethis)
skipped.why: Tethis is an elite raptor. The third Raptor Mastery is done: its Jungle Stalkers are on your last trip north.

skipped.name: Big Game Hunter
skipped.why: King Bangalash is a level-43 elite with panther adds.

skipped.name: Voodoo Dues / Cracking Maury's Foot
skipped.why: Three named level 43–44 pirates, and Cracking Maury's Foot needs a rare key drop.

skipped.name: Akiris by the Bundle
skipped.why: Its reeds drop from level 43–44 Naga Explorers north of Booty Bay, and the second part goes to Theramore.

skipped.name: Sunken Treasure (the fifth) and Death From Below
skipped.why: Fleet Master Seahorn's letter sends you back to Faldir's Cove in Arathi.

skipped.name: Dream Dust in the Swamp / The Rumormonger
skipped.why: It needs the Shimmering Flats chain first.

skipped.name: Hunt for Yenniku, Headhunting, Mok'thardin's Enchantment, The Defense of Grom'gol
skipped.why: Horde quests from Grom'gol.

skipped.name: The Drowned City and The Gurubashi Legends of Old
skipped.why: A dungeon chain that starts with Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore at 40.

skipped.name: Partial Mystical Notes
skipped.why: It starts from a drop whose source is not published; hand it to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay only if it drops.

skipped.name: Crushridge Warmongers
skipped.why: The Warmongers are level 39–40 elites inside Crushridge Hold.

skipped.name: Stromgarde Badges
skipped.why: The badges come from elite Syndicate inside Stromgarde Keep.

skipped.name: WANTED: Marez Cowl / WANTED: Otto and Falconcrest
skipped.why: Marez Cowl (40), Otto (38) and Lord Falconcrest (40) are all elites inside Stromgarde Keep.

skipped.name: Ground to Keep / Dutiful Steps
skipped.why: New Stromgarde quests: Ground to Keep asks for 17 elite kills inside the keep, and Dutiful Steps starts in the keep's crypt among elite Syndicate.

skipped.name: Trelane's Defenses → An Apprentice's Enchantment → Attack on the Tower → Malin's Request
skipped.why: The Azure Agate drops only from elite Boulderfist Shamans, and Trelane's chests are inside their tower with elite ogres.

skipped.name: Breaking the Keystone → Myzrael's Allies
skipped.why: Fozruk is an elite level-42 giant.

skipped.name: Lost in Transit
skipped.why: It is written for Dar, who stands in the Horde town of Stonard, so it is probably a Horde quest.

skipped.name: The Visiting Mage → Notes on Draenethyst → Abridged Notes on Draenethyst
skipped.why: The chain runs through Desolace before it comes back to the Harborage.

skipped.name: Duskwood leftovers (The Night Watch, Worgen in the Woods, Look to the Stars, Mor'Ladim)
skipped.why: Part 5 does the Duskwood return; Mor'Ladim is an elite.

skipped.name: Dustwallow Marsh and the Kalimdor quests at 35–40
skipped.why: Dustwallow is part 5's fallback, and the boat trips cost more than the northern loop.

skipped.name: Devourer of Souls (Succubus via Takar)
skipped.why: Its Ashenvale step adds another continent trip, even from Ratchet.

skipped.name: Riverglades from 38
skipped.why: Its quest list is still not published, and the northern loop has quests launch players have used. Part 7 goes there at 40.

skipped.name: Group elites (Mosh'Ogg ogres, Tethis, Bhag'thera, King Bangalash, Colonel Kurzen)
skipped.why: Launch pets have reduced health, so a warlock can't solo these quickly.

steps.text: Fly from Refuge Pointe to **Ironforge**
steps.note: Refuge Pointe has a direct flight to Ironforge. You come back to Arathi at about 38 for its higher quests.

steps.text: Train your level 34 spells in the Forlorn Cavern
steps.note: Corruption rank 4 is the one that matters. From now on keep 100 g aside for level 40, in case the Felsteed also needs riding training.

steps.text: Hall of Explorers: hand in **Letter to Stormpike** and **The Karnitol Shipwreck**; accept **Further Mysteries** and **Ironband Wants You!**

quests.name: Further Mysteries
quests.note: hand it in at Southshore at about 37.8

quests.name: Ironband Wants You!
quests.note: carry it through this part: part 7 hands it in, and it opens Find Agmond

quests.name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
quests.note: carried from Desolace (part 5); 1,500 XP in Classic

steps.note: Prospector Stormpike and Roetten Stonehammer stand a few steps apart, a short walk east of the Forlorn Cavern. Further Mysteries is a letter for Magistrate Maleb in Southshore, where you stop at about 37.8.

steps.text: Optional: buy 4 **Lesser Bloodstone Ore** at the Auction House if it is cheap

quests.name: Favor for Krazek
quests.note: needs the 4 ore; then Return to Corporal Kaleb

steps.note: With the ore, Krazek in Booty Bay offers Favor for Krazek and then Return to Corporal Kaleb (4,950 XP and a helm in Classic). The classic Alliance speed route says to try the Booty Bay auction house if Ironforge has none.

steps.text: Take the Deeprun Tram to Stormwind
steps.note: The tram still runs in Forever. You arrive in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

steps.text: Dwarven District: turn in **Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators** to Shoni the Shilent
steps.note: Shoni stands next to the tram exit; ForeverDB shows players getting 4,400 XP for it. Stormwind coordinates in this part use Forever's redrawn city map.

steps.text: The Park: turn in **A Green Sample** to Shylamiir, the herbalism trainer
steps.note: 9,400 XP. Wowhead also lists her at 15.2, 49.8, her old Classic spot.

steps.text: Mage Quarter: turn in **Power Overwhelming** to High Sorcerer Andromath
steps.note: 9,400 XP, logged by players on ForeverDB. Players found him at 48.8, 87.8.

steps.text: Fly from Dungar Longdrink to **Darkshire**
steps.note: The flight took 1 min 56 s at launch. You can't fly to Booty Bay until you have been there.

steps.text: Run west from Darkshire to the crossroads, then take the road south into Stranglethorn
steps.note: The road south leaves the crossroads at about 44, 66. The Rebel Camp is just west of the road once you cross into Stranglethorn.

steps.text: Rebel Camp: accept **The Second Rebellion**, **Bad Medicine** and **Krazek's Cookery**

quests.name: Jungle Secrets
quests.note: optional: only if you save Thorsen from the ambush

quests.name: Bookie Herod
quests.note: optional: from Doren after Jungle Secrets

steps.note: Krazek's Cookery is a delivery to Booty Bay (1,400 XP). If Kurzen's agents ambush Private Thorsen at 40.2, 8.4, save him: hand Jungle Secrets to Lieutenant Doren here and take Bookie Herod, whose book and strongbox are in the compound and cave you clear next.

steps.text: Nesingwary's camp: accept and hand in **Welcome to the Jungle**; accept the first Tiger, Panther and Raptor Mastery

quests.name: The Green Hills of Stranglethorn
quests.note: take it only when you hold a complete chapter

steps.note: Keep every page of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn you loot: a full chapter is 780 XP at Barnil Stonepot, and the whole book 4,700 more.

steps.text: Kill 10 **Young Stranglethorn Tigers** and 10 **Young Panthers** just south and east of the camp
Turn in both; accept the second **Tiger Mastery** and **Panther Mastery**
Head east; kill **Stranglethorn Tigers** south of the Kurzen Compound
steps.note: They also roam west of the camp (28–30, 8–16); finish there later if you are short.

steps.text: Kurzen Compound: climb the tower and accept **The Cook in the Cage** from Wendel Mathers
steps.note: New in Forever (quest level 38). In an earlier Classic season this cage was a rogue-only reward, so if Wendel offers a warlock nothing, skip it and Returning to Port.

steps.text: Kill 15 **Kurzen Jungle Fighters**; loot 7 Jungle Remedies and the Venom Fern Extract

quests.name: Bookie Herod
quests.note: optional: at the book on the top floor of the two-storey house

mobs.name: Kurzen Medicine Man
mobs.note: Jungle Remedies drop mostly from these

items.name: Venom Fern Extract
items.note: in a supply crate in the compound, about 44, 9 (the classic Alliance speed route)

items.name: Bookie Herod's Records
items.note: optional: top floor of the two-storey house

steps.note: Remedies drop rarely, so kill every Medicine Man you see.

steps.text: Rebel Camp: turn in **The Second Rebellion** and **Bad Medicine**; accept **Special Forces** and **Kurzen's Mystery**

quests.name: Kurzen's Mystery
quests.note: four tablets on the west coast loop; hand it in here at about 36.7

steps.note: Brother Nimetz offers Kurzen's Mystery once both quests are done: four troll tablets on your west loop, 3,550 XP. Special Forces' mobs stand in the cave you enter anyway.

steps.text: Clear into the Stockpile cave: 10 Commandos, 6 Headshrinkers, then the cage key and uniform at the back

quests.name: The Hidden Key
quests.note: optional: Bookie Herod's Strongbox, 49.6, 7.6, at the back of the cave

items.name: Compound Cage Key
items.note: earlier Classic season: from Kurzen Elites and Subchiefs

items.name: Kurzen Fighter's Uniform
items.note: earlier Classic season: Kurzen Supply Crate at 49.6, 7.7

steps.note: Where the key and uniform come from in Forever is not published. In an earlier Classic season the uniform was in a crate here and the key came from Kurzen Elites and Subchiefs; skip Colonel Kurzen (elite) at the very top.

steps.text: Back at the tower, free Wendel Mathers; accept **Returning to Port**
steps.note: In that earlier season he came back about every 3 minutes; wait if the cage is empty. Its XP is our guess (Classic rate for a level-38 quest).

steps.text: Rebel Camp: turn in **Special Forces** to Lieutenant Doren

quests.name: Patrol Schedules
quests.note: optional: Corporal Sethman, a few steps away

steps.note: If you ran the Bookie Herod chain on the way, hand in its last three quests here: about 4,500 XP for a few seconds.

steps.text: Optional: saved Thorsen only now? Run the whole Bookie Herod chain before heading west

items.name: Bookie Herod's Records
items.note: top floor of the compound's two-storey house, 43.7, 9.4

steps.note: About 8,600 XP in Classic for a 6–8 minute loop to the house, the cave and back, which beats grinding. Thorsen's ambush is timed; he can also turn up when you bring his supplies on your second pass north.

steps.text: Go west past Nesingwary: kill 10 **Panthers** (and any Tigers still needed)
Kill 10 **Stranglethorn Raptors** a little further west
steps.note: Crystal Spine Basilisks share this hill; leave them for Singing Blue Shards on your next visit.

steps.text: Nesingwary's camp: turn in all three; accept the next Tiger, Panther and Raptor Mastery
Kill 10 **Elder Stranglethorn Tigers** south of the camp
steps.note: Sin'Dall (next tiger quest) lives on this hill; you'll be back for her.

steps.text: Kill 10 **Lashtail Raptors** further south, either side of the road
steps.note: Stay east of Grom'gol (32, 28): its Horde guards are level 55.

steps.text: Follow the road south; kill 10 **Shadowmaw Panthers** around the road
steps.note: They stealth. King Bangalash (elite 43) roams near 38, 35; give him room.

steps.text: Keep following the road south through the tunnel into Booty Bay
steps.note: About 4 minutes on foot. The three Mastery turn-ins wait for your next pass north.

steps.text: Booty Bay: learn the flight path from Gyll; hand **A Fine Mess** to Scooty beside him if you carry it

quests.name: A Fine Mess
quests.note: only if your Gnomeregan group escorted Kernobee (part 5)

steps.note: The flight path links Stormwind, Darkshire and Sentinel Hill. A Fine Mess is a level-30 Gnomeregan quest; ForeverDB has no XP for it yet.

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Skindle in the Salty Sailor Tavern
steps.note: Log out in an inn between sessions: rested XP doubles your kill XP until it runs out (5% of a level per 8 hours).

steps.text: Tavern: hand in **Krazek's Cookery**; accept Krazek's, Kebok's and Crank's quests

quests.name: Favor for Krazek
quests.note: only with 4 Lesser Bloodstone Ore: hand it in at once and accept Return to Corporal Kaleb

quests.name: Favor for Krazek
quests.note: only with the 4 ore: hand it in at once

quests.name: Return to Corporal Kaleb
quests.note: only after Favor for Krazek; hand it in at the Rebel Camp on your second pass north

quests.name: Talk of the Town
quests.note: only if it is in your log; its giver is not published

steps.note: These quest givers are on different floors of the same inn. Skip Dream Dust in the Swamp and the Goblin Sponsorship chain: both start outside this route.

steps.text: Hand **The Haunted Isle** to Baron Revilgaz; accept **The Stone of the Tides**; turn in **Returning to Port**
steps.note: Returning to Port is new in Forever; its XP is our guess.

steps.text: Tan-Your-Hide Leatherworks (below the flight path): accept **Supply and Demand** from Drizzlik
Leave north by the road; at Grom'gol head for the coast and swim to the island west of it
steps.note: The island is at about 21, 24. Keep clear of Grom'gol's guards.

steps.text: Explore the haunted island for **The Stone of the Tides**; then dive east of it to read the troll tablet

quests.name: Kurzen's Mystery
quests.note: tablet: Gri'lek the Wanderer, underwater in the Vile Reef (24.8, 23.0)

mobs.name: Lesser Water Elemental
mobs.note: kill only those in your way for now

steps.note: The tablet, Gri'lek the Wanderer, lies underwater in the Vile Reef at about 24.8, 23.0, so cast Unending Breath first. It is one of the four for Kurzen's Mystery; Water Elementals brings you back to this island later.

steps.text: Kill **Crystal Spine Basilisks** on the hill north-east of the island for 10 Singing Crystal Shards
steps.note: Any basilisk drops them; the Stone Maw Basilisks by the Rebel Camp top you up later.

steps.text: Kill Bloodscalp trolls at their camp east of the basilisks; read the tablet in the camp
steps.note: You need 15 ears; finish them in Zul'Kunda next. The tablet here is Moon Over the Vale.

steps.text: Ruins of Zul'Kunda: find the crashed zeppelin's wreckage and Zimmix Sputterspark's cage
steps.note: New Forever quests (level 35). Their exact spots are not published; the quest text says the tracks lead north-west from the wreck to the ruins.

steps.text: Clear the ruins: 8 **Stolen Shipments**, the **Primitive Key**, the last ears and two tablets

quests.name: Kurzen's Mystery
quests.note: tablets: Fall of Gurubashi and The Emperor's Tomb

steps.note: Which trolls drop the key isn't published. The tablets are Fall of Gurubashi (22.9, 12.0) and The Emperor's Tomb (24.7, 8.9); Gan'zulah and Nezzliok nearby are not elites.

steps.text: Give Zimmix the key, accept **Zimmix's Great Escape** and escort him out of the ruins
steps.note: The escort's turn-in is Wharfmaster Lozgil on the Booty Bay docks.

steps.text: Nesingwary's camp: arriving completes **Investigate the Camp**; turn in the three Masteries; accept Sin'Dall's

quests.name: Raptor Mastery
quests.note: its 10 Jungle Stalkers are on your last trip north at about 39.1

steps.text: Kill **Sin'Dall** on the hilltop just south-west and loot her paw
Nesingwary's camp: turn in **Tiger Mastery**

quests.name: Big Game Hunter
quests.note: King Bangalash is an elite with adds

steps.note: Hand any finished Green Hills chapters to Barnil while you are here.

steps.text: Kill **River Crocolisks** in the river by the camp for 2 Large River Crocolisk Skins
steps.note: On the way north, kill Stone Maw Basilisks (34, 7) if you still need shards.

steps.text: Rebel Camp: deliver **Supplies to Private Thorsen**; turn in **Kurzen's Mystery**; accept **Troll Witchery**

quests.name: Troll Witchery
quests.note: 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes from the Skullsplitter camps at about 37.5

steps.note: If Thorsen is out on patrol, wait a minute: saving him starts Jungle Secrets (the optional Bookie Herod loop). Hand in Return to Corporal Kaleb too if you have it.

steps.text: Hearth to Booty Bay
steps.note: Saves an 8-minute run south. The hearthstone has a 10-second cast and a 1-hour cooldown.

steps.text: Tavern: turn in **Investigate the Camp**, **Bloodscalp Ears** and **Singing Blue Shards**; accept **Venture Company Mining**
Turn in **The Stone of the Tides** (Baron Revilgaz) and accept **Water Elementals**
Docks: turn in **Zimmix's Great Escape** and **Anything of Value**

quests.name: Anything of Value
quests.note: its text only says "someone in Booty Bay"

steps.note: If Lozgil won't take Anything of Value, try Baron Revilgaz or Krazek. XP for both quests is our guess.

steps.text: Tan-Your-Hide: turn in **Supply and Demand**; accept **Some Assembly Required**
Run north to the Venture Co. mine; kill Strip Miners for 10 **Singing Blue Crystals**
steps.note: Mobs here are 40–42; pull one at a time.

steps.text: Climb to Knaz Blunderflame's hut and accept **Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile**
steps.at: Knaz's hill (south of the ogre mound)
steps.note: Wowhead names Knaz only as the turn-in, so that he also gives it is our guess. The path up starts north-east of the ruins at about 49, 38; stay out of the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound (elites).

steps.text: Follow the stream north to Lake Nazferiti, killing **Snapjaw Crocolisks** for 5 skins
Venture Co. camp at the lake: loot 5 **Drums of Crude Oil** and 8 **Tumbled Crystals**

items.name: Drum of Crude Oil
items.note: probably lying around the camp: Wowhead's drop rate is 0.01%

steps.text: Cross west to the haunted island; kill **Lesser Water Elementals** for 6 bracers
steps.note: You should pass 37 here, which Skullsplitter Tusks and the Bloodsail quests need. If not, keep killing elementals until you do.

steps.text: Hearth to Booty Bay
steps.note: Your last hearth (Rebel Camp) was about an hour ago. If it is still on cooldown, kill elementals until it is ready.

steps.text: Tavern: turn in **Venture Company Mining** and **Hostile Takeover**; accept **Skullsplitter Tusks**
steps.note: Skullsplitter Tusks needs level 37. Up to Snuff is offered only after the first Bloodsail Buccaneers.

steps.text: Turn in **Water Elementals** and accept **Magical Analysis** (Baron); turn in **Some Assembly Required** and accept **Excelsior** (Drizzlik)

quests.name: Magical Analysis
quests.note: for Archmage Ansirem at Dalaran, about 37.8

quests.name: Excelsior
quests.note: the crocolisk is on your last trip north at about 39.1

steps.note: Magical Analysis goes to Archmage Ansirem outside Dalaran, which you pass in the Alterac Mountains at about 37.8.

steps.text: Accept **The Bloodsail Buccaneers** (First Mate Crazz) and **Scaring Shaky** (MacKinley)
steps.note: Keep An Eye Out and Up to Snuff unlock only after the first Bloodsail Buccaneers, so you get them at the next town stop.

steps.text: North of town, read the **Bloodsail Correspondence** on the barrel; accept the next **Bloodsail Buccaneers**
steps.note: "Pretty Boy" Duncan (39) stands by the barrel. Leave him unless he attacks: you come back for him at about 39.

steps.text: Kill **Elder Mistvale Gorillas** on the hills to the north-east for 5 Mistvale Giblets
steps.note: Silverback Patriarchs (42–43) mix in further east.

steps.text: Back in town: hand in the Bloodsail and Shaky quests; accept **Up to Snuff** and **Keep An Eye Out**

quests.name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
quests.note: optional: level 43, see the pirate step at the end

quests.name: Up to Snuff
quests.note: Deeg, tavern; finish it in the pirate block at the end

quests.name: Keep An Eye Out
quests.note: Dizzy One-Eye on the harbour; finish it in the pirate block at the end

steps.note: Shaky is inside the north tunnel (26.8, 73.6); MacKinley is across from the upturned half-ship (27.8, 77.0). Snuff and Dizzy's Eye drop from pirates; you collect them at about 39.2.

steps.text: Walk north to the Skullsplitter camps; kill trolls for 18 **Skullsplitter Tusks** and 4 **Skullsplitter Fetishes**
steps.note: Work the western huts (42–44, 33–37) for tusks. Fetishes drop from Mystics and from the Witch Doctors at the south huts (44–45, 41–43).

steps.text: Climb to Knaz's hut and turn in **Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile**
steps.note: XP is our guess (Classic rate for a level-36 quest). Keep Skullsplitter Tusks for your next Booty Bay visit at about 39.

steps.text: Walk north to the Rebel Camp; turn in **Troll Witchery** to Brother Nimetz
steps.note: About 4 minutes from Knaz's hut, and the road to Duskwood starts here. Skip Mai'Zoth, the next quest: it is level 46.

steps.text: Take the road north into Duskwood and east to Darkshire
steps.note: About 3–4 minutes on foot (our estimate).

steps.text: Fly from Felicia Maline to **Stormwind**
steps.note: The same short flight you took south at the start of the part, about 2 minutes.

steps.text: Mage Quarter: train your level 36 spells in the Slaughtered Lamb basement
steps.note: Level 38 waits for the Ironforge stop at about 38.5. Walk back to Dungar Longdrink in the Trade District afterwards.

steps.text: Fly from Dungar Longdrink to **Southshore**
steps.note: Stormwind has no direct line to Southshore, so the gryphon goes by way of Ironforge.

steps.text: Southshore town hall: hand **Further Mysteries** to Magistrate Maleb; accept **Dark Council**

quests.name: Assassin's Contract
quests.note: optional: starts from the contract a Shadowy Assassin drops (82% on Wowhead)

quests.name: Assassin's Contract
quests.note: optional: only if a Shadowy Assassin dropped it

steps.note: You already carry Noble Deaths from part 5. Stealthed Shadowy Assassins prowl all over Southshore: kill one if you see it, and its contract sends you after Baron Vardus, who walks between the Shadow Mage camps you visit anyway.

steps.text: Inn: set your hearthstone with Innkeeper Anderson

quests.name: Hints of a New Plague?
quests.note: only if you carry it from part 5: Phin Odelic stands outside the inn

steps.note: You hearth back here from the north of Alterac, then rebind in Booty Bay at about 39. If you carry the last Hints of a New Plague? step from part 5, hand it to Phin Odelic outside the inn.

steps.text: Walk north-west to Dalaran: hand **Magical Analysis** to Archmage Ansirem; accept **Ansirem's Key**

quests.name: Ansirem's Key
quests.note: for Catelyn the Blade in Booty Bay, at about 39

steps.note: He stands outside the dome by Lordamere Lake, about 3–4 minutes from Southshore by our estimate; Wowhead also lists him inside the City of Dalaran. Keep to the southern slopes, away from the elite Crushridge ogres.

steps.text: Walk east to Strahnbrad: solve **Strahnbrad Mystery** at the old forge; start on the **Noble Deaths** rings

items.name: Singed Note
items.note: begins the quest; where it lies is not published

steps.note: Wowhead's text says the old bellows "spring to life when no one is watching": an Ancient Fire Elemental (34–35) lives in them. Signet rings drop from Gravis Slipknot here and from the Syndicate in the camps to the north.

steps.text: North to the Syndicate camps: kill 4 **Argus Shadow Mages** and keep looting signet rings

mobs.name: Baron Vardus
mobs.note: not an elite; only with Baron's Demise

steps.note: Shadow Mages stand at 56, 27, at 53, 21 and at 47.5, 17.5, among Sentries and Saboteurs that also drop rings. The classic Alliance speed route kills the mages here because they are easier than elsewhere.

steps.text: West to Perenolde's house: kill **Nagaz** for his head; finish the rings on Enforcers and Assassins
steps.note: These Syndicate are 38–40 and none are elite. Pull one at a time and Fear the second if two come.

steps.text: Hearth to Southshore
steps.note: Saves a long walk back south. Your last hearth was on the haunted island in Stranglethorn.

steps.text: Town hall: turn in **Noble Deaths**, **Dark Council** and **Strahnbrad Mystery**

quests.name: Strahnbrad Mystery
quests.note: Wowhead only says "in town"; try Maleb first

steps.note: Strahnbrad Mystery's XP is our guess (Classic rate for a level-36 quest). Skip Crushridge Warmongers: the ogres are elites.

steps.text: Fly from Darla Harris to **Refuge Pointe**
Refuge Pointe: accept **Wand over Fist** from Skuerto

quests.name: Wand over Fist
quests.note: open because you finished Worth Its Weight in Gold in part 5

quests.name: Stromgarde Badges
quests.note: badges come from elites in Stromgarde Keep

steps.note: Skip Captain Nials' Stromgarde Badges and both WANTED posters on the board: every target is an elite inside Stromgarde Keep.

steps.text: North-east to the crystal at 62, 34: accept **The Princess Trapped** from the Shards of Myzrael
steps.note: About 3 minutes from Refuge Pointe (our estimate).

steps.text: Drywhisker Gorge: kill kobolds for 12 **Motes of Myzrael**; touch the Iridescent Shards at the back; accept **Stones of Binding**
steps.note: The path up starts behind a tree at about 80, 40. If you have all 12 motes early, still walk to the end of the cave to hand them in.

steps.text: Stone of East Binding: take the **Cresting Key**
steps.note: Cresting Exiles (38–39, not elite) float around the circle.

steps.text: Stone of Outer Binding: take the **Thundering Key**
steps.note: From here head straight south to the ogre cave.

steps.text: South to the ogre cave at 53, 77: take the left path and kill **Kor'gresh Coldrage** for the wand
steps.note: Kor'gresh is a normal level-39 ogre, so this is the one quest of Skuerto's chain you can do alone. The rest needs the elite Boulderfist ogres in Trelane's tower.

steps.note: Stay south and east of Stromgarde Keep: its Syndicate, trolls and ogres are elites. About 4 minutes (our estimate).

quests.name: Sunken Treasure

steps.note: Fozruk, an elite level-42 giant, wanders this side of the zone (19–21, 30–43): keep your distance.

steps.text: Circle of Inner Binding: turn in **Stones of Binding** at the stone

quests.name: Breaking the Keystone
quests.note: needs Fozruk, an elite level-42 giant

mobs.name: Thenan
mobs.note: elite giant that walks around the circle

steps.text: Refuge Pointe: turn in **Wand over Fist** to Skuerto

quests.name: Trelane's Defenses
quests.note: the Azure Agate drops only from elite Boulderfist Shamans

steps.text: Fly from Cedrik Prose to **Ironforge**
Forlorn Cavern: train your level 38 spells

steps.note: The gryphon goes by way of Stormwind.

steps.text: Kill 8 **Young Sawtooth Crocolisks** to the north and 10 **Sorrow Spinners** and 10 **Swamp Jaguars** to the west
steps.note: All three are below your level, so you can pull two at a time. The crocolisks are around 22, 44; the spiders and cats between 6 and 17, 51–59.

steps.text: Biggs: turn in **Encroaching Wildlife**; accept **The Lost Caravan**
North to Father Tuttle: accept **This Light of Mine** and escort him to the Harborage

mobs.name: Noboru the Cudgel
mobs.note: walks this road; drops Noboru's Cudgel

steps.note: Wowhead does not name the giver; Father Tuttle is the escort, so he probably offers it. Noboru (39, not elite) walks this road: kill him for the cudgel that starts his quest.

steps.text: The Harborage: turn in **This Light of Mine** and **Noboru the Cudgel**; accept the Harborage quests

quests.name: Blood of My Blood
quests.note: if offered: the giver is not published

quests.name: Taking the Bait Back
quests.note: from Pelluk, if offered; optional, because the lure rarely drops

steps.note: Wowhead shows the lure dropping only about 1% of the time so far, so give up after five or so Fishermen. Our estimate does not count this quest.

steps.note: Crystals sit at 55, 29–30 and 65, 20–23; the chest is on the cart at 64.5, 18.3. Every Lost One you kill here counts for Blood of My Blood.

steps.note: The escort is easy once the camp next to his cage is clear. The strongbox at 47.8, 39.4 is on your way back west.

steps.text: South to Biggs: turn in **The Lost Caravan**; accept **Driftwood**
Cross the swamp east to Misty Reed Strand; pick up 8 **Sundried Driftwood** along the shore

steps.text: Back to Biggs: turn in **Driftwood**; accept **Deliver the First Shipment**
steps.note: The shipment goes to Nethergarde Keep, just south in the Blasted Lands.

steps.text: South into the Blasted Lands: hand the shipment to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep
steps.note: About 4 minutes from Biggs (our estimate).

steps.text: Learn the Nethergarde Keep flight path; fly to **Booty Bay**

steps.note: He stands with Bloodsail Raiders and Mages (40–41); pull them one at a time. Any Snuff and Dizzy's Eye they drop count already.

steps.text: Back to Catelyn: turn in **"Pretty Boy" Duncan**; accept **The Curse of the Tides**

steps.text: Walk north up the west side; kill 10 **Jungle Stalkers** for **Raptor Mastery**
steps.note: They roam 23–33, 37–51, right on your way north.

steps.text: North-west coast: kill the **Elder Saltwater Crocolisk** for its skin
steps.note: A lone level-38 elite: Voidwalker in front, then your damage-over-time spells and Drain Life. Check its spawn spots at 22, 17, at 25.3, 19.2 and at 29.5, 24 first, and keep clear of Grom'gol if you try 33.5, 32.5.

steps.text: Swim to the haunted island: destroy the **Altar of the Tides** with Catelyn's blade and kill **Gazban**

mobs.name: Gazban
mobs.note: not an elite; drops the Stone of the Tides

steps.note: Gazban is level 40 and not an elite. The water elementals here are below you now.

steps.text: North-east to Nesingwary's camp: turn in **Raptor Mastery** and any finished Green Hills chapters
steps.note: Skip the last Raptor Mastery: Tethis is an elite.

steps.text: Hearth to Booty Bay
steps.note: Your last hearth was in Alterac, hours ago.

mobs.name: Bloodsail Swashbuckler
mobs.note: optional, for the fourth Bloodsail Buccaneers

steps.note: This is the only real grind in the part: about 255 kills from 39.2, by our estimate. Eat cooked food first (+5% kill XP); pirates stand in twos and threes, so Fear the second one.

steps.text: Booty Bay: turn in **Up to Snuff**, **Keep An Eye Out**, **Excelsior** and **The Curse of the Tides**
steps.note: The Curse of the Tides goes to Baron Revilgaz, with the Stone of the Tides and Catelyn's blade. These turn-ins take you past 40.

steps.text: Check your gold: keep at least 100 g before you sail

steps.text: Take the boat from the Booty Bay docks to **Ratchet**
steps.note: Allow 5–10 minutes with the wait. If the boat does not come, look for a temporary portal on the dock.

steps.text: Ratchet: learn the flight path from Bragok
steps.note: Alliance flights from Ratchet go to Theramore and Talrendis Point.

steps.text: Climb Strahad Farsan's tower and complete **Summon Felsteed**

items.note: 60% mount; Wowhead lists only level 40, no riding skill

steps.note: Needs level 40. Talk to Strahad directly: the old trainer breadcrumbs were removed back in Classic.

steps.text: Hearth to Booty Bay
steps.note: This replaces the boat back. Your last hearth was at Nesingwary's camp, more than an hour ago; if it is not ready, take the boat.

steps.text: Fly from Gyll to **Ironforge** (via Stormwind)
steps.note: Booty Bay has no direct line to Ironforge; the gryphon goes by way of Stormwind.

steps.text: Train your level 40 spells in the Forlorn Cavern

steps.text: Fallback only: no Felsteed? Buy Apprentice Riding from Binjy at Steelgrill's Depot

steps.text: Fly from Gryth Thurden to **Thelsamar**
Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Hearthstove
steps.note: Part 7 starts here with the Badlands quests.

steps.text: Level 40.1 in Thelsamar with the Felsteed: part 6 ends here
steps.note: Flight paths added in this part: Booty Bay, Nethergarde Keep and Ratchet. You carry Ironband Wants You! into part 7.

openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: how much the new Forever quests here pay (The Cook in the Cage, Returning to Port, Anything of Value, Zimmix's Great Escape, Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile, Strahnbrad Mystery, This Light of Mine and Blood of My Blood). We assume Classic rates for their levels; if they pay less, the pirate block at the end grows.

Not confirmed yet: who gives This Light of Mine, Blood of My Blood and Taking the Bait Back. Wowhead lists the quests but not the givers; we assume Father Tuttle and the Harborage. If the first two are not offered, the pirate block grows by about 20 kills. Taking the Bait Back is not counted: Wowhead shows its lure dropping only about 1% of the time.

Not confirmed yet: where the Singed Note that starts Strahnbrad Mystery lies (Wowhead only says the old forge bellows hide an Ancient Fire Elemental), and who takes the report. Its text says "in town in Hillsbrad", which could also mean the Horde town of Tarren Mill; if no one in Southshore takes it, skip it (about 2,800 XP by our guess).
Not confirmed yet: where Anything of Value, Where's the Key?, The Cook in the Cage and Talk of the Town start, and who in Booty Bay takes Anything of Value.
Not confirmed yet: where the Compound Cage Key, Kurzen Fighter's Uniform, Primitive Key and Drums of Crude Oil come from in Forever.

If Wendel Mathers offers a warlock nothing (The Cook in the Cage was rogue-only in an earlier Classic season), skip it and Returning to Port, about 3,850 XP by our guess. If you are too low for it at 35.8, take it on your second pass north.

Not confirmed yet: whether Archmage Ansirem still stands outside Dalaran's dome; Wowhead lists him there and inside the City of Dalaran. If you can't reach him, skip Magical Analysis and its Booty Bay follow-ups (about 8,200 XP).

If a Shadowy Assassin shows itself near Southshore's town hall, its Assassin's Contract leads to Baron's Demise; Baron Vardus (40, not an elite) stands with the Shadow Mages you kill anyway. That is about 4,600 XP more than we count.
If Worth Its Weight in Gold was not finished in part 5, Skuerto does not offer Wand over Fist: skip it.
Not confirmed yet: whether Strahad teaches the Felsteed without the 100 g Apprentice Riding. Players in a launch thread say class mounts are still free, but Blizzard has not confirmed it.
Not confirmed yet: the Booty Bay–Ratchet boat timing, and how long the walks from the Rebel Camp to Darkshire and from Darkshire into the Swamp of Sorrows take.
Rested XP is not counted. Logging out in an inn before the pirate block shortens it.

legs.title: Badlands, Riverglades, Krol'dok & Uldaman
legs.summary: Ride from Thelsamar into the Badlands and do its quests in one loop, picking up the Uldaman quests on the way. Then quest in Riverglades, the new zone south of the Badlands, from Farholde Keep. Finish with one Uldaman run carrying every quest, and hand everything in at Thelsamar and Ironforge.
legs.why: The Badlands quests are level 35–43, so at 40 they pay full XP; at 45 many would pay a fraction. The same loop collects five Uldaman quests. Riverglades is a level 36–44 zone with over 150 quests right next door, and Farholde Keep flies straight to Thelsamar, so you need no boat. Launch players have started using it: the leader quested there at 42.5–42.8 and made about a quarter of a level in under half an hour. Uldaman comes last because its hand-ins sit in Thelsamar, the Badlands and Ironforge, all on your way. Forever has also paid about twice the normal XP for quests done inside a dungeon (seen at launch on Stockade, Blackfathom Deeps, Razorfen Kraul, Shadowfang Keep, Wailing Caverns and Gnomeregan quests at levels 22–29), so Uldaman's five inside quests should be worth about 21,000 XP more than their normal value. That is why you can leave Riverglades at about 44.6 instead of about 44.8, roughly 28 minutes sooner. You train 42 and 44 on the Ironforge stop just before Uldaman, because Riverglades has no warlock trainer.
legs.estTime: About 14–14.5 h /played: about 1.8 h on the Badlands loop, up to 20 minutes finding the way into Riverglades, about 9 h of Riverglades questing, and 3–3.5 h for the Ironforge stop, the Uldaman group and the hand-ins, with no grinding on the main route.
legs.start: Level 40.1 in Thelsamar (Loch Modan), with your Felsteed. Hearth: Thelsamar. Trained 34, 36, 38 and 40. New flight paths from part 6: Booty Bay, Ratchet and Nethergarde Keep. You carry Ironband Wants You! for Prospector Ironband.
legs.end: Level 45.3 in Ironforge, after the Uldaman hand-ins and the Vault voucher. Hearth: Thelsamar. Trained 42 and 44. New flight path: Farholde Keep. Nothing to carry; Portents of Uldum is now open at High Explorer Magellas.

steps.text: Restock food and water at the Thelsamar inn before riding out

npcs.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
npcs.role: food and drink; your hearth is already bound here

steps.note: The Badlands has no Alliance vendor on this loop. Your Felsteed makes the whole loop a short ride.

steps.text: Accept **Badlands Reagent Run** from Ghak Healtouch beside the inn
steps.note: You need 5 Buzzard Gizzards, 10 Crag Coyote Fangs and 5 Rock Elemental Shards, all from this loop. It opens Uldaman Reagent Run.

steps.text: Ride to Prospector Ironband; hand in **Ironband Wants You!** and accept **Find Agmond**

quests.name: Find Agmond
quests.note: some quest databases list Ironband Wants You! as required first, others do not, so ask anyway

steps.text: Ride west and take the southern pass out of Loch Modan into the Badlands
steps.note: You come out in the north Badlands beside the Uldaman dig. Its Shadowforge dwarves are elite (much tougher than normal mobs, meant for groups): ride straight past them.

steps.text: Accept **Mirages** from Sigrun Ironhew and **A Dwarf and His Tools** from Prospector Ryedol

quests.name: Fiery Blaze Enchantments
quests.note: level 45; needs a rare Black Drake's Heart

steps.text: At Hammertoe's Digsite kill dwarves for Ryedol's Lucky Pick; click the Crumpled Map in the tent

items.name: Crumpled Map
items.note: in the tent on the right side of the hole

steps.text: Ride north-east and loot the Excavation Supply Crate for **Mirages**

mobs.name: Dustbelcher Warrior

steps.text: Back at the camp hand in three quests; accept **Scrounging** and the next **A Sign of Hope**

quests.name: A Sign of Hope

steps.text: Accept **Tremors of the Earth** from Garek just south-east of the camp

quests.name: Tremors of the Earth
quests.note: quest level 43, needs Mirages done; 3,600 XP

steps.text: At the goblin camp accept **Barbecued Buzzard Wings** and **Power Stones** from Rigglefuzz

quests.name: Pearl Diving

npcs.name: Martek the Exiled

steps.text: Ride west to Lotwil Veriatus; accept **Study of the Elements: Rock**

npcs.name: Lucien Tosselwrench
npcs.role: skip unless you carry the potions

mobs.name: Dustbelcher Ogre

Clear the south-west: Giant Buzzards for wings and gizzards, Elder Crag Coyotes for fangs

steps.text: Ride back to Farholde Keep; hand in and pick up the next quests
Checkpoint 1.5 h after arriving: if you gained under ~40,000 XP, take the bail-out below
steps.note: That is slower than grinding, which makes about 26,000 XP an hour here. Launch players quested in Riverglades at 36 and at 42.5–42.8, so expect it to work.

steps.text: Bail-out only: fly from Farholde Keep to Booty Bay, through Lakeshire and Darkshire
steps.note: Skip all five bail-out steps if Riverglades is working. The launch leader quested in Stranglethorn at 43.8–44.6, after Riverglades and the Badlands.

steps.note: Both quests are open to either faction. You set your hearth back to Thelsamar before Uldaman anyway.

Hand in **Badlands Reagent Run** at Ghak Healtouch behind the inn; accept **Uldaman Reagent Run**

steps.text: Outside with the group: 4 Carved Stone Urns, the Ancient Chest's tablet and the power stones

npcs.name: Hammertoe Grez
npcs.role: quest giver, outside the instance portal

steps.text: Kill the elite Magregan Deepshadow for Hammertoe's Amulet; hand it back for **Prospect of Faith**

quests.name: Prospect of Faith
quests.note: to Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands; 2,350 XP

steps.text: Open Krom Stoutarm's Chest in the North Common Hall for **Reclaimed Treasures**

steps.text: Enter Uldaman: find Baelog, hand in **The Lost Dwarves**, accept **The Hidden Chamber**

quests.name: The Lost Dwarves
quests.note: about 700 XP with the dungeon bonus (315 at normal rates)

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.note: to the Explorers' League; about 11,550 XP with the dungeon bonus

steps.text: Ride out to Prospector Ryedol: hand in **Prospect of Faith**, accept the next part
Hand in **Power Stones** at Rigglefuzz

quests.note: 3,500 XP at normal rates, but only about 40% of that at 44 (quest level 36)

steps.note: Fallback, if Ironband gave you nothing at the start: do Find Agmond and Murdaloc now, on this ride south.

steps.text: Hand in **Solution to Doom** at Theldurin; accept **To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest**

quests.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
quests.note: about 7,600 XP with the dungeon bonus (3,450 at normal rates)

quests.name: Agmond's Fate

Hall of Explorers: hand in **The Hidden Chamber**, **Reclaimed Treasures** and the Hammertoe chain

quests.name: Reclaimed Treasures

quests.name: The Platinum Discs

steps.text: Forlorn Cavern: hand in **To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest** at Gerrig Bonegrip

quests.name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
quests.note: needs three items from around the Badlands

quests.name: Lore for a Price
quests.note: the chain needs a second Uldaman run

steps.note: Found the Shattered Necklace? Hand it to Talvash del Kissel in the Mystic Ward and skip the rest of that chain.

steps.text: Walk to the Vault and hand the voucher to Dinita Stonemantle

steps.text: Level 45.3 in Ironforge, hearth set to Thelsamar: part 7 is done

openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: the pass from the south Badlands into Riverglades. Test-server maps show one along Redridge's east edge, but nobody has posted where it is. If you can't find it in 10 minutes, use the fallback flight through Lakeshire.
Not confirmed yet: Riverglades' quest list. No database or guide has published it, so the Riverglades steps follow mob levels and friendly NPCs. Launch players did quest there at 36 and at 42.5–42.8.

Not confirmed yet: whether Riverglades has enough quests for 43–44. The launch leader left it at 42.8 for the Badlands and Stranglethorn. If you run out, grind the Eastsea pirates on the east coast until about 44.6.
If Uldaman's quests pay only normal XP (Forever's double XP for dungeon quests has only been seen up to level 29), quest in Riverglades until about 44.8 instead of 44.6: about 28 minutes more.
Not confirmed yet: Krol'dok Stronghold's quests. None have been seen; two items found in the game files look like quest starters.
Not confirmed yet: Farholde Keep's exact spot. One test-server video puts it at 64, 23; the game database puts its flight master at 60.6, 81.4 and its innkeeper at 64.6, 84.2, which this guide uses.
Not confirmed yet: whether Rog'mar's level-55 guards reach the central quest areas on PvP realms.
If Martek the Exiled offers Indurium without his letter, take it: the flakes drop from the troggs at Murdaloc's camp (3,000 XP).

legs.title: Searing Gorge, Tanaris & Feralas
legs.summary: Ride through the Badlands into Searing Gorge for the Thorium Point quests, then fly to Ironforge to train 46. Take the Powderfuse Port ship to Tanaris, clear Gadgetzan's east loop, and ride to Feralas for a full Feathermoon circuit that also opens the flight paths part 9 needs. Back in Tanaris, finish the south loop and grind Thistleshrub Valley to 50.
legs.why: Quests beat grinding in this part only until about 47.7. After that nothing at your level is left that this route can reach, so the last 2.3 levels are a grind, as they are in the classic Alliance speed route. Searing Gorge comes first because you start in Ironforge and its quests (level 45–50) still pay full XP: about 44,000 from eleven quests plus about 39,000 from the mobs, in about 2 hours. Several of its quests are left out because they need a group (Overseer Maltorius, Margol the Rager, the Twilight's Hammer camp) or items from zones off this route (Ledger from Tanaris, Look at the Size of It!). Tanaris is reached by the Powderfuse Port ship, the only way into Kalimdor that needs no new flight path. Feralas fits between the two Tanaris loops: its Feathermoon chains give about 76,000 quest XP plus 39,000 from mobs in about 3 hours, about a fifth faster than grinding, and they open the Thalanaar and Feathermoon flight paths that part 9 uses to reach Silithus. The Hinterlands is dropped: its four reachable quests paid no better than grinding and needed a long trip. Zul'Farrak is worth running only with someone who has the Mallet of Zul'Farrak for Gahz'rilla.
legs.estTime: About 18–19.5 h /played: roughly 8 h of quests and travel in Searing Gorge, Tanaris and Feralas, then about 10.5 h grinding some 1,060 kills in Thistleshrub Valley at 100 kills an hour.
legs.start: Level 45.3 in Ironforge, after the Uldaman hand-ins and the Vault voucher. Hearth: Thelsamar (used near the end of part 7). Trained 42 and 44. Flight paths include Farholde Keep. Nothing to carry; Portents of Uldum is open at High Explorer Magellas.
legs.end: Level 50 in Gadgetzan. Hearth: Gadgetzan. Trained 46 only; 48 is trained in part 9. New flight paths: Thorium Point, Gadgetzan, Thalanaar and Feathermoon. Carrying the Mithril Casing, Return to Ironforge if Magellas offered the Uldum quests, and optionally Yuka Screwspigot. Zul'Farrak done or skipped.

skipped.why: Needs a sword from a Swamp of Sorrows murloc and a crate from Dustwallow Marsh, both off this route.

skipped.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
skipped.why: Maltorius is a level 49–50 elite with two elite guards: a group quest.

skipped.name: What the Flux?
skipped.why: The plans lie at Overseer Maltorius's feet, inside his elite guard.

skipped.name: Look at the Size of It!
skipped.why: It starts from a pillow that drops in Blackrock Depths.

skipped.name: The Horn of the Beast → Proof of Deed → At Last!

skipped.name: The Flame's Casing → Set Them Ablaze! → Trinkets...

skipped.name: Dwarven Justice → Release Them
skipped.why: Sends you back into Searing Gorge after you have left, then into the elite Twilight's Hammer camp.

skipped.name: Prayer to Elune
skipped.why: Its giver stands inside the elite Twilight's Hammer camp, and part two goes to Darnassus.

skipped.name: Doling Justice (part 2) and An Orphan Looking For a Home

skipped.name: Rise of the Silithid
skipped.why: Handed in at Darnassus.

skipped.name: In Search of Knowledge (the Troyas chain)
skipped.why: Goes to Rut'theran Village and back.

skipped.name: Again With the Zapped Giants / Refuel for the Zapping
skipped.why: Repeat versions worth 560 XP each.

skipped.name: The Stone Circle
skipped.why: Sends you to Ratchet; it leads into the Sunken Temple.

skipped.name: The Hinterlands (the whole zone)
skipped.why: Its four reachable quests paid no better than grinding; the rest need Feralas items, Darnassus or Booty Bay.

skipped.name: Zul'Farrak without a mallet holder
skipped.why: Its other four quests pay about the same as grinding once the group wait is counted.

skipped.name: Favored of Elune?
skipped.why: Starts from Handle With Care in Gadgetzan, needs feathers from the Hinterlands and is handed in at Rut'theran Village.

skipped.name: The Super Snapper FX

skipped.name: Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient

skipped.name: Rescue OOX-17/TN!

skipped.name: Rescue OOX-22/FE!
skipped.why: An escort whose reward is handed in at Booty Bay.

skipped.name: Tiara of the Deep
skipped.why: Its giver is Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

skipped.name: Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog
