steps.text: Hall of Explorers: accept **Portents of Uldum** from High Explorer Magellas
steps.note: Part 7 ends with the Platinum Discs voucher handed in at the Vault, which opens this quest. If Magellas has nothing for you, skip this step, the next one and the Uldum step in Tanaris.

steps.text: Turn in **Portents of Uldum** to Historian Karnik; accept **Seeing What Happens**
steps.note: Seeing What Happens needs level 45 and is handed in at the gates of Uldum in Tanaris (4,700 XP, then 4,700 more for The Stone Watcher).

steps.text: Buy cooked food at the Auction House for the Well Fed buff
steps.note: Most cooked food gives +5% kill XP for about 15 minutes in Forever. Eat before each long block of kills.

steps.text: Auction House: buy 15 **Silk Cloth** if your bags hold fewer, and one **Mithril Casing** for Un'Goro
steps.note: Caught!, the first Searing Gorge quest, takes the cloth; part 9's Chasing A-Me 01 needs the casing to repair a robot. If no casing is listed, look again on your next Ironforge stop, or part 9 skips those two quests.

steps.text: Fly from Gryth Thurden to **Thelsamar**
steps.note: Your hearth still points to Thelsamar, but you used it near the end of part 7, so fly.

steps.text: Ride through the south pass into the Badlands, then west to the trail south of Kargath
steps.note: Kargath is a Horde town with guards: pass it on the south side. This trail needs no key; the Loch Modan gate into Searing Gorge does.

steps.text: Follow the trail into Searing Gorge; at the Grimesilt dig site, click the **Wooden Outhouse** and accept **Caught!**
steps.note: Margol the Rager, a level 48 elite beast (far tougher than a normal mob), walks where the trail comes in (69–73, 72–82). Wait for him to pass.

steps.text: Kill 8 **Dark Iron Geologists** around the dig site
steps.note: Most mobs in this zone are 47–49, two to four levels above you. Pull one at a time and let your Voidwalker hold them.

steps.text: Hand **Caught!** and the Silk Cloth to the outhouse; accept **Suntara Stones** from Dorius beside it
steps.note: Decline Ledger from Tanaris: it needs a murloc's sword from the Swamp of Sorrows and a crate from Dustwallow Marsh, both off this route.

steps.text: Escort Dorius north along the east side of the gorge
steps.note: Keep him alive through the attacks on the way. At the end he collapses and leaves a Singed Letter.

steps.text: Click the **Singed Letter**: turn in **Suntara Stones** and accept the next **Suntara Stones**
steps.note: The second part goes to Curator Thorius in Ironforge, where you fly at the end of this zone.

steps.text: Ride west to **Thorium Point**; learn the flight path from Lanie Reed
steps.note: Thorium Point flies to Ironforge and Morgan's Vigil. You leave Searing Gorge from here.

steps.text: Thorium Point: accept **JOB OPPORTUNITY**, **STOLEN**, **Curse These Fat Fingers**, **Fiery Menace!** and **Incendosaurs?**

quests.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

steps.note: The first two are on the wanted board. Skip WANTED: Overseer Maltorius and What the Flux?: both put you next to Maltorius, a level 49–50 elite with two elite guards.

steps.text: Velarok Windblade, just south: hear **Divine Retribution**, hand it in, accept **The Flawless Flame**
steps.note: Older guides call him Kalaran Windblade.

steps.text: Cauldron's west and south rim: kill 20 **Heavy War Golems**, plus **Steamsmiths** and **Lookouts** for the stolen tools

quests.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass

steps.note: Golems also give the 4 Golem Oil. The Smithing Tuyere drops from Steamsmiths (37–43, 48–52), the Spyglass from Lookouts outside the towers.

steps.text: South-west plateaus: kill 20 level 47–49 **Searing Lava Spiders**; get 4 **Hearts of Flame** from Inferno Elementals

mobs.name: Searing Lava Spider
mobs.note: the level 47–49 kind; the quest text calls it Greater Lava Spider

steps.note: The quest text still says Greater Lava Spiders. Only the level 47–49 spiders in the west count, not the 45–47 ones further east; Blazing Elementals also drop Hearts of Flame.

steps.text: Back at Velarok: hand in **The Flawless Flame**; accept **Forging the Shaft**
Down in the Cauldron: kill 15 **Taskmasters** and 15 **Slavers**; collect 8 **Thorium Plated Daggers**
steps.note: Most of them work the Cauldron's north half, below Thorium Point. Keep any Grimesilt Outhouse Key that drops.

steps.text: Slag Pit, the tunnels under the Cauldron: kill 20 **Incendosaurs** in the lava pools

quests.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

steps.note: Overseer Maltorius and two Dark Iron Sentries, all elite, stand at about 40–42, 35–36: keep clear of that room. The Incendosaurs fill the lava pools further east, at about 44–52, 20–38.

steps.text: If a **Grimesilt Outhouse Key** dropped, use it, then hand **The Key to Freedom** to the outhouse
steps.note: 5,250 XP for about four minutes of riding. Dark Iron taskmasters, slavers, steamsmiths and lookouts drop the key.

steps.text: Velarok: hand in **Forging the Shaft**; skip **The Flame's Casing**
steps.note: Its Symbol of Ragnaros drops only from the elite Twilight's Hammer camp in the north-west. With a group, the chain goes on to Set Them Ablaze! (7,600 XP).

steps.text: Thorium Point: hand **JOB OPPORTUNITY** and **STOLEN** to Taskmaster Scrange, and the three kill quests to Hansel

quests.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

steps.text: Fly from Lanie Reed to **Ironforge**
Hall of Explorers: hand the Singed Letter (**Suntara Stones**) to Curator Thorius
steps.note: He wanders around the library. Decline Dwarven Justice: it sends you back into a Searing Gorge prison cave.

steps.text: Forlorn Cavern: train your level 46 spells
steps.note: Level 48 (Soul Fire) waits for part 9's Ironforge stop, and so does 46 if you are still a few bars short. There is no Alliance warlock trainer on Kalimdor.

steps.text: Fly from Gryth Thurden to **Farholde Keep** (via Thelsamar)
steps.note: Farholde links only to Thelsamar, Lakeshire and Morgan's Vigil. Powderfuse Port has a flight master but no routes.

steps.text: Ride north-east from Farholde Keep to **Powderfuse Port** on the east coast
steps.note: The port is around 77.6, 50.8. Nobody has timed this ride; on the map it looks like 3–5 minutes mounted.

steps.text: Take the ship from Powderfuse Port to **Steamwheedle Port** (Tanaris)
steps.note: Plan 5–10 minutes with the wait. If no ship comes, look for a temporary portal on the dock.

steps.text: Steamwheedle Port: accept **Southsea Shakedown**, **Pirate Hats Ahoy!** and Yeh'kinya's **Screecher Spirits**
steps.note: You catch the screecher spirits in Feralas later in this part. Skip Stoley: his quest needs a letter from Booty Bay first.

steps.text: Ride west to Gadgetzan
steps.note: About 2 minutes. The road crosses the Wastewander camps: you come back for them in a moment.

steps.text: Learn the Gadgetzan flight path from Bera Stonehammer
steps.note: Gadgetzan links to Marshal's Refuge, Cenarion Hold, Thalanaar and Theramore.

steps.text: Make Gadgetzan your home at Innkeeper Fizzgrimble
Accept **Wastewander Justice**, **Water Pouch Bounty** and both **WANTED** posters
Accept **The Thirsty Goblin**, **The Dunemaul Compound**, **Thistleshrub Valley** and **Gadgetzan Water Survey**
steps.note: Thistleshrub Valley needs level 45. The first three wait in your log until you are back from Feralas.

steps.text: East of town: kill 10 **Wastewander Bandits** and 10 **Thieves**; loot 5 **Water Pouches**
steps.note: Any Wastewander drops pouches; finish them in the next camp if short.

steps.text: Gadgetzan: turn in **Wastewander Justice**; accept **More Wastewander Justice**
South-east camps: kill **Shadow Mages**, **Rogues**, **Assassins** and **Caliph Scorpidsting**
steps.note: Needs 10 mages, 8 rogues and 6 assassins. Caliph walks between the tents with two stealthed guards.

steps.text: Ride east to the cave at 68, 41 and through it into Lost Rigger Cove
Lost Rigger Cove: kill 10 of each **Southsea** pirate type; collect 20 **Pirate Hats**

quests.name: Ship Schedules
quests.note: only if a Ship Schedule drops

items.name: Ship Schedule
items.note: random drop: starts Ship Schedules (4,850 XP), handed in at Steamwheedle Port

steps.note: 40 kills in all; the hats drop along the way. If a Ship Schedule drops, take its quest too.

steps.text: Kill **Andre Firebeard** in the two-storey house and take his head
Ride north to Steamwheedle Port: turn in **Southsea Shakedown**, **Andre Firebeard** and **Pirate Hats Ahoy!**
Hearth to Gadgetzan
steps.note: Riding back takes about 2 minutes if the hearth is still on cooldown.

steps.text: Turn in **More Wastewander Justice**, **Caliph Scorpidsting** and **Water Pouch Bounty**
West of town: use the **Untapped Dowsing Widget** at the pool by Sandsorrow Watch
steps.note: Two hostile insects (47–48) spawn once you have the sample: kill them or ride away. The pool is at about 39, 29.

steps.text: Gadgetzan: turn in **Gadgetzan Water Survey**; accept **Noxious Lair Investigation**
Ride north out of Gadgetzan into Thousand Needles, to the Shimmering Flats racetrack
steps.note: You ride once to Thalanaar to learn its flight path; after that you fly. Mobs on the salt flats are far below your level.

steps.text: Zul'Farrak group planned? Accept **Gahz'rilla** from Wizzle Brassbolts
steps.note: Worth it only if someone in your group carries the Mallet of Zul'Farrak, which summons Gahz'rilla. Otherwise ride on.

steps.text: Ride west through Thousand Needles to **Thalanaar**, just inside Feralas
steps.note: About 10 minutes from Gadgetzan in all (our estimate).

steps.text: Learn the Thalanaar flight path from Thyssiana
steps.note: Thalanaar flies to Feathermoon, Gadgetzan and Theramore.

steps.text: Ride west along the road to Kindal Moonweaver's camp
steps.note: Camp Mojache, a Horde town with guards, sits by the road around 75, 42: give it a wide berth.

steps.text: Accept **Freedom for All Creatures** from Kindal Moonweaver
steps.note: Her camp is up a hidden path just north-west of the Grimtotem camp's entrance.

steps.text: Lead Kindal to the Grimtotem pen, open it, and kill Grimtotems until the darters are free
steps.note: You have 6 minutes, and Kindal plus at least 6 Sprite Darters must live. Pull attackers off her.

steps.text: Hand in **Freedom for All Creatures**; accept **Doling Justice** from Jer'kai
Grimtotem camps: kill 12 **Naturalists**, 10 **Raiders** and 6 **Shamans**
steps.note: One camp is beside Kindal; the other is just north, at 67–70, 38–41.

steps.text: Hand in **Doling Justice**; skip its second part and the orphan quest

quests.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home

steps.note: Part two goes to Darnassus. The orphan chain needs it and ends in the Hinterlands.

steps.text: Ride west to the Forgotten Coast dock; accept **Zapped Giants** and **Fuel for the Zapping** from Zorbin
steps.note: You do both on the coast after Feathermoon. Put the Ultra-Shrinker on your action bar.

steps.text: Take the Feathermoon Ferry from the dock to Feathermoon Stronghold
steps.note: Feathermoon sits on an island off the coast. The ferry is for Alliance players.

steps.text: Learn the Feathermoon flight path from Fyldren Moonfeather
steps.note: Feathermoon flies to Thalanaar, Auberdine, Nijel's Point and Cenarion Hold. Part 9 uses it to reach Silithus.

steps.text: Make Feathermoon your home at Innkeeper Shyria
steps.note: You hearth back here twice, then set Gadgetzan again when you leave.

steps.text: Gazebo by the water: accept **The Mark of Quality** from Pratt McGrubben
Feathermoon: accept **The Ruins of Solarsal**, **The Missing Courier**, **The High Wilderness** and **The Sunken Temple**
steps.note: Hand the first Missing Courier straight to Ginro, upstairs in the small house, for part two. Skip In Search of Knowledge: it goes to Rut'theran Village.

steps.text: Ride south to the Ruins of Solarsal gazebo; turn in **The Ruins of Solarsal**
steps.note: The naga drop nothing for you yet: kill only what blocks the way.

steps.text: Feathermoon: turn in **Return to Feathermoon Stronghold**; take both **Against the Hatecrest** quests
steps.note: Shandris sends you to Latronicus beside her; he gives the real one.

steps.text: Ruins of Solarsal: kill naga until you have 10 **Hatecrest Naga Scales**
Feathermoon: hand in **Against the Hatecrest**; accept **Against Lord Shalzaru**
Swim to the Isle of Dread; kill **Lord Shalzaru** in his cave for the **Mysterious Relic**
steps.note: The island is just south of Solarsal. Shalzaru is a normal level 47 naga at the back of the cave.

steps.text: Hearth to Feathermoon
steps.note: Your last hearth was at the end of the Tanaris east loop, more than an hour ago. If it is not ready, swim and ride north (about 3 minutes).

steps.text: Hand in **Against Lord Shalzaru**; take **Delivering the Relic** to Vestia Moonspear next door
Take the ferry back to the mainland dock
Coast south of the dock: zap and kill giants for **Zapped Giants**; kill elementals for **Fuel for the Zapping**
steps.note: Zap a giant before you fight it: the Ultra-Shrinker turns it into a normal mob that drops the residue. Never fight an unzapped giant: they are elite.

steps.text: Wrecked Row Boat on the south coast: turn in **The Missing Courier**; accept **Boat Wreckage**
Feral Scar Vale: kill yetis for 10 **Thick Yeti Hides**; catch 3 screecher spirits on the way
steps.note: Use Yeh'kinya's Bramble on a dead screecher to catch its spirit. The vale's yeti cave is at its east side.

steps.text: If an **OOX-22/FE Distress Beacon** dropped, take it to the robot in the nearby cave
steps.note: 3,900 XP for a random drop. Skip the escort: its reward is handed in at Booty Bay.

steps.text: Gordunni camps to the south-east: kill 8 **Warlocks**, 8 **Shaman** and 8 **Brutes**
steps.note: Brutes stand at the north end (59–62, 54–59); Warlocks and Shaman are further south (58–62, 63–73).

steps.text: Ride back north-west to Zorbin: hand in **Zapped Giants** and **Fuel for the Zapping**
steps.note: Skip the repeat versions he offers next: 560 XP each.

steps.text: Take the ferry to Feathermoon
Ginro and Quintis: turn in **Boat Wreckage**, **The Knife Revealed** and **Psychometric Reading**; accept **The Woodpaw Gnolls**
steps.note: Ginro is upstairs in the small house; Quintis is at the top of the spiral tower. Go back and forth once each.

steps.text: Hand **The High Wilderness** to Angelas and **The Mark of Quality** to Pratt; accept **Improved Quality**
Take the ferry back to the mainland
Ride north-east to the Rage Scar yetis; kill them for 10 **Rage Scar Yeti Hides**
steps.note: A Pristine Yeti Hide sometimes drops: it starts a 2,200 XP quest for Pratt.

steps.text: Ride west to Rockbiter; accept **The Giant Guardian**
steps.note: Elite Land Walkers and Cliff Giants (48–50) roam just west of him. Keep your distance from them.

steps.text: Ride north to Shay Leafrunner; turn in **The Giant Guardian**, accept **Wandering Shay**, take the bell
steps.note: The bell is in the chest next to her.

steps.text: Lead Shay back to Rockbiter; ring the bell whenever she wanders off
steps.note: Stay a few steps ahead of her and she wanders less. The bell works once a minute.

steps.text: Hand **Wandering Shay** to Rockbiter
Ride south-east across Feralas to the Woodpaw gnoll camps
steps.note: About four minutes. The backpacks hang on the big tree in the middle of the camps.

steps.text: Big tree: click the **Large Leather Backpacks**; turn in **The Woodpaw Gnolls**, accept **The Writhing Deep**
steps.note: You also get the Undelivered Parcel: right-click it to start Thalanaar Delivery.

steps.text: Go down into the Zukk'ash hive to the south; open the **Zukk'ash Pod** to free Raschal
steps.note: Take the southern tunnel and keep right; the pod is at the end.

steps.text: Hearth to Feathermoon
steps.note: Your last hearth was on the Isle of Dread, well over an hour ago.

steps.text: Turn in **Freed from the Hive** (Ginro), **A Hero's Welcome** (Shandris) and **Improved Quality** (Pratt)
steps.note: Decline Rise of the Silithid: it goes to Darnassus. Hand Pratt the Pristine Yeti Hide too if one dropped.

steps.text: Fly from Fyldren Moonfeather to **Thalanaar**
Hand **Thalanaar Delivery** to Falfindel Waywarder
Fly from Thyssiana to **Gadgetzan**
Make Gadgetzan your home again at Innkeeper Fizzgrimble
steps.note: You hearth here twice more in this part, and part 9 starts here.

steps.text: Ride east to Steamwheedle Port; hand **Screecher Spirits** to Yeh'kinya
Zul'Farrak planned? Accept **The Prophecy of Mosh'aru** from Yeh'kinya
steps.note: Its two tablets drop inside Zul'Farrak. Skip it if you will not run the dungeon.

steps.text: Ride south-west to Marvon Rivetseeker: hand in **The Sunken Temple**; accept **Gahz'ridian** and wear the helm
steps.note: Decline The Stone Circle: it sends you to Ratchet. The helm shows the buried ornaments on your minimap; dig them up all through the southern loop.

steps.text: Dunemaul Compound: kill **Gor'marok the Ravager**, plus Brutes and Enforcers
steps.note: Needs 10 Brutes, 10 Enforcers and Gor'marok. Clear a path to him first; finish the counts in the southern camp.

steps.text: Southern ogre camps: finish the Brutes and Enforcers; keep digging up **Gahz'ridian Ornaments**
steps.note: Ornaments lie around 47.8, 66.2; 38.9, 65.9; and 39.7, 74.5. You need 30.

steps.text: Gates of Uldum: hand **Seeing What Happens** to the pedestal; do **The Stone Watcher**
steps.note: Talk the Stone Watcher through, use the pedestal again, then take Return to Ironforge for part 9. Approach up the west side.

steps.text: Thistleshrub Valley: kill 8 **Gnarled Thistleshrubs** and 8 **Rootshapers**; loot a **Laden Dew Gland**
steps.note: One Laden Dew Gland from a Dew Collector completes The Thirsty Goblin; ignore any extra gland counts your quest tracker shows.

steps.text: If you see **Tooga** the turtle here, accept **Tooga's Quest**
steps.note: 5,900 XP but a 30-minute timer. He follows you: take him to Torta at Steamwheedle Port and never let him fall behind.

steps.text: Noxious Lair: kill **Centipaar** until you have 5 **Insect Parts**
steps.note: Stay on the outer mounds; the bugs inside the hive come in packs.

steps.text: Hearth to Gadgetzan (if Tooga is following you, travel with him instead)
steps.note: Hearthing leaves Tooga behind and fails his quest. If the hearth is not ready yet, ride north (about 3 minutes).

steps.text: Turn in **Thistleshrub Valley**, **The Dunemaul Compound** and **The Thirsty Goblin**; accept **In Good Taste**
Turn in **In Good Taste** (Sprinkle) and **Noxious Lair Investigation** (Pestlezugg)
steps.note: Decline Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient (its mushroom is in the Hinterlands). Fizzledowser then offers The Scrimshank Redemption: skip it (a long cave trip).

steps.text: Optional: lead Tooga to Torta at Steamwheedle Port
Zul'Farrak group with a mallet holder? Accept **Troll Temper**, **Divino-matic Rod** and **Scarab Shells**
steps.note: Run Zul'Farrak only if someone has the Mallet of Zul'Farrak for Gahz'rilla; without it the run pays about the same as grinding. Tran'rek may want Krazek's Booty Bay letter first.

steps.text: Ride south to Marvon Rivetseeker: turn in **Gahz'ridian**
steps.note: Short on ornaments? Keep the helm on during the next grind and come back.

steps.text: If an **OOX-17/TN Distress Beacon** dropped, ride south-east to the crashed robot
steps.note: 4,400 XP for about 2 extra minutes on the way to Thistleshrub Valley. Skip the escort: it is handed in at Booty Bay.

steps.text: Before the long grind: eat Well Fed food, and log out in the Gadgetzan inn between sessions
steps.note: Rested XP doubles your kill XP until it runs out; an inn banks about 5% of a level per 8 hours offline.

steps.text: Grind **Thistleshrubs** in Thistleshrub Valley until 49.5
steps.note: About 810 kills (8 hours): the highest normal mobs near Gadgetzan, so the best XP per kill. No quests are left at 48–50, so split this over sessions.

steps.text: With a mallet holder: run **Zul'Farrak** for its five quests
steps.note: About 1.75 hours with the group wait for roughly 59,000 XP, because Forever pays about double for quests done inside dungeons. That saves about 20 minutes of grinding.

steps.text: After Zul'Farrak: hand in the quests in Gadgetzan, at Steamwheedle Port and to Wizzle in the Shimmering Flats
steps.note: Then grind on to 50.

steps.text: Grind **Searing Rocs** and **Glasshide Petrifiers** on the valley's north rim until 50
steps.note: About 250 kills. Use the rim when the valley is crowded; otherwise stay on the Thistleshrubs.

steps.text: Hearth to Gadgetzan
Optional: ride east to Steamwheedle Port and accept **Yuka Screwspigot** from Yorba Screwspigot
steps.note: It needs level 48, so it waits until now. A free 2,650 XP when part 10 passes Yuka in the Burning Steppes.

steps.text: Level 50 in Gadgetzan: part 9 starts with the ride south into Un'Goro

quests.name: Return to Ironforge
quests.note: only if you did the Uldum pedestal: carry it to Historian Karnik on the part 9 Ironforge stop

steps.note: If you did the Uldum pedestal, carry Return to Ironforge: Historian Karnik then gives A Future Task (4,700 XP). No quest in Gadgetzan sends you to Un'Goro.

openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: nobody at launch has reached these quests, so every quest XP number in this part is the old game's value. If Forever pays more, the Thistleshrub grind gets shorter.

If you have a partner for elites, add WANTED: Overseer Maltorius, What the Flux?, The Horn of the Beast chain and the rest of the Windblade chain: about 40,000 XP, or about 140 fewer kills. Maltorius, Margol the Rager and the Twilight's Hammer camp are all elite in Forever.
Not confirmed yet: the grind rate above level 45. Blizzard raised creature health at higher levels on Nov 2, so 100 kills an hour may be optimistic for the Thistleshrub block.
If you are a few bars short of 46 at the Ironforge stop, train 46 in part 9 together with 48.
Not confirmed yet: how often the Feathermoon Ferry sails. If you wait long, swim the channel between the dock and the island instead.
Not confirmed yet: how long the ride from Farholde Keep to Powderfuse Port takes and where the Tanaris ship docks. Plan 3–5 minutes for the ride.
If no Mithril Casing is on the Auction House, part 9 skips two Chasing A-Me 01 quests (about 10,500 XP).

If your group has the Mallet of Zul'Farrak, Zul'Farrak saves about 20 minutes. Not confirmed yet: whether Forever still pays about double for dungeon quests above level 30, and whether Scarab Shells needs Krazek's Booty Bay letter first.
Gadgetzan and Feathermoon may offer new Forever quests that are not in the databases yet. Take any whose objectives lie on your loops.

legs.title: Un'Goro, Blasted Lands, Felwood, Winterspring & Silithus
legs.summary: Quest through Un'Goro Crater in one loop from Gadgetzan, then walk into Silithus for its flight path. Cross to Ironforge to train, spend most of a level on the Blasted Lands collection quests, and take the new Stormwind Harbor ship to Auberdine. Quest through Felwood and Winterspring by way of Timbermaw Hold, then finish with the Cenarion Hold quests in Silithus and sail back to Stormwind at 55.
legs.why: Un'Goro comes first because it borders Gadgetzan, where part 8 ends, and one loop from Marshal's Refuge takes you to about 50.8. Krakle's Finding the Source needs level 51, so you do it last, after a short tar pits grind, and then walk into Silithus to learn the Cenarion Hold flight path for the end of the part. Kalimdor has no Alliance warlock trainer, so you cross to the Eastern Kingdoms once: Steamwheedle ship, Farholde flight, Ironforge. From there the Blasted Lands (flight path from part 6) pay about 34k quest XP, most of it for monster parts you collect while you grind, and the new Stormwind Harbor ship puts you in Auberdine, one flight from Astranaar, without the Menethil detour. Felwood runs south to north into Timbermaw Hold, and its quests alone earn just enough Timbermaw reputation to walk through. Winterspring follows the classic Alliance speed route. Silithus comes at the end of the part: at 54.6 its Cenarion Hold quests pay about 65k XP in about 1.5 h, flights included, which beats grinding there (about 35k an hour), and your boat home leaves from Auberdine anyway. Even so, quests and the kills they need cover only about 469k of the 802,800 XP from 50 to 55 (Classic values), so about 334k (about 1,020 kills) is still grinding. It sits where it pays best: a short tar pits grind to reach 51 for Krakle, the Blasted Lands up to 52, so you can train in Stormwind, then the Deadwood and Winterfall camps (which also give Timbermaw reputation) and the Ice Thistle Hills.
legs.estTime: About 22–25 h /played: roughly 13.5 h of questing and travel plus about 1,020 grind kills (about 10.2 h at 100 kills an hour).
legs.start: Level 50 in Gadgetzan (Tanaris). Hearth: Gadgetzan. You have trained up to level 46. Your flight paths include Thorium Point, Gadgetzan, Thalanaar, Feathermoon, Nethergarde Keep, Auberdine and Astranaar. You carry a Mithril Casing, Return to Ironforge if part 8's Uldum quests were offered, and maybe Yuka Screwspigot for part 10.
legs.end: Level 55 in Stormwind, off the Auberdine boat after Silithus. Hearth: Everlook. You trained 48 and 50 in Ironforge and 52 and 54 in Stormwind. New flight paths: Marshal's Refuge, Cenarion Hold, Talonbranch Glade and Everlook (plus Talrendis Point if you did Azshara). You carry Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril and A Little Slime Goes a Long Way for part 10, plus the optional The Everlook Report, Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff and Yuka Screwspigot. Abandon Crystals of Power, The Mighty U'cha and any pylon quests you did not finish.

skipped.name: The Spirits of Southwind (Southwind chain)
skipped.why: It needs Rabine Saturna's lead-in quest from Darnassus, which this route never visits.

skipped.name: The Twilight Lexicon
skipped.why: It needs three level-60 Twilight Keepers.

skipped.name: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands
skipped.why: Deathclasp is a level-59 elite scorpid: a group kill.

skipped.name: Taking Back Silithus
skipped.why: Its giver stands by the Ironforge flight master and needs level 54, but you pass Ironforge at 51.

skipped.name: Secrets of the Colossus (Ashi, Regal, Zora)
skipped.why: Level-60 quests handed in at Booty Bay.

skipped.name: The Stones That Bind Us and the rest of the Fallen Hero chain
skipped.why: It needs nine level-57 Servants of Razelikh, far too high at 51, and the later steps are level 58–60.

skipped.name: To Serve Kum'isha
skipped.why: It needs a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere, a very rare drop.

skipped.name: Loramus (Azshara)
skipped.why: It follows The Demon Hunter, a level-60 Blasted Lands quest.

skipped.name: Sunken Temple
skipped.why: Its main quest needs the Hinterlands chain, and The Stone Circle sends you to Ratchet: about the grind rate at best.

skipped.name: Shaper's Terrace and Blackmaw Hold
skipped.why: New level 55–60 dungeons with no quest data yet: test them first.

skipped.name: Mount Hyjal
skipped.why: A level-60 zone; its flight masters are level 60. Darkwhisper Gorge leads there: turn back.

skipped.name: Volcanic Activity
skipped.why: Its turn-in is Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet, off the route.

skipped.name: A Visit to Gregan / Haze of Evil / Bloodpetal Sprouts
skipped.why: Muigin's chain goes to Feralas.

skipped.name: The Videre Elixir (Linken chain)
skipped.why: It needs Feralas and a trip to a Tanaris graveyard.

skipped.name: Bungle in the Jungle
skipped.why: It needs Darnassus's March of the Silithid chain.

skipped.name: Are We There, Yeti? (part 3)
skipped.why: You must also scare people in Gadgetzan and Un'Goro, far off the route.

skipped.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid → Dousing the Flames → A Final Blow
skipped.why: It goes to the Barrens, then into Shadow Hold (group).

skipped.name: Felbound Ancients / Purified! / Ancient Spirit
skipped.why: It needs a Darnassus trip, then an escort to Forest Song.

skipped.name: A Strange Red Key / Rescue From Jaedenar
skipped.why: The Blood Red Key drops only about 1 in 30 from Shadow Hold's demons and cultists, which are up to level 59–60, and the escort ends in a three-demon ambush. The chain pays about 23k XP if a key happens to drop.

skipped.name: Corrupted Sabers
skipped.why: It needs Well of Corruption, a Horde quest.

skipped.name: To Winterspring!
skipped.why: It needs level 53 at the Emerald Sanctuary and pays only 580 XP.

skipped.name: The Final Piece / Words of the High Chief / High Chief Winterfall
skipped.why: They need High Chief Winterfall, an elite group kill.

skipped.name: Deadwood Ritual Totem
skipped.why: It needs Neutral with Timbermaw Hold, about 3,000 more reputation.

skipped.name: Winterfall Ritual Totem
skipped.why: It needs Neutral with Timbermaw Hold, about 3,000 more reputation.

skipped.name: Frostsaber Provisions and the Frostsaber Rock chain
skipped.why: They need level 58 (Rivern Frostwind).

skipped.name: Sister Pamela
skipped.why: 550 XP for a trip to Darrowshire.

skipped.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
skipped.why: A lead-in to Donova, whom you meet from the tunnel side anyway.

skipped.name: Enraged Wildkin (Harlo)
skipped.why: A lead-in to Jaron, whom you meet first anyway.

steps.text: Gadgetzan: accept **Super Sticky** from Tran'rek; buy food and water

quests.name: Super Sticky
quests.note: quest level 54; 5,450 XP (Classic); 12 tar from Un'Goro tar elementals

steps.note: Part 8 did not take it. You hand it in when you pass back through Gadgetzan for the ship, so it costs no extra trip.

steps.text: Ride west to the Un'Goro path and follow it down to the waterfall
steps.note: From now on, loot every Power Crystal cluster you pass (red, blue, green, yellow): the optional Crystals of Power wants 7 of each. A Mangled Journal can drop from almost any Un'Goro monster (1–4%).

steps.text: Accept **The Apes of Un'Goro** and **The Fare of Lar'korwi** from Torwa Pathfinder

quests.name: The Apes of Un'Goro
quests.note: 2 pelts each of Gorilla, Stomper and Thunderer; 5,650 XP

steps.text: Ride north and take a **Piece of Threshadon Carcass** from the fresh carcass

mobs.name: Venomhide Ravasaur
mobs.note: poisons; kill it before it stacks

steps.text: Back at Torwa: turn in **The Fare of Lar'korwi**, accept **The Scent of Lar'korwi**
At the pond west of Torwa, click **A Wrecked Raft**, then dive for **A Small Pack**

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.note: 1,250 XP; ends at the pack under the water

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.note: bring the compass, map and key to Linken at Marshal's Refuge

steps.text: Raptor nests nearby: stand on the eggs to spawn **Lar'korwi Mates**; loot 2 **Ravasaur Pheromone Glands**
steps.note: Clear the raptors around the two egg nests first, then step on the eggs. Raptors drop the Mangled Journal most often (about 3–4%).

steps.text: Turn in **The Scent of Lar'korwi** at Torwa; accept **The Bait for Lar'korwi**
Ride north-east to the big skeleton; use **Torwa's Pouch** on the flat stone, kill **Lar'korwi**
steps.note: The Eastern Crystal Pylon (77.3, 50.0) is right here. You need it only for the optional pylon loop.

steps.text: Ride north-west to Marshal's Refuge; accept **Chasing A-Me 01** from Karna Remtravel

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
quests.note: find A-Me 01 in Fungal Rock; 2,650 XP

steps.note: About 4 minutes on your mount. Ride round the east side of the volcano, not over it.

steps.text: Learn the **Marshal's Refuge** flight path from Gryfe
steps.note: It links to Gadgetzan and Cenarion Hold. Your hearth stays in Gadgetzan.

steps.text: Marshal's Refuge: accept seven quests; give Linken his pack items

quests.name: Expedition Salvation
quests.note: crate in the NE camp + equipment in the SW camp; 4,200 XP

quests.name: Alien Ecology
quests.note: hive wall sample in the Slithering Scar; 3,050 XP

quests.name: Lost!
quests.note: find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge

quests.name: Beware of Pterrordax
quests.note: from the sign; 10 Pterrordax + 15 Frenzied Pterrordax; 5,650 XP

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.note: take Linken's sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring, later in this part

steps.note: Skip Larion's quests (Horde only), Muigin's follow-up (it goes to Feralas) and the repeatable Dadanga is Hungry!

steps.text: In the back of the cave, accept **Crystals of Power** from J.D. Collie

quests.name: Crystals of Power
quests.note: 7 Power Crystals of each colour; 5,250 XP

steps.note: The three pylon quests (3,950 XP each) open only after you hand this in. Keep looting crystals as you go.

steps.text: Fungal Rock: kill gorillas for 2 pelts of each kind; give **A-Me 01** your Mithril Casing

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
quests.note: hand over the Mithril Casing; 3,950 XP

steps.note: A-Me 01 waits in the cave: hand in part 1, take part 2, give it the Mithril Casing from part 8 and take part 3. Without a casing, skip parts 2 and 3.

steps.text: Escort **A-Me 01** west to Karna Remtravel at Marshal's Refuge; turn in **Chasing A-Me 01**
steps.note: Stay close and kill whatever attacks it on the way. Parts 2 and 3 pay 10,500 XP for about 12 minutes, the ride back south included.

steps.text: Ride back south-east to the three tar lakes: 12 **Super Sticky Tar**, 15 **Bloodpetals**, scales and bones
steps.note: Dinosaur Bones also lie on the ground as bone piles. The level 48–50 dinosaurs are a little below your level, so each kill gives less XP.

steps.text: Loot the **Crate of Foodstuffs** in the wrecked north-east camp
Ride south down the east side to Torwa: turn in **The Bait for Lar'korwi** and **The Apes of Un'Goro**

quests.name: The Mighty U'cha
quests.note: optional: only worth it on the pylon loop

steps.text: South rim: kill 10 **Pterrordax**; keep their scales

openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: Forever's XP for level 50–55 quests. No launch player has reached them, so every number here uses Classic values (open-world quests paid exactly Classic XP at lower levels).
Not confirmed yet: how fast level 51–58 monsters die after Forever raised their health on Nov 2. Every grind here assumes 100 kills an hour, so this part's 1,020 kills take about 10 hours.
If the Stormwind Harbor ship to Auberdine is missing, take the tram back to Ironforge, fly to Menethil Harbor and sail from there (about 10 minutes more).

If part 8 did not learn the Feathermoon flight path, you cannot fly from Astranaar to Cenarion Hold. Skip Silithus, grind about 190 more Ice Thistle kills, and fly from Astranaar to Auberdine for the boat.
If you have no Mithril Casing, skip Chasing A-Me 01 parts 2 and 3; the Blasted Lands grind grows by about 35 kills.

If you bind your hearth in Stormwind at the level-52 training stop instead of Everlook, you can hearth from Cenarion Hold straight to Stormwind. That skips the long flight and the boat (about 15–20 minutes) but costs the ride back from Darkwhisper Gorge (about 4 minutes).
Not confirmed yet: whether Forever starts you at 2,500/3,000 Hostile with Timbermaw Hold, as Classic does. If you start higher, the reputation check before the tunnel does not matter.

Not confirmed yet: whether Donova offers Threat of the Winterfall before you bring her Trouble in Winterspring! from Everlook. The classic Alliance speed route takes it straight from her; if she does not offer it, skip it (about 17 more grind kills).
Not confirmed yet: how common Power Crystals are in Forever, so the pylon loop stays optional.
Not confirmed yet: the flight times between Astranaar, Auberdine, Feathermoon and Cenarion Hold. We estimate about a quarter of an hour each way.
Not confirmed yet: whether Darkwhisper Gorge still counts as discovered at the same spot now that it leads into Mount Hyjal.

legs.title: Burning Steppes & the Plaguelands
legs.summary: Start in the Burning Steppes with Morgan's Vigil's quests and The True Masters courier chain, then grind Blackrock orcs to 56. Train in Stormwind, hand in your ooze jars in Ironforge, and ride from Southshore to Chillwind Camp for Western Plaguelands' cauldron chain and one loop of Eastern Plaguelands, which includes Tirion's hammer quest. After training 58 in Stormwind, finish Darrowshire from Light's Hope, grind the north-east almost to 60, and end Tirion's chain on Caer Darrow.
legs.why: This part is still mostly grinding, about 1,800 kills, because the Alliance has few unused quests left between 55 and 60; the classic Alliance speed route grinds here too. The Burning Steppes come first: Morgan's Vigil's quests sit on one loop, and The True Masters is a courier chain (Lakeshire, Stormwind, Lakeshire, Morgan's Vigil) worth about 20,700 XP with Dragonkin Menace. Grinding to 56 before you leave opens The First and the Last, whose follow-ups (about 20,000 XP) lie on your path through the Plaguelands. Western Plaguelands' cauldron chain ends at Gahrron's Withering on the eastern border, so one loop of Eastern Plaguelands starts there and ends at Tirion, and the western chains finish on the way back to Chillwind Camp. The two quests you carry from part 9 are handed in on paths you already take (about 12,150 XP for a few minutes), and Tirion's chain adds about 18,400 XP for roughly 20–25 minutes, about one and a half times the grind rate; it also lets you leave from Chillwind Camp, which is closer to Ironforge. Together they replace about 100 grind kills. The group dungeons help less than you might expect. Stratholme's living side is the only one that clearly beats grinding, by about 40 minutes. Lower Blackrock Spire is about even, and Blackrock Depths is slower, because its best quests need an Ironforge or Kharanos chain this route doesn't do, or a second run. All three need Forever to keep doubling quest XP inside dungeons above level 30, which players have measured only up to 29.
legs.estTime: About 25.5–27.5 h /played: roughly 8.5 h of quests, rides and flights, plus about 1,800 grind kills (about 18 h at 100 kills an hour). With a Stratholme group and the Light's Hope armour hand-ins, about 25.5–26 h.
legs.start: Level 55 in Stormwind (Slaughtered Lamb), trained 54. Hearth: Everlook; you re-bind to Stormwind early in this part. Carrying Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril and A Little Slime Goes a Long Way, plus The Everlook Report and Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff if you took them, and optionally Yuka Screwspigot.
legs.end: Level 60 in Ironforge (Forlorn Cavern), trained 60. You trained 56 and 58 in Stormwind. Hearth: Stormwind, or Light's Hope if its innkeeper is there. New flight paths: Morgan's Vigil, Chillwind Camp and Light's Hope. Route complete.

skipped.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
skipped.why: It starts in Ironforge, which you only reach after the Burning Steppes, and its second half is back in the Burning Steppes: about 6,000 XP for more than 10 minutes of extra travel.

skipped.name: Kharan Mighthammer
skipped.why: King Magni offers it only after The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan, so it can't be ready for a Blackrock Depths run at 56.

skipped.name: Hurley Blackbreath
skipped.why: It starts with Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos (Dun Morogh), which this part never visits.

skipped.name: Incendius!
skipped.why: Offered only after you hand Overmaster Pyron to Jalinda Sprig, and Pyron is inside Blackrock Depths: it needs a second run.

skipped.name: A Taste of Flame
skipped.why: It needs the Black Dragonflight Molt from the end of Kalaran Windblade's Searing Gorge chain, which part 8 skips.

skipped.name: Felnok Steelspring
skipped.why: It sends you back to Everlook in Winterspring.

skipped.name: Maxwell's Mission
skipped.why: Marshal Maxwell offers it only after you bring Bijou's message out of Lower Blackrock Spire, so its three bosses need a second run.

skipped.name: Mother's Milk
skipped.why: You must leave Lower Blackrock Spire poisoned and reach Ragged John before it wears off, which breaks up the run.

skipped.name: The Active Agent
skipped.why: Offered after you hand in The Flesh Does Not Lie, and its ziggurats are on Stratholme's undead side: a second run.

skipped.name: Of Love and Family (part 2)
skipped.why: The painting is inside Stratholme, and you only get the quest on Caer Darrow at 60.

skipped.name: Fragments of the Past
skipped.why: It sends you to the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara.

skipped.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way (part 2)
skipped.why: It needs 10 pure ooze samples from the Glutinous Oozes in Un'Goro Crater, and this route has left Kalimdor.

skipped.name: Alas, Andorhal
skipped.why: Araj the Summoner and his guards are a fight for 3–5 players.

skipped.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
skipped.why: Davil's book is inside Hearthglen among elite Scarlet Crusade guards.

skipped.name: Good Luck Charm
skipped.why: It goes back to Janice in Felstone Field (and Two Halves Become One there) after you have left Western Plaguelands.

skipped.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
skipped.why: Its turn-in is in Darnassus.

skipped.name: Unfinished Business (part 3)
skipped.why: Optional: a climb into Hearthglen's tower past elites, for 6,200 XP.

skipped.name: Hameya's Plea
skipped.why: Its target is a level-60 troll in Zul'Mashar, and the hand-in is behind the Undercroft at the opposite corner of the zone.

skipped.name: That's Asking A Lot
skipped.why: It needs crafted bars, bombs and triggers.

skipped.name: Mold Rhymes With...
skipped.why: Its turn-in is in Gadgetzan; it is the Scholomance key chain.

skipped.name: Order Must Be Restored
skipped.why: A raid-sized assault on Nathanos Blightcaller.

skipped.name: Barov Family Fortune
skipped.why: It is done inside Scholomance, and The Last Barov needs an assassination in a Horde town.

skipped.name: Taking Back Silithus
skipped.why: Silithus and Winterspring returns are a Kalimdor round trip of about 50 minutes from the Plaguelands; part 9 already covers Silithus.

skipped.name: Blasted Lands, Searing Gorge, Mount Hyjal and the Dreadsteed
skipped.why: Searing Gorge is done in part 8 and the Blasted Lands in part 9, Mount Hyjal is level-60 content, and the Dreadsteed is a Dire Maul group chain for after 60.

steps.text: Start at the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter at level 55
steps.note: You trained 54 here at the end of part 9, and your hearth still points to Everlook. You carry Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril and A Little Slime Goes a Long Way for this part.

steps.text: Accept **A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!** from Crier Goodman

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

npcs.name: Crier Goodman
npcs.role: quest giver (walks the Trade District and Cathedral Square)

steps.note: He walks between the Trade District and Cathedral Square. Take it: without it, Chillwind Camp won't offer Clear the Way.

steps.text: Make Stormwind your home at Innkeeper Allison
steps.note: At 56 you hearth back here from Morgan's Vigil to train and pick up The First and the Last.

steps.text: Optional: if you saved 60 wool, silk or mageweave, hand it to Clavicus Knavingham
steps.note: About 5,600 XP for three stacks of saved cloth, with no travel; 60 Runecloth on the 58 trip is another 6,600. These quests are in the game files, but nobody has confirmed this quartermaster in game yet.

steps.text: Fly to Lakeshire
steps.note: Players timed this flight at 1 min 53 s in launch week.

steps.text: Ride north out of Lakeshire into the Burning Steppes, then east along the road to Morgan's Vigil
steps.note: About 4–5 minutes on your mount. The path up to Morgan's Vigil starts near 83, 63.

steps.text: Learn the Morgan's Vigil flight path from Borgus Stoutarm
steps.note: It links to Stormwind, Lakeshire, Farholde Keep, Nethergarde Keep and Thorium Point. There is no inn here.

steps.text: Accept **Extinguish the Firegut** and **FIFTY! YEP!** from Oralius, and **Dragonkin Menace** from Helendis Riverhorn
steps.note: Dragonkin Menace needs 15 elite dragonkin (elites are much tougher than normal mobs), so ask in the zone channel for 2–3 players now. Pets were weakened on Nov 2, so your Voidwalker holds elites worse than it used to.

quests.name: Put Her Down
quests.note: Lower Blackrock Spire; from Helendis Riverhorn

steps.text: Optional, for a group run: also accept **Overmaster Pyron**, **The Good Stuff** and **Put Her Down**
steps.note: The first two are for Blackrock Depths, Put Her Down is for Lower Blackrock Spire. Take them only if you plan that dungeon (see the dungeon steps after the Burning Steppes quests).

steps.text: Kill 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres and 7 Firegut Brutes on Dreadmaul Rock
steps.note: Ogres cover the whole rock north of the Vigil. Work north toward Flame Crest as you finish.

steps.text: At Flame Crest, accept **Tablet of the Seven** from Maxwort Uberglint and **Broodling Essence** from Tinkee Steamboil
steps.note: Flame Crest is a neutral goblin camp. Ragged John stands here too; you come back for him later.

steps.text: Optional, for a group run: accept **The Heart of the Mountain**, **Kibler's Exotic Pets** and **En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why**
steps.note: The Heart of the Mountain is for Blackrock Depths; Kibler's two are for Lower Blackrock Spire. Skip them if you are not running that dungeon.

steps.text: If you carried **Yuka Screwspigot** from Tanaris, hand it to Yuka in the Flame Crest cave

quests.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
quests.note: only for a Blackrock Depths run

steps.note: 2,650 XP. She then offers Ribbly Screwspigot, a Blackrock Depths quest: take it only for a group run.

steps.text: Ride to the north-east dragonkin: zap Black Broodlings with the device, then kill them and the dragonspawn
steps.note: Use the device on a broodling before you hit it; the kill then drops a Broodling Essence. You need 8.

steps.text: Follow the east wall south and finish 15 broodlings, 10 dragonspawn and 4 wyrmkin
steps.note: Solo, pull one elite at a time: Fear and Death Coil keep you alive, and Drain Life heals you. The classic Alliance speed route calls it soloable but close.

steps.text: Turn in **Extinguish the Firegut** and **Dragonkin Menace**; accept **Gor'tesh the Brute Lord** and **The True Masters**
Fly to Lakeshire
Turn in **The True Masters** to Magistrate Solomon and accept the next part
steps.note: Redridge coordinates here are on Forever's redrawn map, about 5 lower across than older guides.

steps.text: Fly to Stormwind
In Stormwind Keep, hand **The True Masters** to Bolvar, talk to Lady Prestor, then take Bolvar's Decree
steps.note: If you missed Crier Goodman earlier, look for him on the way back to the flight master.

steps.text: Fly back to Lakeshire
Give Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon and accept the last courier part of **The True Masters**
Fly to Morgan's Vigil
Turn in **The True Masters** to Marshal Maxwell and accept the part that sends you to Ragged John
steps.note: Together with Dragonkin Menace, this courier chain is worth about 20,700 XP for a few flights.

steps.text: Ride west to the Pillar of Ash orc camps: kill Gor'tesh and loot Blackrock Medallions
steps.note: Medallions drop from about 80% of the orcs and worgs, going by the old game's data.

steps.text: Grind Blackrock orcs around the Pillar of Ash until 27,900 XP short of 56; finish the 50 medallions
steps.at: Pillar of Ash and Blackrock Pass
steps.note: About 329 kills; the six hand-ins left in this zone then take you to 56, which The First and the Last needs. If a dungeon group forms, skip this grind (see the optional dungeon steps below).

steps.text: Click the dwarf statue in the Ruins of Thaurissan for the Tablet Transcript
At Flame Crest, turn in **Tablet of the Seven** and **Broodling Essence**, then talk to Ragged John
steps.note: Skip Felnok Steelspring: it sends you back to Winterspring.

steps.text: Ride back south-east to Morgan's Vigil, killing ogres you pass
Turn in **Gor'tesh the Brute Lord**, **FIFTY! YEP!** and **The True Masters**; accept **Ogre Head On A Stick = Party**

quests.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party

steps.note: Marshal Maxwell now offers Marshal Windsor, a Blackrock Depths quest: leave it unless you have a group.

steps.text: Plant Gor'tesh's head on the Soft Dirt Mound at the top of Dreadmaul Rock

quests.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party

steps.text: Turn in **Ogre Head On A Stick = Party**

quests.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party

steps.text: Optional, for a Blackrock Depths group: accept **Marshal Windsor** from Marshal Maxwell
steps.note: Maxwell offers it only now that The True Masters is done.

steps.text: Optional: run Blackrock Depths once with a quest group

quests.name: Marshal Windsor
quests.note: Windsor sits in a cell in the Detention Block

quests.name: Overmaster Pyron
quests.note: at the quarry near the start

quests.name: Incendius!
quests.note: only offered after Pyron is handed in outside

quests.name: The Good Stuff
quests.note: 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs from the dwarves

quests.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
quests.note: only if you carried Yuka Screwspigot

quests.name: Dark Iron Legacy
quests.note: Franclorn's ghost, seen only while you are dead

quests.name: Dark Iron Legacy
quests.note: place Ironfel on the Shrine of Thaurissan

steps.note: On our estimate this is slower than grinding: about 50,000–65,000 quest XP plus 9,000 from mobs for 2.5–3 hours with the wait, where the orc grind gives that in about 2 hours. Run it for gear, or if your group is unusually fast; Franclorn, who starts Dark Iron Legacy, is a ghost you only see while dead.

quests.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
quests.note: catch a Bloodaxe Worg Pup with the cage

quests.name: Urok Doomhowl
quests.note: summon Urok with the Roughshod Pike, bring Warosh's Mojo back

quests.name: Mother's Milk
quests.note: you must leave the dungeon poisoned

steps.text: Optional: run Lower Blackrock Spire once with a quest group
steps.note: About 77,500 quest XP plus 10,000 from mobs in about 2.5–3 hours with the wait and the ride: no faster than grinding, so run it for gear. Its elites are level 55–60, so go only with players of 56 or higher.

steps.text: Back at Flame Crest, hand in **The Heart of the Mountain**, **Ribbly Screwspigot**, **Kibler's Exotic Pets** and **En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why**
steps.note: After a group run, hand in only the ones you did.

steps.text: Then at Morgan's Vigil, hand in **Abandoned Hope**, **Message to Maxwell**, **Overmaster Pyron**, **The Good Stuff** and **Put Her Down**
steps.note: Skip the orc grind above if you ran a dungeon. If you are still short of 56, grind Blackrock orcs or Firegut ogres until you reach it.

steps.text: Hearth to Stormwind
steps.note: It saves the two-flight trip. If you are not 56 yet, grind first: The First and the Last needs 56.

steps.text: Train your level 56 spells in the Slaughtered Lamb
steps.note: Stormwind's warlock trainers teach the same spells as Ironforge's, and you are already here. New spells no longer go on your bars by themselves (Nov 2 notes).

steps.text: Accept **The First and the Last** from Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep
steps.note: Needs level 56.

steps.text: At SI:7 in Old Town, turn in to Master Mathias Shaw, do **Honor the Dead**, accept **Flint Shadowmore**
steps.note: This chain leads to The Eastern Plagues (8,300 XP) and The Blightcaller Cometh (6,600).

steps.text: Take the Deeprun Tram from the Dwarven District to Ironforge
steps.note: It is quicker than flying, and you stop in Ironforge anyway.

quests.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
quests.note: the follow-up needs pure ooze samples from Un'Goro Crater

steps.text: In the Hall of Explorers, turn in **A Little Slime Goes a Long Way** to Laris Geardawdle
steps.note: 6,350 XP for the ooze jars you filled in Felwood. Skip the follow-up quest: it needs pure ooze samples from Un'Goro Crater.

steps.text: Fly from Gryth Thurden at the Great Forge to Southshore
steps.note: Players timed Southshore to Ironforge at 3 min 26 s.

steps.text: Ride north from Southshore through the eastern Alterac pass into Western Plaguelands, to Chillwind Camp
steps.note: Stay east of Tarren Mill's Horde guards. Alterac's map is redrawn in Forever, so follow the road; about 4–5 minutes.

steps.text: Learn the Chillwind Camp flight path from Bibilfaz Featherwhistle
steps.note: It links to Ironforge, Southshore, Aerie Peak and Light's Hope. Chillwind Camp has no innkeeper, so keep your Stormwind hearth.

steps.text: Hand Valorfist **A Call to Arms** for **Clear the Way**; give Pureheart **The Everlook Report**, take **Argent Dawn Commission**

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

steps.note: The Everlook Report from part 9 is 2,550 XP. Wear the Argent Dawn Commission trinket in the Plaguelands so Scourgestones drop for Argent Dawn reputation.

steps.text: Turn in **Flint Shadowmore**; accept **The Eastern Plagues**, and **A Plague Upon Thee** from Nathaniel Dumah
steps.note: The insignias for The Eastern Plagues and the termites are both in Eastern Plaguelands.

steps.text: Accept **Little Pamela** from Marlene Redpath on Sorrow Hill
Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls on Sorrow Hill
Turn in **Clear the Way**; take **All Along the Watchtowers**, **The Scourge Cauldrons** and **Target: Felstone Field**
steps.note: The cauldron quests come from High Priestess MacDonnell.

steps.text: Mark Andorhal's four towers with the Beacon Torch: 46.6, 71.1 → 40.1, 71.6 → 42.3, 66.2 → 44.3, 63.3
steps.note: Stand in each doorway and use the torch. Elites wait inside, so don't step in.

steps.text: Accept **A Matter of Time** from Chromie upstairs in the Andorhal inn
Use the Temporal Displacer at the broken grain silos and kill 15 Temporal Parasites
steps.note: Each silo spawns 1–3 parasites. Most silos are on the east side of town.

steps.text: Turn in **A Matter of Time**; accept **Counting Out Time**
Loot 5 Andorhal Watches from the small lockboxes in the rubble around the inn
Turn in **Counting Out Time**
steps.note: Skip the repeatable version.

steps.text: Felstone Field: kill Cauldron Lord Bilemaw for his key, then use the Scourge Cauldron
Upstairs in the north farmhouse, accept **Better Late Than Never** from Janice; grab Janice's Parcel in the barn
steps.note: The parcel goes to Stormwind on your 58 trip.

steps.text: At camp, turn in **Return to Chillwind Camp** and **All Along the Watchtowers**; take **Target: Dalson's Tears** and **Skeletal Fragments**
steps.note: Skeletal Fragments drop from about 80% of the skeletons here; you finish them in the Andorhal grind. Skip Alas, Andorhal: it is a group fight.

steps.text: Dalson's Tears: kill Cauldron Lord Malvinious and use the cauldron
Do **Locked Away**: skeleton → outhouse key → Farmer Dalson → cabinet key → the locked cabinet upstairs
steps.note: Worth 7,050 XP. Mrs. Dalson's Diary in the barn gives nothing.

steps.text: Turn in **Return to Chillwind Camp**; accept **Target: Writhing Haunt**
Accept **The Wildlife Suffers Too** from Mulgris Deepriver in the Writhing Haunt farmhouse
Kill Cauldron Lord Razarch and use the Writhing Haunt cauldron
Kill 8 Diseased Wolves just north of the Haunt
steps.note: No need to go further east for them.

steps.text: Turn in **The Wildlife Suffers Too**; accept the grizzly part
Turn in **Return to Chillwind Camp**; accept **Target: Gahrron's Withering**
Ride back to the Writhing Haunt and kill 8 Diseased Grizzlies on the slopes around it
steps.note: Grizzlies roam from the Haunt north-east to the Gahrron hills; take the ones nearest the farmhouse first.

steps.text: Turn in **The Wildlife Suffers Too** to Mulgris at the Writhing Haunt
steps.note: Skip Glyphed Oaken Branch: its turn-in is in Darnassus.

steps.text: Ride east to Gahrron's Withering: kill Cauldron Lord Soulwrath, use the cauldron, keep the return quest
steps.note: Soulwrath is level 58. Keep Return to Chillwind Camp until you are back at camp; Tirion's bridge (about 70, 50) is just east of here.

steps.text: Read Eastern Plaguelands coordinates in this part on Wowhead's map; Forever's in-game map shows lower numbers
steps.note: The Questie addon's Forever data puts Tirion at 5.2, 35.6 and Light's Hope at 71.8, 49.6. Rough conversion: in-game x ≈ 0.9 × x − 1.6, y ≈ 0.89 × y − 3.1.

steps.text: Cross the Thondroril bridge; accept **Demon Dogs**, **Blood Tinged Skies** and **Carrion Grubbage** from Tirion Fordring
steps.note: From here on, kill every Plaguehound Runt, Plaguebat and Carrion Grub or Devourer you pass.

steps.text: Ride north-east to the Plaguewood edge: fill the termite jar at the mounds, kill Frenzied Plaguehounds and Carrion Devourers
steps.note: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the mounds (around 45, 34) until you have 100 termites.

steps.text: Ride north to Northpass Tower and turn in **Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril** to Aurora Skycaller
steps.note: 5,800 XP for the fragments you dug in Winterspring, about a minute off your path. Skip her next quest, Fragments of the Past: it sends you to Azshara.

steps.text: Continue east toward Northdale: finish 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds and keep collecting worm meat
steps.at: North of Blackwood Lake to Northdale

steps.text: Ride south to Light's Hope Chapel and learn the flight path from Khaelyn Steelwing
steps.note: It links to Ironforge, Chillwind Camp and Aerie Peak.

steps.text: Give **Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff** to the Duke; accept **Zaeldarr the Outcast** and **The Restless Souls** from Caretaker Alen
steps.note: The Duke stands by the chapel next to the flight master (2,550 XP). While here, look for Rohan the Assassin, Huntsman Leopold and Korfax by the chapel: if they exist, see the armour quests at 58.

steps.text: If Jessica Chambers is at Light's Hope, make it your home
steps.note: She is in the game files but came with a late patch of the old game. With this bind, you hearth straight back here after the 58 trip.

steps.text: Ride west across the middle of the zone: kill 5 Plaguehounds, plus grubs and bats
Sweep south-west to Darrowshire, killing Plaguebats, Plaguehound Runts and Carrion Grubs on the way
Turn in **Little Pamela** to Pamela Redpath; accept **Pamela's Doll**
Search Darrowshire's ruined houses for the doll's head, left side and right side, then combine them
steps.note: The parts move between houses. Ghosts spawn when you get close.

steps.text: Turn in **Pamela's Doll**; accept **Auntie Marlene** and **Uncle Carlin**
Enter the Undercroft and kill Zaeldarr the Outcast at the bottom for his head
steps.note: Leave the dirt mound behind the crypt alone for now: you come back for it with Tirion's quest.

steps.text: Loot the three SI:7 insignias from the Mangled Human Remains around Marris Stead
steps.note: Nathanos Blightcaller (a level 62 elite) stands at the farm: come in from the east and stay out of his range.

steps.text: Ride north along the west edge and finish the runts, bats and worm meat
At Tirion's hut, turn in **Demon Dogs**, **Blood Tinged Skies** and **Carrion Grubbage**; do **Redemption**; accept **Of Forgotten Memories**
steps.note: Redemption is just Tirion's story. Of Forgotten Memories sends you back to the Undercroft for his son's hammer.

steps.text: In Terrordale, turn in **The Restless Souls** to Egan; accept **Augustus' Receipt Book** from Augustus
steps.note: 6,600 XP just for finding Egan.

steps.text: Loot Augustus' Receipt Book in the ruined inn and bring it back to Augustus
Optional, for a Stratholme group later: accept the second **The Restless Souls** from Egan
steps.note: It is done inside Stratholme with Egan's Blaster. Skip it if you won't run Stratholme.

steps.text: Ride back south past Tirion's hut and down the west edge to the Undercroft
steps.note: About 3 minutes.

steps.text: Behind the Undercroft, click the Loose Dirt Mound; kill Mercutio Filthgorger and his Crypt Robbers for Taelan's Hammer
steps.note: The mound brings Mercutio (57) and a few Crypt Robbers (54–55), all normal mobs. Let your Voidwalker hold Mercutio, Fear one robber and drain the rest.

steps.text: Ride back to Tirion: turn in **Of Forgotten Memories**; accept **Of Lost Honor**
steps.note: 6,000 XP. Of Lost Honor's symbol lies in Northdale, inside your 58–60 grind area, so it waits until then.

steps.text: Cross Tirion's bridge and ride south-west down the road to Chillwind Camp
steps.note: About 3 minutes.

steps.text: Turn in **The Eastern Plagues**, **Return to Chillwind Camp**, **Mission Accomplished!** and the termites; accept **The Blightcaller Cometh**
steps.note: Mission Accomplished! is a talk-only quest with Valorfist (9,300 XP). Keep The Blightcaller Cometh for Stormwind.

steps.text: At Sorrow Hill, turn in **Auntie Marlene**; accept **A Strange Historian** and take the ring from Joseph's grave
steps.note: Joseph Redpath's monument is the odd-coloured gravestone just north of her house.

steps.text: Give Chromie the ring; accept **The Annals of Darrowshire**
Search the books on the Andorhal town hall floor until one is **The Annals of Darrowshire**
steps.note: Go in from the south-west side. Some books spawn mobs.

steps.text: Turn in **The Annals of Darrowshire**; accept **Brother Carlin**
steps.note: Brother Carlin goes to Light's Hope on your second visit.

steps.text: Ride north to Kirsta Deepshadow's hut, north of the lumber mill; accept **Unfinished Business**
steps.at: Kirsta's hut, north of the Lumber Mill
steps.note: About 2 minutes from Andorhal.

steps.text: Northridge Lumber Mill: kill 2 Scarlet Knights, 2 Scarlet Magi, 2 Scarlet Medics and 2 Scarlet Hunters
steps.note: Medics and hunters stand at the south end of the mill (51, 44).

steps.text: Place the termites in the barrel at the centre of the mill
Turn in **Unfinished Business**; accept part two
Kill Huntsman Radley, then Cavalier Durgen on top of the tower
steps.at: East of the mill / north tower

steps.text: Turn in **Unfinished Business**
steps.note: Part three needs a climb into Hearthglen past elites: do it only if Hearthglen's tower is quiet (6,200 XP).

steps.text: Ride south and grind the Scourge in Andorhal until 10,150 XP short of 58
steps.note: About 362 kills. Finish the 15 Skeletal Fragments on the Acolytes and keep any Scourgestones and Bone Fragments; the two camp hand-ins then bring you to 58.

steps.text: Back at Chillwind Camp, turn in the last **A Plague Upon Thee** and **Skeletal Fragments**
steps.note: Skip Mold Rhymes With...: its turn-in is in Gadgetzan. Hand any Scourgestones to Argent Officer Pureheart for reputation.

steps.text: Hearth to Stormwind; if you bound at Light's Hope, fly to Stormwind by way of Ironforge instead

npcs.name: Bibilfaz Featherwhistle
npcs.role: flight master (if you bound at Light's Hope)

steps.note: The hearth has been ready since Morgan's Vigil. If you did the cloth donations, A Donation of Runecloth (60 Runecloth, 6,600 XP) is at Clavicus Knavingham nearby.

steps.text: City Hall: give Janice's parcel to Royal Factor Bathrilor; accept **Good Natured Emma**
Find Ol' Emma and turn in **Good Natured Emma**
steps.note: Skip Good Luck Charm: Janice is back in Felstone Field and this route doesn't return there.

steps.text: Turn in **The Blightcaller Cometh** to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
steps.note: Skip Order Must Be Restored: it is a raid-sized fight.

steps.text: Train your level 58 spells in the Slaughtered Lamb
Fly to Light's Hope by way of Ironforge; if you bound there, hearth instead
steps.note: Nobody has timed this flight yet.

steps.text: Light's Hope: turn in **Uncle Carlin**, **Brother Carlin** and **Zaeldarr the Outcast**; accept **Defenders of Darrowshire** and **Villains of Darrowshire**
steps.note: Skip Heroes of Darrowshire: its book is inside Hearthglen.

steps.text: If they are here, accept **Bonescythe Digs**, **Cryptstalker Armor Doesn't Make Itself...** and **Binding the Dreadnaught**
steps.note: Each pays 6,600 XP for 30 drops: Bone Fragments from the Scourge you grind, Crypt Fiend Parts from crypt fiends, Dark Iron Scraps from Blackrock Depths dwarves. Rohan, Leopold and Korfax came with a late patch of the old game, so they may not be in Forever.

steps.text: Optional, Stratholme: accept **The Flesh Does Not Lie**, **The Great Fras Siabi**, **Houses of the Holy**, **The Archivist**
steps.note: Only if you plan a Stratholme group. Betina Bigglezink, Smokey LaRue, Leonid Barthalomew and Duke Nicholas all stand around the chapel.

steps.text: Corin's Crossing: kill Gibbering Ghouls and talk to the Darrowshire Spirits that rise from them
steps.note: Cannibal Ghouls and Diseased Flayers free spirits too.

steps.text: Pick up the Shattered Sword of Marduk at the bottom of the gorge west of the crossing
steps.at: The Infectis Scar, west of Corin's Crossing

steps.text: Dive into Blackwood Lake for Horgus' Skull
Ride east and finish the 15 spirits on the Diseased Flayers north of the chapel
Turn in **Defenders of Darrowshire** and **Villains of Darrowshire** to Carlin Redpath
Before the long grind, eat Well Fed food; between play sessions, log out in an inn
steps.note: Rested XP doubles kill XP and builds 5% of a level per 8 hours. Well Fed food adds 5% kill XP for about 15 minutes.

steps.text: Optional: run Stratholme's living side once with a quest group
steps.at: Stratholme, living side (north of Eastern Plaguelands)
steps.note: About 93,000 quest XP plus 10,000 from mobs in about 2.5 hours with travel and the wait, roughly 40 minutes faster than grinding it. That holds only if Forever still doubles quest XP inside dungeons at this level.

quests.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
quests.note: 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from any mob

quests.name: The Archivist
quests.note: kill Archivist Galford, burn the archive

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.note: Egan's Blaster on the ghostly citizens

quests.name: The Active Agent
quests.note: its ziggurats are on Stratholme's undead side

steps.text: After Stratholme, hand in its five quests around the chapel
steps.note: Skip The Active Agent that Betina then offers: its ziggurats are on Stratholme's undead side. With this run done, grind about 320 fewer kills below, and stop the troll grind 29,000 XP short of 60 if you carry The Restless Souls.

steps.text: Grind the Scourge north of the chapel, from the flayer fields toward Northdale, until 59
steps.note: About 509 kills; these mobs stay at or above your level, so keep any Bone Fragments for the armour quest. Blizzard raised creature health at higher levels on Nov 2, so kills may be slower than in the old game.

steps.text: If you have 30 of any armour drop, ride back to the chapel and hand them in
steps.note: 6,600 XP each for a 3-minute detour. Grind about 20 fewer kills for each one you hand in.

steps.text: In Northdale, open the Symbol of Lost Honor container for **Of Lost Honor**
steps.note: It stands among the Scourge between the flayer fields and Zul'Mashar.

steps.text: Grind the Mossflayer trolls at Zul'Mashar, or stay on the Scourge, until 12,400 XP short of 60
steps.note: About 613 kills. Trolls are humanoids, so Fear works and they drop runecloth; leave Infiltrator Hameya (level 60) alone.

steps.text: Ride west along the northern road toward Terrordale and Tirion's hut
steps.note: About 4–5 minutes; you pass Terrordale on the way.

steps.text: If you ran Stratholme, turn in **The Restless Souls** to Egan in Terrordale
Turn in **Of Lost Honor** to Tirion; accept **Of Love and Family**
Cross the bridge and ride south along the river to Darrowmere Lake; swim to Caer Darrow
steps.note: About 2–3 minutes. The island also holds the Scholomance entrance.

steps.text: On Caer Darrow, turn in **Of Love and Family** to Artist Renfray; this takes you to 60
steps.note: Renfray is a friendly ghost (level 12). Skip his next quest: the painting is inside Stratholme.

steps.text: Ride south-west to Chillwind Camp and fly to Ironforge
steps.note: Chillwind Camp is closer to Ironforge than Light's Hope. If your hearth is in Stormwind, hearthing there and training at the Slaughtered Lamb is quicker.

steps.text: Train your level 60 spells in the Forlorn Cavern
steps.note: Level 60 adds Bane of Doom. The Dreadsteed chain (Dire Maul, with a group) comes after this route.

steps.text: Level 60: route complete
steps.note: Hearth: Stormwind, or Light's Hope if you bound there. Flight paths added this part: Morgan's Vigil, Chillwind Camp and Light's Hope.

openQuestions: Not confirmed yet: quest XP at 55–60. Nobody had reached these quests at launch, so every number in this part is the old game's value. If Forever pays more, the grinds get shorter.

Not confirmed yet: whether Forever still pays about double for quests done inside dungeons above level 30 (players measured it only up to 29). If it pays the old values, Stratholme is no faster than grinding, and Blackrock Depths and Lower Blackrock Spire are clearly slower.

Not confirmed yet: kill speed above 50. Blizzard raised class damage and the health of higher-level creatures together on Nov 2, and pets now get less health from your Stamina. Dragonkin Menace (15 elites) and the Mercutio pull at the Undercroft have not been tested solo in Forever.

Not confirmed yet: whether Rohan the Assassin, Huntsman Leopold and Korfax stand at Light's Hope in Forever. If they do, Bone Fragments from the Scourge are the easy one; the old game's loot tables list Crypt Fiend Parts mainly from Stratholme and a level-60 elite, and Dark Iron Scraps from Blackrock Depths dwarves.
Chillwind Camp has no innkeeper. Light's Hope's innkeeper came with a late patch of the old game, so check in game before binding there.
Eastern Plaguelands' in-game map is redrawn in Forever; this part uses Wowhead's coordinates (see the tip at Tirion's bridge for a rough conversion).
Not timed yet: the flights Stormwind to Light's Hope and Chillwind Camp to Ironforge, the ride from Southshore to Chillwind Camp, and the ride from Zul'Mashar to Caer Darrow.
If the cloth quartermasters are in game, saved cloth is cheap XP in Stormwind: about 5,600 for wool, silk and mageweave, and 6,600 for runecloth.
If you did not dig the Kel'Theril fragments or fill the ooze jars in part 9, skip those two hand-ins and grind about 40 more kills.
